quests.name: Durnehviir
journal: I have made a pact with the dragon, Durnehviir. I will agree to summon him to Tamriel on occasion, and in return he's agreed to fight by my side and teach me his unique shout.
I've now fully learned Durnehviir's shout by summoning him to Tamriel. Our agreement appears to be mutually beneficial, and therefore I'll continue to summon him as I deem necessary.
objectives: Learn the first word of the Soul Tear shout
Learn the second word of the Soul Tear shout
Learn the final word of the Soul Tear shout

quests.name: Durnehviir Misc Objective Handler
objectives: Speak to Durnehviir at his lair in the Soul Cairn

quests.name: Forgotten Vale Books Quest
objectives: Bring Ancient Falmer Tome to Urag gro-Shub

lines.name: Dragonborn
lines.begins: I've been attacked by a group of cultists. I need to see if they have any evidence of what prompted this assault.
lines.start: Miraak's cultists find you once you're level 25 and past The Way of the Voice. You can sail to Raven Rock from Windhelm's docks earlier.
lines.gate: Level 25 and The Way of the Voice, for the cultists.
lines.firstObjective: Find out who sent the Cultists

quests.name: Dragonborn
journal: I've been attacked by a group of cultists. I need to see if they have any evidence of what prompted this assault.
I've found a note on one of the cultists who attacked me. Perhaps it has some clue as to what prompted them to come after me.

I've been attacked by a group of people claiming to work for someone named Miraak. I need to find out why they're trying to kill me, and so I should look for the boat in Windhelm they used to travel from Solstheim.
I have arrived on Solstheim in search of the "Miraak" mentioned in a note as being behind the attempt on my life. Perhaps someone in the town of Raven Rock will know about him.
The people of Raven Rock know the name Miraak, saying that he has a temple near the center of the island. I should seek him out and find out why people have attacked me on his behalf.

After an attempt on my life, I've tracked the people responsible to the isle of Solstheim, where someone named Miraak has a temple near the center of the island. It's time to find out what's going on.
objectives: Find out who sent the Cultists

quests.name: The Temple of Miraak
journal: After freeing the Skaal from the magic controlling them, Storn, the shaman, has asked me to seek out a member of their tribe who is still missing. I need to look to the temple near the center of Solstheim to find Frea and make sure she is safe.
I've found Miraak's temple on Solstheim. Now I need to find out why people are trying to kill me on his behalf.
I was successful in defeating Miraak after he attacked me, but he has disappeared. I should search his temple to learn more about what's going on here.
I've found Frea, a warrior from the Skaal Village on Solstheim. She is also searching the Temple of Miraak, looking for answers. We've agreed that we need to find where Miraak's power is coming from.

After delving through the Temple of Miraak, Frea and I have discovered a strange book deep within secret chambers. Frea believes it has a connection to what's happening on Solstheim. I should read it to learn what secrets it holds.

After searching the Temple of Miraak, Frea and I found a strange book. When I read it, I was transported to some other realm, where I learned that Miraak is still alive and plans to return to Solstheim. I need to tell Frea what I've seen.

After finding Frea, and searching the Temple of Miraak, we discovered a strange book. When I read it, I was transported to some other realm and learned that Miraak is still alive and claims he'll return soon. Frea has suggested we take this information back to her village, and see what can be done to stop Miraak.
objectives: Find the source of Miraak's power

quests.name: The Fate of the Skaal
journal: After a strange experience with the Black Book in the Temple of Miraak, Frea says it is important to consult the Skaal Shaman. I should accompany her back to her village.

Storn, the Skaal shaman, has suggested that my experiences on Solstheim mean I am connected to Miraak. To follow the path Miraak has taken and learn what he knows, I must travel to Saering's Watch and learn the Word of Power written there.

In order to free the people of the Skaal, and to thwart Miraak's plans, I have learned a new Word of Power. I must use this new knowledge to disrupt the activity at the Wind Stone, where the Skaal are working against their will.
The people of the Skaal have been freed from the control they have been under, but in doing so a hideous creature has been released. It must be defeated before the Skaal are truly safe.

The Skaal have been freed from Miraak's control, and his minion has been destroyed. Now that Storn no longer needs to focus on keeping his people safe, he may be able to tell me more about how to find and defeat Miraak.
objectives: Use the "Bend Will" Shout on the Wind Stone

quests.name: Cleansing the Stones
journal: After I destroyed Miraak's control of the Wind Stone, Storn has asked me to free the remaining sacred Stones using my "Bend Will" Shout.
I cleansed the sacred Stones that Miraak had corrupted. Solstheim is free of his influence except for the Tree Stone, which remains imprisoned inside his new Temple.

quests.name: The Path of Knowledge
journal: In order to defeat Miraak, I need to find more of the Black Books, the source of his knowledge and power. Storn suggested that the wizard Neloth may know the location of the Black Books that I need.

In order to defeat Miraak, I need to find more of Hermaeus Mora's Black Books, the source of his knowledge and power. The Telvanni wizard Neloth found one of these books in the Dwarven ruin of Nchardak, but it is locked inside some kind of protective mechanism. Maybe together we can find a way to get at this Black Book.
With the help of the Telvanni wizard Neloth, I found another of Hermaeus Mora's Black Books in the Dwarven ruin of Nchardak.
objectives: Restore the steam supply to the Dwemer reading room
Release the book from the Dwemer contraption

quests.name: The Gardener of Men
journal: With Neloth's help, I gained access to the Black Book in Nchardak. Now to read it and learn more of Miraak's knowledge.

With Neloth's help, I gained access to the Black Book in Nchardak. I read it and was transported to Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha, where I found the book's counterpart. Hermaeus Mora himself appeared and taught me the second Word of "Bend Will". He has promised to teach me the third Word but only in return for "the secrets of the Skaal."

With Neloth's help, I gained access to the Black Book in Nchardak. I read it and was transported to Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha, where I found the book's counterpart. Hermaeus Mora himself appeared and taught me the second Word of Bend Will. He promised to teach me the third Word but only if in return for "the secrets of the Skaal." The Skaal shaman Storn agreed to give Hermaeus Mora what he wanted, but when Storn read the book, Hermaeus Mora killed him while teaching me the promised Word of Power.
objectives: Learn the hidden knowledge of "Epistolary Acumen"
Wait for Storn to read the book

quests.name: At the Summit of Apocrypha
journal: Hermaeus Mora taught me the final Word of Power of the "Bend Will" Shout, killing Storn in the process. I now have what I need to return to Apocrypha and face Miraak.

Hermaeus Mora taught me the final Word of Power of the "Bend Will" Shout, killing Storn in the process. With this Shout, I can tame Miraak's dragon and force him to fly me to Miraak's temple in Apocrypha.
Hermaeus Mora taught me the final Word of Power of the "Bend Will" Shout, killing Storn in the process. I used the Shout to tame Miraak's dragon and flew to his temple, where he was waiting for me.

Hermaeus Mora taught me the final Word of Power of the "Bend Will" Shout, killing Storn in the process. I used the Shout to tame Miraak's dragon and flew to his temple, where I fought and killed him. Miraak will never threaten Solstheim again.
objectives: Use the "Bend Will" Shout to tame Sahrotaar

lines.name: The Companions
lines.begins: If I want to become a member of the Companions, I have to speak to their leader, Kodlak Whitemane, in Whiterun.
lines.start: Talk to Kodlak Whitemane in Jorrvaskr, Whiterun. Or take the Companions start.
lines.gate: None. Jobs open the next part: 3 before Proving Honor, 5 more before The Silver Hand, 4 more before Blood's Honor (12 in all).

quests.name: Take Up Arms
journal: If I want to become a member of the Companions, I have to speak to their leader, Kodlak Whitemane, in Whiterun.
The legendary warrior band of Whiterun, the Companions have agreed to let me join them, if I can handle some preliminary tasks for them.
I have joined the Companions, the legendary warrior band of Whiterun.
objectives: Spar with Vilkas in the training yard behind Jorrvaskr
Give Vilkas' sword to Forgemaster Eorlund Grey-Mane, at the Skyforge

quests.name: Proving Honor
journal: The Companions leaders say they don't have any more work for me, but that I should speak to Skjor about "the next steps."

The Companions have given me one final challenge before inducting me. I'm to retrieve a fragment of Wuuthrad, the Blade of Ysgramor, from <Alias=Dungeon> while <Alias=Observer> judges my valor. <Alias=Dungeon> is a barrow northwest of Whiterun.
I successfully retrieved a fragment of Wuuthrad, the Blade of Ysgramor, to earn my place in the Companions.

quests.name: Brotherhood
journal: <Alias=Questgiver> says that the Companions have been waiting for my return. I'm supposed to follow <Alias.PronounObj=Questgiver>.
I have been inducted as a full member of the Companions.

quests.name: The Silver Hand
journal: Aela and Skjor want to speak to me about some kind of special mission for the Companions.
Skjor and Aela say they have some sort of special assignment for me. I'm supposed to meet them underneath the Skyforge tonight.
I have ascended to the Circle which leads the Companions, and now share their blood as a werewolf. To celebrate my new status, Skjor and Aela have invited me to attack a Silver Hand camp nearby.

I have ascended to the Circle which leads the Companions, and now share their blood as a werewolf. Aela led me to a Silver Hand stronghold where Skjor fell in battle. She has enlisted me on her quest for revenge.

quests.name: Blood's Honor
journal: Kodlak Whitemane has caught wind of my secret missions with Aela and has asked to speak with me.
As part of his quest to cure his lycanthropy, Kodlak Whitemane has sent me to kill the Glenmoril Witches and bring back their heads.
I killed the Glenmoril Witches at the behest of Kodlak Whitemane, but he was killed by the Silver Hand before I could return.

quests.name: Purity of Revenge
journal: Vilkas has come with me to avenge the death of Kodlak by wiping out the Silver Hand.
Vilkas and I avenged Kodlak's death by bringing ruin to the Silver Hand.

quests.name: Glory of the Dead
journal: I should attend the funeral of Kodlak Whitemane, the late Harbinger of the Companions.
Eorlund needs the fragments of Wuuthrad to prepare them for remounting in Jorrvaskr.
As a member of the Circle, I need to convene in the Underforge to determine the next steps for the Companions following the death of Kodlak Whitemane.
The Companions believe there is a way to cleanse Kodlak's soul of the taint of the beast. We're going to the ancient Tomb of Ysgramor to perform the ceremony.
I helped grant Kodlak Whitemane the glory of Sovngarde, and took his place as Harbinger of the Companions.
objectives: Give the fragments of Wuuthrad to Eorlund
Give the final fragment to Eorlund
Go to Ysgramor's Tomb with the Circle

quests.name: Animal Extermination
journal: I've been tasked to clear the <Alias=Beast> out of <Alias=BeastVictim>'s home in <Alias=VictimHometown>.
I've cleared the <Alias=Beast> out of <Alias=BeastVictim>'s home in <Alias=VictimHometown>.

quests.name: Animal Extermination
journal: I've been asked to take care of a <Alias=BeastBoss> lair in <Alias=DenHold>.
I cleared a <Alias=BeastBoss> lair in <Alias=DenHold>.

quests.name: Animal Pelt Collection
journal: I need to find <Global=CR03TotalPeltsNeeded> <Alias=SamplePelt>s for the Companions.
I found <Global=CR03TotalPeltsNeeded> <Alias=SamplePelt>s for the Companions.

quests.name: Hired Muscle
journal: <Alias=Brute> has been causing trouble for someone around <Alias=BruteTown>. I need to rough <Alias.PronounObj=Brute> up to remind <Alias.PronounObj=Brute> of <Alias.PronounPosObj=Brute> obligations.
<Alias=Brute> won't be causing as much trouble for <Alias=BruteTown>.
I got carried away and killed <Alias=Brute>.
<Alias=Brute> was killed, through no fault of my own.

quests.name: Trouble in Skyrim
journal: A group of bandits has been causing trouble in <Alias=LocationHold>. I've been asked to clear out <Alias=Location>.
A group of draugr has been causing trouble in <Alias=LocationHold>. I've been asked to clear out <Alias=Location>.
A group of Falmer has been causing trouble in <Alias=LocationHold>. I've been asked to clear out <Alias=Location>.
A group of the Forsworn has been causing trouble in <Alias=LocationHold>. I've been asked to clear out <Alias=Location>.
A group of giants has been causing trouble in <Alias=LocationHold>. I've been asked to clear out <Alias=Location>.
A group of hagravens has been causing trouble in <Alias=LocationHold>. I've been asked to clear out <Alias=Location>.
A group of spriggans has been causing trouble in <Alias=LocationHold>. I've been asked to clear out <Alias=Location>.
A group of vampires has been causing trouble in <Alias=LocationHold>. I've been asked to clear out <Alias=Location>.
A group of warlocks has been causing trouble in <Alias=LocationHold>. I've been asked to clear out <Alias=Location>.
I cleared out <Alias=Location>, so <Alias=LocationHold> is now a bit safer.

quests.name: Family Heirloom
journal: A family in <Alias=LocationHold> had a valuable stolen. They believe the culprits took it to <Alias=Location>, and I'm to retrieve it for them.
I recovered a stolen <Alias=Gewgaw> from <Alias=Location> for a noble family in <Alias=LocationHold>.

quests.name: Escaped Criminal
journal: There is an escaped criminal wandering <Alias=LocationHold>. I'm supposed to track <Alias.PronounObj=Criminal> down and kill <Alias.PronounObj=Criminal>.
I killed an escaped criminal in <Alias=LocationHold>.

quests.name: Rescue Mission
journal: <Alias=Victim> has been kidnapped and taken to <Alias=Lair>. I need to get <Alias.PronounObj=Victim> back to <Alias=VictimHome>.
I rescued <Alias=Victim> from <Alias=Lair> and escorted <Alias.PronounObj=Victim> back to <Alias=VictimHome>.
I found <Alias=Victim> in <Alias=Lair> but <Alias.Pronoun=Victim> died.

quests.name: Striking the Heart
journal: We've heard rumors of a Silver Hand lieutenant camped at <Alias=Camp>. With <Alias.PronounObj=CampBoss> dead, their forces should weaken.
I killed the Silver Hand leader at <Alias=Camp>.

quests.name: Stealing Plans
journal: We've heard rumors of a Silver Hand lieutenant camped at <Alias=Camp>. If I can steal their plans, we could track down their chief hideout.
I stole Silver Hand documents from <Alias=Camp>.

quests.name: Retrieval
journal: Aela has heard that the Silver Hand are holding a fragment of Wuuthrad at <Alias=Camp>. I'm going to retrieve it.
I retrieved a fragment of Wuuthrad from <Alias=Camp>.

quests.name: Totems of Hircine
journal: Aela has tracked one of the Totems of Hircine to <Alias=Dungeon>, and has come with me to retrieve it.
Aela and I retrieved a Totem of Hircine from <Alias=Dungeon>.
objectives: Take the Totem to the Underforge

quests.name: Purity
journal: <Alias=Questgiver> wants to be cured of lycanthropy, and has asked me to help him. We must take a Glenmoril Witch's head to the Tomb of Ysgramor to perform the same ceremony which cured Kodlak.
<Alias=Questgiver> wants to be cured of lycanthropy, and has asked me to help him. We must take a Glenmoril Witch's head to the Tomb of Ysgramor to perform the same ceremony which cured Kodlak.
I helped <Alias=Questgiver> cure himself of lycanthropy.

quests.name: Dragon Seekers
journal: <Alias=Questgiver> has heard the rumors of dragons and wants to defeat one for himself. I'm going to accompany him to <Alias=Den> to slay the beast there.
<Alias=Questgiver> and I killed a dragon at <Alias=Den>.

lines.name: The College of Winterhold
lines.begins: I've found the College of Winterhold, where mages study the arcane arts in Skyrim. If I want to learn more about magic, I'll need to join their ranks.
lines.start: Pass Faralda's test at the College bridge in Winterhold: cast one of the spells she asks for. After The Way of the Voice a Shout also gets you in. Or take the College start.

quests.name: First Lessons
journal: I've found the College of Winterhold, where mages study the arcane arts in Skyrim. If I want to learn more about magic, I'll need to join their ranks.
In order to join the College of Winterhold, I need to show I'm capable of simple magic by casting a Magelight spell.
In order to join the College of Winterhold, I need to show I'm capable of simple magic by summoning a flame atronach.
In order to join the College of Winterhold, I need to show I'm capable of simple magic by casting a Firebolt spell.
In order to join the College of Winterhold, I need to show I'm capable of simple magic by casting a Fear spell.
In order to join the College of Winterhold, I need to show I'm capable of simple magic by casting Healing Hands on Faralda at the entrance to the College.
I've been allowed to join the College of Winterhold, and need to find Mirabelle Ervine for a tour of the grounds.
I have joined the College of Winterhold. Mirabelle Ervine has agreed to show me around in order to become familiar with the grounds.
I have joined the College of Winterhold, and after a tour of the grounds need to find Tolfdir, who looks after the new apprentices.
After joining the College of Winterhold and speaking with Tolfdir, I've learned a bit about wards and will be accompanying some of the others on an expedition.

quests.name: Under Saarthal
journal: Tolfdir has decided to take us to investigate the ruins of Saarthal to explore the more practical uses of magic.
Tolfdir has asked the Apprentices to meet him at Saarthal, the site of an ongoing excavation by the College.
In the College excavation at Saarthal, I've been asked to assist Arniel Gane with his work uncovering the ruins.
I've been asked to assist Arniel Gane in his work at the excavation in Saarthal by collecting enchanted objects scattered around the ruins.

While helping in the excavation in Saarthal by gathering enchanted items, I somehow triggered some sort of trap. It has revealed an unexplored section of the ruins, and Tolfdir would like me to follow him further in.
While exploring the excavation in Saarthal, I somehow triggered some sort of trap. It has revealed an unexplored section of the ruins, and Tolfdir would like me to follow him further in.

While following Tolfdir through an unexplored section of Saarthal, a vision from the Psijic Order has suggested that something has been set in motion by the exploration of Saarthal. Tolfdir should be warned.

While in an unexplored area of Saarthal, I received a vision from someone in the Psijic Order saying there's something dangerous in Saarthal. Despite this, Tolfdir wishes to forge ahead and has asked that I follow him.

During an expedition to Saarthal, I uncovered a new section of the ruins, and was warned by a vision from someone in the Psijic Order of danger within. Despite this, Tolfdir and I have explored further and found a strange orb buried deep within Saarthal. Tolfdir has asked that I take news of the discovery to the Arch-Mage.
I've delivered word to the Arch-Mage that something interesting was found deep within Saarthal.
objectives: Use the Saarthal Amulet to escape the trap

quests.name: Hitting the Books
journal: With Tolfdir still occupied in Saarthal, I need to speak to Mirabelle Ervine to find out about researching the discovery in Saarthal.
Since Tolfdir is not available, I've been asked by Savos Aren to look into information on the object we found in Saarthal by talking to Urag gro-Shub in the Arcanaeum.

I've been asked to find more information on the object found in Saarthal. Urag suggested that useful books may have been stolen from the Arcanaeum by Orthorn, a former apprentice at the College. His last known location was Fellglow Keep.

In attempting to track down books that may have information about Saarthal, I've been exploring Fellglow Keep and have located Orthorn, the former apprentice who stole the books in the first place. He's now a prisoner, and has begged me to free him.
I've freed Orthorn from Fellglow Keep, and he has offered to help me find the books I'm looking for.

I was asked to find books that may have information about the object discovered in Saarthal, and traveled to Fellglow Keep to retrieve them from Orthorn, a former apprentice at the College. I've found the books and now need to see them returned to the College.
I've returned to the College with the books from Fellglow Keep. One of the books, "Night of Tears," has some information about Saarthal that Urag found very interesting.

quests.name: Good Intentions
journal: Urag has asked me to mention the Night of Tears book to Tolfdir.
I've mentioned the Night of Tears book to Tolfdir, who seems distracted by the orb from Saarthal, and has some additional thoughts about it.
While discussing the Saarthal orb with Tolfdir, Ancano interrupted and insisted I follow him.
Ancano interrupted my conversation with Tolfdir to insist that I speak with someone claiming to be from the Psijic Order, who is waiting in the Arch-Mage's quarters in the College.

I've been led to the Arch-Mage's quarters by Ancano, who was insistent that I speak to someone claiming to be from the Psijic Order. The monk, named Quaranir, has informed me that the "Eye of Magnus" is dangerous and that to learn how to deal with it, I need to speak with the Augur of Dunlain within the College. I should ask my fellow members where to find him.

I've been led to the Arch-Mage's quarters by Ancano, who was insistent that I speak to someone claiming to be from the Psijic Order. The monk, named Quaranir, has informed me that the "Eye of Magnus" is dangerous and that to learn how to deal with it, I need to speak with the Augur of Dunlain within the College. He can be found in the Midden, beneath the College.

After speaking with Quaranir from the Psijic Order and being warned of the danger of keeping the Eye of Magnus at the College, I sought out and talked to the Augur of Dunlain, who lives in the Midden underneath the College. The Augur told me that I'll need to find the Staff of Magnus, and to give that information to my superiors immediately.

After speaking privately with a monk from the Psijic Order, I have been warned that the "Eye of Magnus" is potentially dangerous and must be dealt with. After consulting with the Augur of Dunlain beneath the College, I have brought word to the Arch-Mage that the Staff of Magnus needs to be located.

quests.name: Containment
journal: Ancano has done something to the Eye of Magnus, causing the orb to release incredible amounts of energy, and possibly putting the area in danger. I need to find the Arch-Mage and make sure he's safe.

Ancano has done something to the Eye of Magnus, causing the orb to release incredible amounts of energy, damaging the College and killing the Arch-Mage. The town of Winterhold may be affected as well, and needs to be secured.
Winterhold now appears to be safe from the creatures attacking it. Mirabelle needs to be informed of what's going on.
The town of Winterhold has been secured for now, but the Eye of Magnus cannot be reached and continues to jeopardize the College.
objectives: Assess the damage to the Great Hall

quests.name: Revealing the Unseen
journal: I've been asked to speak with Mirabelle Ervine to follow up on the Staff of Magnus.

Mirabelle has told me that members of the Synod recently visited the College, mentioning the Staff of Magnus. They were last known to be heading towards Mzulft; they may know more about where to find the staff.

At Mirabelle's suggestion, I entered the ruins of Mzulft searching for the Synod researchers. I found one man who died, and suggested that more people may be inside at something called the Oculory. I should head further into the ruins to see what's going on.

At Mirabelle's suggestion, I entered the ruins of Mzulft searching for the Synod researchers. I found Paratus Decimius, who appears to be the only surviving member of the Synod expedition, and who has insisted that a "focusing crystal" is necessary to finish his experiment but was stolen by the Falmer.

Exploring Mzulft while looking for information about the Staff of Magnus, I've encountered Paratus Decimius, the sole surviving member of a Synod expedition. I've found the focusing crystal he needs to finish his experiment, and should return it to him.
Paratus Decimius may know the location of the Staff of Magnus, but has asked for my help in completing an experiment in Mzulft. I need to follow him to the top of the ruins.

Paratus Decimius may know the location of the Staff of Magnus, but has asked for my help in completing an experiment in Mzulft. I need to use magic to attenuate Paratus' focusing crystal, and then manipulate the dwarven machinery to line up the beams of light.

Traveling to Mzulft in search of the Synod, I found Paratus Decimius who helped me learn that the Staff of Magnus is located in Labyrinthian. This information needs to get back to Savos Aren at the College immediately.

After traveling to Mzulft and learning that the Staff of Magnus is located within Labyrinthian, I returned to the College to give the news to Arch-Mage Aren. Aren, however, is more concerned with the Eye of Magnus at the moment, since Ancano has locked himself in the Hall of the Elements with it. I need to help the Arch-Mage reach him at once.
After finding the Synod in Mzulft, I learned that the Staff of Magnus can be found in Labyrinthian, and brought this news to the Arch-Mage.
objectives: Place the Crystal into the Oculory

quests.name: The Staff of Magnus
journal: I need to retrieve the Staff of Magnus from within Labyrinthian and return with it to the College of Winterhold. Only the staff will help me put an end to Ancano's abuse of the Eye of Magnus.
I have recovered the Staff of Magnus, and need to get it back to the College at once.
I have recovered the Staff of Magnus.
objectives: Find a way out of Labrynthian

quests.name: The Eye of Magnus
journal: The Staff of Magnus has been recovered, and so it's time to assault the College of Winterhold and strike down Ancano.
Ancano has been defeated, but there's still a tremendous amount of energy coming out of the Eye of Magnus. I need to talk to Tolfdir about what to do next.

Ancano has been defeated. The Psijic Monks have removed the Eye of Magnus from the College, saying that the world is not ready for such a thing. With the crisis over, I have been named the new Arch-Mage of the College.
objectives: Use the Staff of Magnus to enter the College of Winterhold
Reach the Hall of the Elements

quests.name: Shalidor's Insights
journal: Urag gro-Shub is looking for writings by the Arch-Mage Shalidor, so that he can translate them into something useful for the College. He's asked that I attempt to find another copy for him.
I've managed to find the writings of the Arch-Mage Shalidor that Urag gro-Shub was looking for. I should take them to him at the Arcanaeum so that he can translate them.

Urag gro-Shub asked me to bring him more of the writings of the Arch-Mage Shalidor. I was able to find another copy, and have brought it to him. He will translate it as soon as he's able, and then we'll see what we can learn from it.

quests.name: Aftershock
journal: There have been reports of some sort of magical anomaly in Skyrim. Tolfdir fears it is a side effect of Ancano's meddling with the Eye of Magnus, and has asked that I look into it. He suggested I take the Staff of Magnus with me, just in case.
I have found and shut down the magical anomaly Tolfdir was worried about. I should return to him and let him know it's been dealt with.
A magical anomaly was reported in Skyrim; it seems to have been connected to Ancano's meddling with the Eye of Magnus. I successfully shut it down before it could become a greater problem.

quests.name: Brelyna's Practice
journal: Brelyna Maryon has asked me to act as a test subject while she practices some new spells. Her first attempt ended badly, but she has assured me that if I let her try one more time, it will work out. I should find her once her spell has worn off.
After two attempts at helping Brelyna with trying out new spells, she has agreed that perhaps she should work a bit more before trying anything else.
objectives: Wait for Brelyna's spell to wear off

quests.name: J'zargo's Experiment
journal: J'zargo has asked for help with a project he's been working on. I'm supposed to test out Flame Cloak scrolls he made, and report back to him when I've tried them out on several undead creatures.
I've informed J'zargo that the Flame Cloak scrolls he created don't work exactly as he intended. I doubt he'll be asking for additional help.
I told J'zargo that I ran out of the scrolls he'd given me, and he no longer wants my help.
objectives: Test J'zargo's Flame Cloak spell on the undead (<Global=MGRJ1Test>/<Global=MGRJ1Total>)

quests.name: Onmund's Request
journal: Onmund has asked me to help him get an amulet with sentimental value back from Enthir.

Enthir insists that Onmund sold him the amulet in question, and he will not go back on a trade. If, however, I can recover a particular staff for Enthir, he'll give me the amulet. I'll need to search <Alias=StaffLocation> for the staff.
I have found the staff that Enthir wanted, and need to deliver it to him so that he'll exchange it for Onmund's amulet.
Enthir agreed to return Onmund's amulet to him, and has given it to me. I need to make sure it gets back to Onmund.
Onmund is grateful that I was able to deal with Enthir and return his amulet.

quests.name: Arniel's Endeavor
journal: Arniel Gane has asked for help with a special project he's working on. Although he won't tell me what they're for, he wants me to bring him a number of Dwarven Cogs.
I've given Arniel Gane the Dwarven cogs he asked for, and he was quite grateful. He's suggested that there may be more I can help with in the future.
objectives: Deliver ten cogs to Arniel Gane

quests.name: Arniel's Endeavor
journal: Arniel has asked for more help with his project, though this time the request is very different. Enthir is apparently refusing to follow through on a trade; something Arniel needs for his work. He's asked that I go speak with Enthir on his behalf.

Arniel asked me to deal with Enthir, who was supposedly refusing to complete a business arrangement. Enthir insists that he hasn't been paid, but will consider the deal done if I acquire a staff for him from <Alias=Dungeon>.

I've managed to complete the trade agreement between Enthir and Arniel, and have the object Arniel was interested in. It's some sort of soul gem, though Enthir believes it to be useless. I should deliver it to Arniel.
I've successfully completed a deal between Enthir and Arniel that is somehow related to Arniel's special project. He claims to be making progress, though I have no idea what that means.

quests.name: Arniel's Endeavor
journal: Arniel has finally revealed to me that his secret project deals with the disappearance of the dwarves, though he hasn't been clear about how his work relates to it. He's given me a warped soul gem, and asked me to find several Dwarven convectors in the various ruins around Skyrim. I'm supposed to place the gem inside a convector, and then heat it using a spell Arniel has taught me. When I've done this several times, I should return the gem to Arniel.

I've successfully altered Arniel's warped soul gem, and should return it to him. It is somehow critical to his project regarding the disappearance of the dwarves; perhaps he'll explain exactly what he's up to.

I've once again helped Arniel with his secret, and very vague, project relating to the dwarves. He implied that he's waiting for something else, and then finally maybe I'll see what this is all about.
objectives: Place the warped soul gem into a Convector
Place the warped soul gem into another Convector
Place the warped soul gem into a final Convector
Deliver the soul gem to Arniel

quests.name: Arniel's Endeavor
journal: Arniel has once again asked me to speak to Enthir, who was supposed to deliver something else relating to Arniel's project.

Arniel was convinced that Enthir was refusing to complete the trade the two of them had arranged, but it turns out that this time Enthir never received the item in question. The courier bringing the item never arrived. If I want to help Arniel finish his work, I'll need to find the courier myself.

Arniel was distraught over being unable to finish his project, believing that Enthir was refusing to complete a trade the two of them had agreed upon. Instead, the courier that was supposed to deliver the item never arrived. I've tracked him down (sadly he did not survive) and have the package Arniel wanted. I should make sure it gets to Arniel as soon as possible.

I've helped Arniel with the final piece of his project, by tracking down a missing courier who was supposed to be delivering an item from Morrowind. That item is Keening, a dwarven dagger that Arniel claims is very important. With it, he says he's able to finish his experiment and has asked that I observe what happens.
Arniel's experiment is over, but I'm not entirely sure what has happened. He has vanished, leaving behind the dagger Keening. I may never know whether he succeeded in his work.

quests.name: Rejoining the College
journal: I've been suspended from the College for my actions. I should speak with Tolfdir about having it lifted.
I've been suspended from the College for my actions, and will need to pay Tolfdir 250 gold in order to have it lifted.
I've been suspended from the College for my actions, and will need to pay Tolfdir 500 gold in order to have it lifted.
I've been suspended from the College for my actions, and will need to pay Tolfdir 1000 gold in order to have it lifted.
I have paid Tolfdir and my suspension from the College has been lifted.
objectives: Give Tolfdir 250 gold to lift your suspension
Pay Tolfidr 500 gold to lift your suspension
Pay Tolfidr 1000 gold to lift your suspension

quests.name: Destruction Ritual Spell
journal: I've asked Faralda about additional training in Destruction. She gave me a book called "Power of the Elements" and hinted that it could lead me to new, powerful spells. I should examine the book to see what I can learn.
I have followed the clues in Power of the Elements, allowing me to finish the book.
objectives: Complete the book Powers of the Elements

quests.name: Illusion Ritual Spell
journal: Drevis Neloren has told me that there are books hidden throughout the College of Winterhold that contain information about powerful Illusion spells. I need to use the spell he's given me, Vision of the Tenth Eye, to find them.
I have found the Master Illusion texts hidden throughout the College and delivered them to Drevis Neloren. In return, he has given me one of the Master Illusion spells.
objectives: Bring the four Master Illusion texts to Drevis Neloren

quests.name: Conjuration Ritual Spell
journal: Phinis Gestor has told me that in order to inscribe powerful Conjuration spells, he'll need a sigil stone from an Oblivion gate. To get one, I'll need to summon an unbound dremora and bend it to my will.
Phinis Gestor requires a sigil stone to inscribe powerful Conjuration spells for me. I subdued an unbound dremora and had it retrieve one for me, which I should now take to Phinis.

I have subdued an unbound dremora and had him retrieve a sigil stone for me, which Phinis Gestor has used to inscribe the Master Conjuration spells. In exchange for doing this, he has given me the first of the spells.
objectives: Summon and subdue an Unbound Dremora

quests.name: Restoration Ritual Spell
journal: I've asked Colette about additional training in Restoration. She suggested there are spells I don't yet know, but that the Augur down in the Midden is the keeper of that knowledge and I'd have to gain his approval before I can learn them.
I've passed the Augur's test, and have been granted the Bane of the Undead spell.

quests.name: Alteration Ritual Spell
journal: Tolfdir is working on a new Master Alteration spell, and has asked for my help. He wants to study dragon heartscales, but in order to collect them I'll first need to obtain a special dagger known as Kahvozein's Fang.
At Tolfdir's request, I've used Kahvozein's Fang to collect dragon heartscales. Hopefully this will help him to create the new Alteration spell he's been working on.
I've assisted Tolfdir in his research by collecting dragon heartscales, which he needed to figure out a new Alteration spell. As a reward for helping him, he's given me the first copy of the tome.
objectives: Use Kahvozein's Fang to collect Dragon Heartscales
Bring the Dragon Heartscales to Tolfdir

quests.name: Rapture of the Deep
journal: After learning the Waterbreathing spell from Tolfdir, I have been instructed to talk to Arniel Gane.
I should talk to Arniel Gane when ready to leave. He wants me to put the Waterbreathing spell to the test north of the College.
I should follow Arniel Gane. He's prepared a test for me.
Arniel Gane has asked me to cast Waterbreathing and dive to find a crystal for him in the middle of some sunken ruins.
I should return the crystal to Arniel Gane.
I should talk to Tolfdir and show him the crystal I found in the sunken ruins.
Tolfdir taught me a new alteration spell and I tested it by diving into a sunken temple for Arniel Gane.
objectives: Speak with Arniel Gane when ready to depart

quests.name: College Curriculum
journal: As a new member of the College of Winterhold, I'm expected to learn more about magic. I should talk to Tolfdir for my next lesson.
Tolfdir asked me to study a tome of Waterbreathing.
I should find Arniel Gane, he will help me put my waterbreathing spell to the test.
I've completed Tolfdir's lesson, I should check with the other scholars for more lessons.
I should continue learning magic from the scholars at the College of Winterhold. I should ask Tolfdir for help if I can't seem to find them.
I should continue learning magic from the scholars at the College of Winterhold. I should ask Tolfdir for help if I can't seem to find them.
I should continue learning magic from the scholars at the College of Winterhold. I should ask Tolfdir for help if I can't seem to find them.
I should continue learning magic from the scholars at the College of Winterhold. I should ask Tolfdir for help if I can't seem to find them.
I should continue learning magic from the scholars at the College of Winterhold. I should ask Tolfdir for help if I can't seem to find them.
I've completed all of the initial lessons from the College's scholars. I should check with Tolfdir, perhaps he has another lesson for me...

After joining the College, I was introduced to each of the scholars and their respectives Schools of Magic. They taught me new spells, gave me lessons in their fields of expertise and helped me put my skills to the test.
objectives: Talk to Tolfdir for more lessons
Learn Waterbreathing and talk to Tolfdir
Complete lessons for all college scholars (1/7)
Complete lessons for all college scholars (2/7)
Complete lessons for all college scholars (3/7)
Complete lessons for all college scholars (4/7)
Complete lessons for all college scholars (5/7)
Complete lessons for all college scholars (6/7)

quests.name: I Choose You, Familiar
journal: After meeting Phinis, the Conjuration scholar, I've been asked to study the spell "Conjure Familiar". Once I've mastered this spell, I should return to Phinis for the next part of the lesson.
Phinis, the Conjuration scholar, has asked me to follow him to put my Conjuration skills to the test.
Phinis has asked me to cast a familiar near him, to test my knowledge in Conjuration.
Phinis' Atronach destroyed my familiar almost instantly. No surprises there. Not sure what I am to take from this lesson. I should talk to him.

Phinis taught me that all conjuration spells serve a purpose. He argued that familiars are especially useful as a distraction against most enemies - They are relatively easy to cast and can give you a window of time to retreat to safety.
I decided I didn't have time or interest in learning about Conjuration, so I declined to participate in Phinis' lesson. Also, his voice irritates me.
objectives: Learn Conjure Familiar and Talk to Phinis

quests.name: A Test of Ice and Fire
journal: Faralda has taught me about the different elements of the school of Destruction magic. She's given me a spell tome of Firebolt I should study.
Faralda has asked me to put my Firebolt spell to the test. She has the perfect enemy to test the spell on.
I've taken care of the Ice Wraith for Faralda. I should check back with her to finish the lesson.
Faralda taught me about Destruction and how I should always choose the right element against certain types of enemies.
Fire, Ice, Shock... Too elemental for my taste. Why do all mages always have to focus on this specific School of Magic? Sorry Faralda, but I'm not your average mage, I won't be taking your class.
objectives: Learn the spell and talk to Faralda

quests.name: Enchanted To Meet You
journal: Sergius seems very busy, but he's offered to help me with enchanting. He's given me a note where the client orders are specified, but first I must find an enchanting table...

Sergius seemed very busy. I've offered to help him out with his Enchanting duties, as perhaps I can learn something in the process. He's given me a note where the client orders are described. First step will be disenchanting the old dagger he gave me, so I can learn its effects.

Sergius seemed very busy. I've offered to help him out with his Enchanting duties, as perhaps I can learn something in the process. It seems I need a filled gem to apply the enchantment the client wants.

Sergius seemed very busy. I've offered to help him out with his Enchanting duties, as perhaps I can learn something in the process. It seems I have a filled gem and I already know the enchantment the client wants, so I just need to apply it to the sword now.
I should show Sergius the enchantment, see if it's ready to be delivered.
Sergius has asked me to personally deliver the enchanted sword to the client. I should read the note he gave me to find out where this client is.
Sergius has asked me to personally deliver the enchanted sword to the client. I must find someone called Gretilde in Stonehills.
It turns out "the client" had nothing to do with the order. I should investigate before I leave Stonehills.

It turns out the client's daughter, Adara, sent the order to the College in the hopes of talking to a member of the College. She wants to be a mage and displays some aptitude already. I should talk to her.

It turns out the client's daughter, Adara, sent the order to the College in the hopes of talking to a member of the College. She wants to be a mage and displays some aptitude already. I'm not sure what to think, best talk to her mother.
Adara's mother has agreed to let her join the College of Winterhold. I'm to escort her and keep her safe until we get there.
Faralda won't let Adara join until she sees her magical aptitudes for herself. I should talk to the young mage.
That was quite the unusual delivery. I should talk to Sergius and explain what has happened.

Sergius taught me the basics of Enchanting and had work on my own enchantment.Things took a strange turn when I met a young mage called Adara while delivering the item. Sergius didn't care much for this though. It seems enchanting is quite the profitable business as it's keeping him quite busy. Now, that's an interesting lesson!
I refused to help Sergius with his enchanting, as he was clearly in a mood and I have no time to deal with people like him. Good riddance, I say.

quests.name: Back-Stabbing Rodents
journal: Drevis has taught me about different uses Illusion spells can have. He's given me a spell tome I should study.
Drevis has asked me to put my new illusion spell to the test by attacking a near-by den of Skeevers. With the spell, I should be able to make them fight each other.
I've taken care of the skeevers for Drevis. I should check back with him to finish the lesson.
Drevis taught me about Illusion and how it can influence the minds of my enemies.
I refused to take Drevis' class on Illusion. That mage didn't seem he knew what he was doing anyway.
objectives: Learn the spell and talk to Drevis
Use the spell on the skeevers and deal with them

quests.name: Reading Comprehension 101
journal: The College's librarian, Urag gro-Shub, gave me a book to read. I should talk to him after reading the book.
I failed Urag gro-Shub's test. I should talk him into giving me another try.
I passed Urag gro-Shub test, where he taught me about the importance of reviewing the credibility of sources.
I passed Urag gro-Shub test, where he taught me about the importance of reviewing the credibility of sources.
I refused take the test from the College of Winterhold's librarian, Urag gro-Shub. I've got more important things to do than to sit around wasting time with books.
objectives: Read Olaf and the Dragon and talk to Urag gro-Shub
Actually read the book and try again

quests.name: None Escape The Light
journal: Colette has taught me about restoration being a powerful tool against undead. She's given me a spell book to study.
Colette has taught me that Restoration can be a powerful tool against undead. I should put my knowledge to the test by helping Tolfdir.
It seems draugr have taken over the Midden. I've offered to take care of them by using my restoration skills. I should use Turn Lesser Undead on one of the draugr, then deal with them.
I should talk to Colette and tell her how things went with the draugr in the Midden.
I learned about Restoration being a useful and valid school of magic against the undead.
I refused learning about Restoration from Colette. It's not a real School of Magic anyway.
objectives: Learn the spell and talk to Colette
Deal with the Draugr in the Midden

quests.name: Out of Balance
journal: Drevis Neloren has asked for my help in purifying the focus points for magical energy around the College. I've been given special Tuning gloves that I'll need to wear in order to cleanse the focal points. Drevis has warned that there may be side-effects to performing this task.
I've finished cleansing the focal points around the College, and should take the gloves back to Drevis.
I've successfully helped Drevis by cleansing the focal points around the College.
objectives: Cleanse the focal points for magical energies around the College

quests.name: Enchanting Pick-Up
journal: Sergius Turrianus needs an item picked up from <Alias.ShortName=Client> in <Alias=ClientLocation> and returned to him so that he can enchant it.
I've received the item from <Alias.ShortName=Client> and need to deliver it to Sergius at the College so he can enchant it.
I've finished the task that Sergius gave me, and have successfully picked up and delivered the item from <Alias.ShortName=Client> so that it can be enchanted.
objectives: Go to <Alias.ShortName=Client> in <Alias=ClientLocation> and pick up the item
Return the item to Sergius Turrianus

quests.name: Restocking Soul Gems
journal: Sergius has asked for my help in restocking soul gems.
I've delivered the soul gems that Sergius requested.

quests.name: Filling Soul Gems
objectives: Bring a Filled Grand Soul Gem to Sergius Turrianus

quests.name: Fetch me that Book!
objectives: Return the book to Urag gro-Shub

quests.name: Fetch me that Book!
objectives: Return the book to Urag gro-Shub

quests.name: Research Thief
objectives: Talk to Nirya to see what she's plotting
Help Nirya steal the notes or tell Faralda the plot
Bring the notes to Nirya or tell Faralda the plot

lines.name: The Thieves Guild
lines.begins: Brynjolf in Riften seems to be involved in some nefarious activities and has convinced me to take part in one of his schemes.
lines.start: Brynjolf comes up to you in Riften's market, between 8 in the morning and 8 at night.

quests.name: A Chance Arrangement
journal: Brynjolf in Riften seems to be involved in some nefarious activities and has convinced me to take part in one of his schemes.
Brynjolf's scheme in Riften has ended and the promise of more coin has been made. This appears to be the beginning of profitable friendship.

quests.name: Taking Care of Business
journal: Brynjolf has promised me more work if I'm able to locate him at a tavern called the Ragged Flagon. Judging from the dangerous nature of its location, it seems as though he's having me perform some type of initiation, but I can't be certain.

After successfully locating the Ragged Flagon, Brynjolf has given me a new assignment. Three business owners in Riften are proving to be a thorn in his side and I'm supposed to teach them the error of their ways. I should speak to Brynjolf about these townspeople in the event that they prove to be as stubborn as I'm expecting them to be.

I've dealt with the three troublesome business owners in Riften as Brynjolf had specified. Perhaps now that I've proven my worth to Brynjolf, I can discover more about this mysterious organization that he represents.
objectives: Locate Brynjolf at the Ragged Flagon
(Optional) Use Talen-Jei to get to Keerava

quests.name: Loud and Clear
journal: Brynjolf is taking me to meet the leader of the organization he represents. He says more work and significantly more coin could be available if I join their ranks.
Thanks to Brynjolf's support, I've been welcomed into the Thieves Guild by its Guild Master, Mercer Frey. I'm eager to receive my first task and prove that his recommendation wasn't in vain.

My first task as a member of the Thieves Guild involves a honey operation located just outside of Riften called Goldenglow Estate. My actions there are in direct response to the owner's sudden silence and lack of cooperation with the Thieves Guild and Maven-Black-Briar, one of the Guild's most important clients.

I've completed my task at Goldenglow Estate and discovered the owner's sudden lack of cooperation with the Guild was leveraged by an anonymous buyer of that very same location. Why this buyer purchased Goldenglow and is showing animosity towards the Guild is a mystery for the moment.
objectives: (Optional) Speak to Vex about Goldenglow Estate
(Optional) Obtain the key to Aringoth's safe

quests.name: Dampened Spirits
journal: I've been sent to speak to Maven Black-Briar, head of the wealthiest most influential family in Riften. According to Brynjolf, she has a job of utmost importance for me and I need to follow her directions to the letter.

Maven Black-Briar has sent me to Whiterun where I am to meet with someone named Mallus Maccius. Together, our goal is to bring down one of Maven's competitors, Honningbrew Meadery and discover where he obtained the financing to take her on.

I've become a key component in a cunning plan to frame Honningbrew Meadery's owner, Sabjorn, and have him imprisoned. The first part of the scheme is to approach Sabjorn under the guise of assistance with a pest problem he's having thanks to Mallus's tinkering.

Sabjorn has provided me with poison I'm to apply to the nests deep within the tunnels under Honningbrew Meadery. As Mallus predicted, I should be able to use the very same poison to taint Sabjorn's mead as well.
The plan worked perfectly and Whiterun's Captain of the Guard was stricken with illness when he drank the poisoned mead. Sabjorn's been carted off to jail and Honningbrew Meadery is now closed.
Now that Mallus's position as the owner of Honningbrew Meadery has been secured, I need to find any information explaining how Sabjorn was able to fund this costly operation.

The information I obtained from Honningbrew Meadery points to the same anonymous buyer of Goldenglow Estate. If successful, this individual would have completely estranged Maven Black-Briar from the Guild and destroyed it economically. It's becoming painfully obvious that it's time to shed some light on our mysterious adversary before they have a chance to strike again.

quests.name: Scoundrel's Folly
journal: After the revelations at Honningbrew Meadery and Goldenglow Farm, it's time to put the pieces together and shed some light on the Thieves Guild's anonymous adversary.

Mercer Frey has pointed to Solitude as my next destination. I'm to meet up with an old Argonian contact for the Guild named Gulum-Ei. It's hoped he'll be able to identify the Thieves Guild's anonymous adversary.

As predicted by Mercer Frey, Gulum-Ei proved to be quite stubborn and refused to reveal any useful information. I have no choice but to shadow him during his daily routine and discover if he's up to anything that could be used as influence to make him divulge the truth.

Thanks to Gulum-Ei's confession, a former member of the Thieves Guild named Karliah has been identified as its anonymous adversary. Worse still, I've discovered that she was the same Dunmer who murdered Gallus, the Guild's previous Guild Master and who's apparently resurfaced after all these years to do the same to Mercer Frey.

quests.name: Speaking With Silence
journal: I'm on my way to meet Mercer Frey at the ruins of Snow Veil Sanctum, Karliah's last known location. Together, Mercer and I intend to hunt her down and make her pay for Gallus' murder.

The tables have unexpectedly turned, and Mercer Frey has been revealed as Gallus' killer. I now find myself in Karliah's care after Mercer tried to murder me, claiming I'd outlasted my usefulness by witnessing their conversation. I've also discovered that Mercer, Gallus, and Karliah were members of some sort of group calling themselves "The Nightingales" - guardians in service to the goddess Nocturnal. What they're protecting or what this has to do with the Guild is still a mystery to me.
objectives: Meet Mercer Frey outside Snow Veil Sanctum

quests.name: Hard Answers
journal: Karliah believes the only proof that could expose Mercer's treachery can be found within the pages of Gallus' journal which she recovered from Snow Veil Sanctum. Unfortunately, the journal is written in some sort of code that needs to be deciphered. Our only hope is Enthir, one of Karliah and Gallus' former acquaintances who is a wizard at the College of Winterhold.

Enthir has informed me that Gallus' journal is written in Falmer. He's directed me to seek out Calcelmo, the court wizard in Markarth who is the foremost authority on them in hopes of obtaining a translation.

Calcelmo has proven to be extremely stubborn and refuses to allow me access to his materials regarding the Falmer language. I'm left with little choice other than taking matters into my own hands and stealing his notes.

Calcelmo's "notes" on the Falmer language are actually derived from a massive stone slab in his tower! It will be impossible to bring this item to Enthir to have him translate Gallus' journal. I'll have to discover a way to make the information more portable.

After Enthir successfully translated Gallus' journal, I've discovered that Mercer's motivations transcended simple greed or murder. As a member of the Nightingales, Mercer was tasked with guarding a place called the Twilight Sepulcher, the Temple of Nocturnal. According to Gallus, he defiled the temple and betrayed the Thieves Guild. Karliah insists we bring this information to Brynjolf immediately.
objectives: (Optional) Obtain the key to Calcelmo's Museum
Duplicate the writing on Calcelmo's Stone

quests.name: The Pursuit
journal: I'm on my way back to the Ragged Flagon to meet up with Karliah. Using the information obtained from Gallus' journal as proof, I hope to convince Brynjolf of Karliah's innocence and Mercer Frey's betrayal.

Brynjolf has been convinced of Karliah's innocence and Mercer's betrayal after investigating the Guild's treasure vault and finding it empty. Of greater mystery is the fact that the vault can only be opened with two keys and is utterly impervious to lockpicking. How Mercer Frey could have breached it is a mystery to us all.
The hunt is on and I'm on my way to Riftweald Manor, Mercer Frey's estate in Riften, to locate a clue as to his current whereabouts.
I've discovered some plans in Riftweald Manor. This must be where Mercer Frey is headed. I should bring these to Brynjolf as soon as possible.

Brynjolf is convinced Mercer Frey intends to perform one final heist before departing Skyrim for good. According to the plans I discovered in Riftweald Manor, he's after the "Eyes of the Falmer," two gems of enormous value. If we have any hopes of intercepting Mercer, we need to proceed to their location immediately.
objectives: Meet Karliah at the Ragged Flagon
Shoot the mechanism to lower the ramp

quests.name: Trinity Restored
journal: Before intercepting Mercer Frey, Karliah wishes to speak to both Brynjolf and myself.

Karliah has indicated Brynjolf and I are to meet her at an old standing stone just outside the Southwest Gate of Riften. Her motivations for doing so are mysterious, but I suspect it has something to do with the Nightingales.

Karliah has informed Brynjolf and I that we're to join the elite ranks of the Nightingales and assist in reforming the trinity that was disrupted over twenty-five years ago when Mercer Frey murdered Gallus.
I've undertaken the Oath and I'm now a Nightingale, guardian of the Twilight Sepulcher and a dedicated sentinel of the goddess Nocturnal.

Karliah has finally revealed the fundamental mission of the Nightingales... the guardianship of the Skeleton Key of Nocturnal. This powerful artifact, normally kept safely within the Twilight Sepulcher, has been stolen by Mercer Frey. As a Nightingale, the duty to recover the Skeleton Key falls squarely upon my shoulders.
objectives: Meet Karliah at the standing stone

quests.name: Blindsighted
journal: I'm on my way to Irkngthand, a vast dwarven ruin that supposedly contains the legendary "Eyes of the Falmer." Karliah and Brynjolf are waiting for me within. Together we hope to stop Mercer Frey from stealing the Eyes and escaping from Skyrim with the Skeleton Key of Nocturnal.

I've entered Irkngthand, a vast dwarven ruin that supposedly contains the legendary "Eyes of the Falmer." Karliah and Brynjolf are waiting for me within. Together we hope to stop Mercer Frey from stealing the Eyes and escaping from Skyrim with the Skeleton Key of Nocturnal.

Karliah and Brynjolf have joined me in my exploration of Irkngthand, a vast dwarven ruin that supposedly contains the legendary "Eyes of the Falmer." Together we hope to stop Mercer Frey from stealing the Eyes and escaping from Skyrim with the Skeleton Key of Nocturnal.
I've finally located Mercer Frey within the ruins of Irkngthand. He seemed to be expecting us, and I'm afraid he led us here with the express purpose of eliminating the Nightingales once and for all.

Mercer Frey, betrayer of the Thieves Guild and Gallus' murderer is finally dead. Upon his death, a wave of magic issued from his body and has caused the already crumbling chamber to collapse and fill with water.
Mercer Frey is dead and I've recovered the Skeleton Key of Nocturnal from his corpse. I need to escape Irkngthand before the place collapses around me.

Safe from the dangers below, Karliah, Brynjolf, and I finally have a moment to breathe. Mercer Frey is dead, the Skeleton Key of Nocturnal is in my possession and, most importantly, the Nightingales have survived.

Karliah, Brynjolf, and I have slain Mercer Frey, escaped Irkngthand, and recovered the Skeleton Key. All that remains is returning the artifact to the Twilight Sepulcher where it belongs; a journey I must undertake alone.

quests.name: Darkness Returns
journal: With the Skeleton Key of Nocturnal safely in my possession, I'm bound for the Twilight Sepulcher to return it to its resting place.

Within the Twilight Sepulcher, I happened upon the spirit of Gallus, the Nightingale murdered by Mercer Frey. He warned me that removing the key from its resting place has corrupted the other resident Nightingale Guardian Spirits, distorting their morality and making them incredibly hostile.

I've returned the Skeleton Key to its proper resting place within the Twilight Sepulcher and encountered Nocturnal herself. As a reward for my actions, she allowed me to become a true Nightingale Agent and imbued me with the appropriate ability befitting my station.
objectives: Return the Skeleton Key to the Ebonmere

quests.name: Reparations
journal: I've been banned from the Thieves Guild for breaking one of their cardinal rules. Once everyone in the Guild calms down, I should ask Vex what she recommends I do to make reparations.
I've paid my reparations and I have been reinstated to the Thieves Guild.

quests.name: No Stone Unturned
journal: It was suggested that I show my Unusual Gem to Vex, a member of the Thieves Guild in Riften. However, I'll need to wait until I'm a full member of the Guild before she'll be able to assist me.
I've found an unusual gem which seems to exhibit magical properties. I should bring it to Vex at the Thieves Guild for an appraisal.
The unusual gem has turned out to be one of twenty-four "Stones of Barenziah." According to Vex, they have little value unless the set is complete.

Vex has revealed to me that the Crown of Barenziah is actually a paragon for the Thieves Guild. If I can recover the crown from Tolvald's Cave, she should be able to restore our paragon to its full strength.
I've brought the Crown of Barenziah back to Vex, who has restored it to its original condition where it now serves as a paragon for the Thieves Guild.
objectives: Become a full member of the Thieves Guild
Bring the Unusual Gem to Vex in the Thieves Guild

quests.name: Under New Management
journal: I've been offered the position of Guild Master of the Thieves Guild. All that remains is to attend my installation ceremony in the cistern of the Ragged Flagon.

With the ceremony complete, I've become the Guild Master of the Thieves Guild. As a benefit of my position, I've received a suit of Thieves Guild Leader's Armor, the Amulet of Articulation and the key to the Guild Master's Tribute Chest.
objectives: Speak to Brynjolf about becoming the Guild Master
Become Guild Master for the Thieves Guild
Speak to Brynjolf about being Guild Master
Retrieve your Guild Leader Armor from Tonilia

I've retrieved the <Alias=ItemToGet> from <Alias=WealthyHome> in <Alias=City>.
I've successfully completed the job and received my share of the pay.
By killing a resident at the task's location, I've failed this job and was forced to forfeit my share of the pay.
During the course of this task, I was arrested and sent to the local jail. I've therefore failed the job and was forced to forfeit my share of the pay.
Before the task could be completed, I decided to quit. I've therefore failed the job and forfeited any pay I might have received.

I've stolen <Global=TGRNGold> gold in goods from <Alias=City>.
I've successfully completed this job and been allowed to keep everything I've stolen.
During the course of this task, I was arrested and sent to the local jail. I've therefore failed the job.
