quests.name: Silver Lining
journal: Endon, a silversmith residing in Markarth, has requested assistance from the Thieves Guild.
Endon had a silver mold stolen while it was en route to Markarth. The item in question was taken by a group of bandits led by Rigel Strong-Arm and brought to their hideout at Pinewatch.
The silver mold has been returned to Endon, and the Thieves Guild can now count on him as an influential ally in Markarth.

quests.name: The Dainty Sload
journal: Erikur, a wealthy merchant residing in Solitude, has requested assistance from the Thieves Guild.

Erikur has been cheated by Volf, captain of a trading vessel named the Dainty Sload. In order to frame Volf for a crime he didn't commit, Erikur is requesting that a substance called Balmora Blue be stashed on board in the captain's footlocker.
The Balmora Blue has been stashed aboard the Dainty Sload, and the Thieves Guild can now count on Erikur as an influential ally in Solitude.

quests.name: Imitation Amnesty
journal: Olfrid Battle-Born, a wealthy Nord residing in Whiterun, has requested assistance from the Thieves Guild.

Olfrid Battle-Born has a good friend residing in Whiterun's jail who is slated for execution. In order to free him, a prisoner registry in the Steward of Whiterun's quarters must be changed and a letter stolen from the jarl's quarters in Dragonsreach.
Arn is now a free man and the Thieves Guild can now count on Olfrid Battle-Born as an influential ally in Whiterun.

quests.name: Summerset Shadows
journal: Torsten Cruel-Sea, a wealthy merchant residing in Windhelm, has requested assistance from the Thieves Guild.

Torsten Cruel-Sea's daughter Fjotli was slain and robbed of a silver locket by a Thieves Guild hailing from Summerset Isle. Calling themselves "The Summerset Shadows," they are looking into expanding their influence in Skyrim.

Torsten's daughter wasn't slain by the Summerset Shadows, but their leader, Linwe, has them robbing the dead of their valuables. Linwe and the rest of his guild have established a hideout in Uttering Hills Cave.
I've slain Linwe and obtained Fjotli's Silver Locket. This ends the presence of the Summerset Shadows in Skyrim.
The locket has been returned to Torsten Cruel-Sea, and the Thieves Guild can now count on him as an influential ally in Windhelm.

quests.name: TG00 Maul Handler
objectives: Talk to Brynjolf about joining the Thieves Guild

quests.name: Meet the Family
journal: After speaking with Delvin Mallory and Vex, I've determined that the Thieves Guild appears to be in decline but neither of them seem to agree why. I should check in with them from time-to-time and undertake some of the extra jobs they offer in order to help get the Guild back on its feet and put some coin in my pocket.
objectives: Learn more about the Thieves Guild from Vex
Learn more about the Thieves Guild from Delvin
Retrieve your Thieves Guild Armor from Tonilia

quests.name: East Empire Warehouse Dialogue and Handler
objectives: Speak to Orthas Endario about the East Empire Company's problems

quests.name: Scoundrel's Folly Post
objectives: Speak to Tonilia about exchanging a piece of armor

quests.name: No Stone Unturned Misc Handler
journal: I've found an unusual gem which seems to exhibit magical properties. I should bring it to someone knowledgeable in such goods for appraisal.
With Maul in Riften no longer speaking to me, I'm going to have to continue my search for someone who can identify my unusual gem.
objectives: Bring the Unusual Gem to an appraiser
Find someone who can identify the Unusual Gem

quests.name: The Litany of Larceny
journal: I've discovered an unusual statue of a queen bee within Goldenglow Estate. I should take it to Delvin Mallory at the Ragged Flagon to determine its true value.
I've discovered an unusual golden decanter inside Honningbrew Meadery. I should take it to Delvin Mallory at the Ragged Flagon to determine its true value.
I've discovered what appears to be a shipping map for the East Empire Company. I should take it to Delvin Mallory at the Ragged Flagon to determine its true value.
I've discovered the intricately crafted model of a sailing ship inside Snow Veil Sanctum. I should take it to Delvin Mallory at the Ragged Flagon to determine its true value.
I've discovered an curious Dwemer-constructed puzzle cube inside Calcelmo's Quarters in Markarth. I should take it to Delvin Mallory at the Ragged Flagon to determine its true value.
I've discovered the bust of a man named the Gray Fox inside Mercer Frey's House. I should take it to Delvin Mallory at the Ragged Flagon to determine its true value.
I've recovered one of the Eyes of the Falmer from Irkngthand. I should take it to Delvin Mallory at the Ragged Flagon to determine its true value.
objectives: Return the Queen Bee Statue to Delvin
Return the Honningbrew Decanter to Delvin
Return the East Empire Shipping Map to Delvin
Return the Ship Model to Delvin
Return the Dwemer Puzzle Cube to Delvin
Return the Bust of the Gray Fox to Delvin
Return the Eye of the Falmer to Delvin

quests.name: Paid in Full
objectives: Recover the Bonemold Formula for Glover Mallory
Bring the Bonemold Formula to Glover Mallory

lines.name: The Dark Brotherhood
lines.begins: I heard a rumor that a boy named Aventus Aretino, in Windhelm, has been attempting to contact the Dark Brotherhood. I should find this boy and speak with him, and find out why he wants to contact a guild of assassins.
lines.start: Aventus Aretino in Windhelm (Innocence Lost). Kill Grelod, sleep, and Astrid finds you. Or take the Dark Brotherhood start.

sources.name: ACDB - Additional Contracts for the Dark Brotherhood

quests.name: Innocence Lost
journal: I heard a rumor that a boy named Aventus Aretino, in Windhelm, has been attempting to contact the Dark Brotherhood. I should find this boy and speak with him, and find out why he wants to contact a guild of assassins.

The mother of Aventus Aretino recently died, and the boy was sent to live at Honorhall Orphanage in Riften. He thinks I'm a Dark Brotherhood assassin, and wants me to kill the Orphanage's sadistic headmistress, Grelod the Kind. I could kill her or talk to the guards in Riften to try and have her arrested.
I've convinced Grelod the Kind that Aventus Aretino is just outside Riften. She's agreed to follow me to the docks, where I can then get rid of her discreetly.
Grelod is at the docks, where no one can see her. Time to get rid of her.
Grelod the kind has been dealt with. I should inform Aventus.
I should check on the children at the Honorhall Orphanage now that Grelod is spending the rest of her days at Riften's jail.
It turns out Grelod was killed while imprisoned. Perhaps Aventus Aretino actually managed to summon the Dark Brotherhood after all.
I killed Grelod the Kind, and Aventus Aretino rewarded me with a family heirloom. Now the boy can return to Honorhall Orphanage, and live out his childhood peacefully.
It turns out Grelod was killed while imprisoned. Perhaps Aventus Aretino actually managed to summon the Dark Brotherhood after all.
objectives: Kill Grelod the Kind or find an alternative way to deal with her
Tell Aventus Aretino that Grelod has been dealt with
Check with Constance at Honorhall Orphanage
Lure Grelod to the Riften Docks
Tell Aventus Aretino that Grelod is dead

quests.name: Where You Hang Your Enemy's Head...
journal: I should see Delvin Mallory in the Ragged Flagon in Riften, and see if he can help refit the Dawnstar Sanctuary.
The Dawnstar Sanctuary has been refitted and repaired to the extent of Delvin Mallory's capabilities. A new age has dawned for the Dark Brotherhood.

quests.name: Delayed Burial
journal: Apparently there's a strange jester near the Loreius Farm, on the road north of Whiterun. It would seem he's transporting a coffin in a cart, but one of the wheels has broken of. It might be worth investigating.
I met a strange jester named Cicero, who is transporting his mother's coffin. One of the wheels of Cicero's wagon has broken off, and he wants me to ask a farmer named Loreius for help.
I have agreed to help the farmer Loreius get rid of the strange jester named Cicero, who keeps asking for his help. I'm to report Cicero to the nearby guard, and lie about his offense.
The jester Cicero wants the farmer Loreius to fix his broken wagon wheel, but Loreius just wants Cicero to leave. I can either convince Loreius to fix the wheel, or report Cicero to the nearby guard.
I have reported Cicero to the guard, and lied about his offense. I must now speak to Loreius, and let him know I have assisted him.
I have spoken to Loreius, and convinced him to repair Cicero's broken wagon wheel. I need to report back to Cicero, and let him know help is on the way.
I have resolved the conflict between the jester Cicero and Loreius the farmer.
I have resolved the conflict between the jester Cicero and Loreius the farmer.
I have resolved the conflict between the jester Cicero and Loreius the farmer.
objectives: Convince Loreius to fix the wheel

quests.name: With Friends Like These...
journal: Astrid, of the Dark Brotherhood, informed me that by killing Grelod the Kind, I have robbed her organization of a kill. I have been taken captive and moved to some remote shack. Astrid will only give me the key if I kill someone she has taken captive, to "repay my debt."

I have killed one of the captives as Astrid instructed, and must now gain entrance to the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, which is located in the southern Pine Forest. Astrid has provided me with the correct passphrase - "Silence, my Brother."
I have killed an innocent person, gained entrance into the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and been officially welcomed into the Dark Brotherhood by Astrid. There's no turning back now.
Astrid invited me into the Dark Brotherhood, but I killed her instead. I will now never be able to join the shadowy organization of assassins.

quests.name: Sanctuary
journal: I must speak with Nazir, in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and receive my first assassination contracts.
I have spoken to Nazir and received my first set of contracts.
objectives: Receive the first set of contracts from Nazir

quests.name: Mourning Never Comes
journal: Astrid has given me my first major contract. I am to contact Muiri, the apothecary's assistant in The Hag's Cure, in Markarth. Muiri has apparently performed the Black Sacrament, and is trying to contact the Dark Brotherhood.

Muiri wants me to kill the bandit leader Alain Dufont, who is holed up with his gang of cutthroats in the dwarven ruin of Raldbthar. If Dufont dies, the contract will be completed, but Muiri will pay me some kind of bonus if I also eliminate Nilsine Shatter-Shield, in Windhelm.
Alain Dufont is dead. I must now return to Markarth, and tell Muiri the deed is complete.
I have spoken to Muiri, and been paid for the assassination of Alain Dufont. I must now report back to Astrid at the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.

After contacting Muiri, the apothecary's assistant at The Hag's Cure in Markarth, I learned that she wished to hire the Dark Brotherhood to kill a slanderous ex-lover. I killed the man, the bandit leader Alain Dufont, and was rewarded for the contract.

quests.name: Whispers in the Dark
journal: Astrid has heard Cicero speaking with someone, in whispered tones, in the chamber of the Night Mother. She fears they're conspiring against the Sanctuary, and wants me to eavesdrop on the conversation. I'm to sneak into the chamber, and hide in the coffin of the Night Mother.

While eavesdropping on Cicero, I heard the voice of the Night Mother, who named me Listener. Astrid seems unsure what to believe, and needs time to process this latest development. In the meantime, I'm to see Nazir for more side contract work.

While eavesdropping on Cicero, I heard the voice of the Night Mother, who named me Listener. Astrid seems unsure what to believe, and it's hard to tell what effect this will ultimately have on the Sanctuary.
objectives: Hide in the Night Mother's coffin
Receive a side contract from Nazir

quests.name: The Silence Has Been Broken
journal: I returned to Nazir, but he directed me to speak with Astrid immediately. Perhaps she's made up her mind about me seeing Amaund Motierre in Volundruud.
Astrid has agreed to let me see Amaund Motierre in the dungeon known as Volunruud, as commanded by the Night Mother. I'm to speak with Motierre, and find out what he wants.

Amaund Motierre has commissioned the Dark Brotherhood to kill several people, all of which will lead to the assassination of a primary target - the Emperor of Tamriel himself. I am to report this information back to Astrid.

I've given Astrid the amulet and sealed letter provided to me by Amaund Motierre. I'm to take the amulet to a fence named Delvin Mallory, in the Riften Ratway - to gain any information I can, and sell it if Mallory is willing to buy.

Delvin Mallory has informed me that the amulet provided by Amaund Motierre indicates he is a member of the Emperor's Elder Council. Mallory was willing to purchase the amulet in exchange for a letter of credit, which I must now deliver to Astrid.
After meeting with Amaund Motierre, I learned he is a member of the Elder Council, and wants the Dark Brotherhood to kill several people, all of whom lead to a primary target - the Emperor himself.
objectives: Deliver the letter and amulet to Astrid
Show the amulet to Delvin Mallory

quests.name: Bound Until Death
journal: I must journey to the Temple of the Divines in Solitude, attend the public wedding reception of Vittoria Vici and Asgeir Snow-Shod, and kill the bride. I'll receive a bonus if I kill Vici as she addresses the crowd.

I have killed Vittoria Vici, the Emperor's cousin, at her own wedding, and everyone will assume it's related to the ongoing war. The Emperor will now be forced to visit Skyrim to deal with the aftermath, paving the way for his assassination.

quests.name: Breaching Security
journal: Astrid informed me that I should speak to Gabriella about my next contract, which has something to do with the Emperor's security.

I must kill Gaius Maro, an agent of the Emperor's security force. Once he's dead, I must plant a letter on his body that will incriminate him in a plot to kill the Emperor. If I wish to earn a bonus, I must not kill him in Dragon Bridge, or on the road, but in one of the cities he visits.

I have killed Gaius Maro, and planted the Incriminating Letter on his body. This will surely disrupt the security plan for the Emperor's visit, ruin Commander Maro emotionally, and make the Emperor believe the only plot to kill him has been foiled.
objectives: Plant the Incriminating Letter on Gaius Maro's body

quests.name: The Cure for Madness
journal: Upon my return to the Sanctuary, I was informed by Gabriella that there was some kind of "incident" with Cicero. I need to speak to Astrid to find out what happened.
While I was away, Cicero went berserk and tried to kill Astrid. He fled the Sanctuary, with Arnbjorn in pursuit. I need to locate them both, and then kill Cicero.
After learning that Cicero went berserk and tried to kill Astrid, I was ordered to go to the Dawnstar Sanctuary, find him, and end his life. The matter has now been resolved.
objectives: Kill Cicero, or leave the Sanctuary

quests.name: Recipe for Disaster
journal: I must speak with Festus Krex about my next target, the renowned chef known only as the "Gourmet."

I have been tasked with killing the Gourmet, but only one person knows the famous chef's true identity and location - a man named Anton Virane. I must get this information from Anton Virane, and then kill him.
I must kill the Gourmet, who is actually an Orc named Balagog gro-Nolob. Once he's dead, I must steal his Writ of Passage. And, if I can manage to hide the body, I'll receive a bonus.
The Gourmet is dead, and I'm now in possession of his Writ of Passage. Soon, I will take his place as chef for the Emperor...
objectives: (Optional) Drag Balagog's body to a hiding place

quests.name: To Kill an Empire
journal: It would appear all the contracts leading up to the Emperor's assassination have been completed. I must now speak with Astrid, and receive further instructions.

Using the Writ of Passage issued to the chef known as "The Gourmet," I must enter Castle Dour and play the part of the culinary master, who is scheduled to prepare a feast. This will be my opportunity to assassinate the Emperor, using any tools at my disposal.

It was a trap! The Emperor was actually Titus Mede II's double, and Commander Maro said I had been betrayed by someone within the Dark Brotherhood. Despite his deal, Maro has sent troops to destroy the Sanctuary. I must return there and help my Family!

After learning the Emperor was actually Titus Mede II's double, and being confronted by Commander Maro, I learned Maro had betrayed the betrayer, and sent troops to destroy the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary. I returned there, to lend aid to my fellow Family members.
objectives: Report to Gianna while wearing a chef's hat
Follow Gianna to the dining room

quests.name: Death Incarnate
journal: I have returned to the Sanctuary in the midst of the Penitus Oculatus' assault. I must assist my fellow Family members any way I can.

Not only have the Penitus Oculatus killed most of the Family members and burned the Sanctuary,  Astrid also revealed herself to be the one who betrayed me. But there is still hope - the Emperor is still in Skyrim, and I have a chance to fulfill my contract with Amaund Motierre.
objectives: Kill the Legion soldiers inside the Sanctuary (<Global=DB10LegionAttackerDeadCount>/5)

quests.name: Hail Sithis!
journal: The Night Mother has spoken to me once again. The true Emperor must be assassinated - the contract with Amaund Motierre must be completed.
The Emperor has been assassinated. The Dark Brotherhood will, once more, be feared and respected the world over.

quests.name: Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!
journal: I have killed a Dark Brotherhood assassin. I should report her death to a guard.
I've spoken to a guard about the Dark Brotherhood assassin's death. He told me I should share this information with Commander Maro, in the village of Dragon Bridge.

Commander Maro has tasked me with killing every assassin in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary! He has provided me with the location of the sanctuary, and I am to find a way inside. I should investigate the area surrounding the sanctuary and see what I can find.

Commander Maro has tasked me with killing every assassin in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary! He has provided me with the location of the sanctuary, I have found a way inside. I need to find and kill each of the assassins.
I have killed every assassin of the Dark Brotherhood. I should now report back to Commander Maro.
It turns out I killed Astrid, the leader of the Dark Brotherhood. Commander Maro in Dragon Bridge asked me to kill the rest of the group, but I refused.

After killing the leader of the Dark Brotherhood, I was commissioned by Commander Maro to wipe out the assassins. I did so, and was rewarded for my efforts. Of course, it will now be impossible for me to join the shadowy organization...
objectives: Report Astrid's death to a guard
Learn the passphrase to enter the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary

quests.name: Honor Thy Family
journal: I have broken the rules of the Sanctuary, and must pay Nazir a fine before I can proceed with any Dark Brotherhood business.

quests.name: Contract: Kill Narfi
journal: I must travel to the town of Ivarstead and kill the beggar Narfi. I may use any means at my disposal. When I am done, I am to return to Nazir at the Sanctuary and collect my reward.
Narfi has been dealt with, and I have collected my reward from Nazir at the Sanctuary.

quests.name: Contract: Kill Ennodius Papius
journal: I must kill the ex-miller Ennodius Papius, at Anga's Mill. I may use any means at my disposal. When I am done, I am to report back to Nazir at the Sanctuary and collect my reward.
Ennodius Papius is dead, and I have collected my reward from Nazir at the Sanctuary.

quests.name: Contract: Kill Beitild
journal: I must go to Dawnstar and kill the mine boss, Beitild. I may use any means at my disposal. When I am done, I am to report back to Nazir at the Sanctuary and collect my reward.
Beitild is dead, and I have collected my reward from Nazir at the Sanctuary.

quests.name: Contract: Kill Hern
journal: I must travel to Half-Moon Mill and kill the vampire Hern. I may use any means at my disposal. When I am done, I am to report back to Nazir at the Sanctuary and collect my reward.
Hern is dead, and I have collected my reward from Nazir at the Sanctuary.

quests.name: Contract: Kill Lurbuk
journal: I must kill the bard Lurbuk, in the town of Morthal. I may use any means at my disposal. When I am done, I am to report back to Nazir at the Sanctuary and collect my reward.
Lurbuk is dead, and I have collected my reward from Nazir at the Sanctuary.

quests.name: Contract: Kill Deekus
journal: I must go to the shipwreck on the Northern Coast, and kill Deekus. I may use any means at my disposal. When I am done, I am to report back to Nazir at the Sanctuary and collect my reward.
Deekus is dead, and I have collected my reward from Nazir at the Sanctuary.

quests.name: Contract: Kill Ma'randru-jo
journal: I must find and kill the Khajiit Ma'randru-jo, a merchant who travels with one of the caravans. I may use any means at my disposal. When I am done, I am to report back to Nazir at the Sanctuary and collect my reward.
Ma'randru-jo is dead, and I have collected my reward from Nazir at the Sanctuary.

quests.name: Contract: Kill Anoriath
journal: I must kill the archer Anoriath, who can usually be found at his food stall in Whiterun, or hunting in the plains outside the city. I may use any means at my disposal. When I am done, I am to report back to Nazir at the Sanctuary and collect my reward.
Anoriath is dead, and I have collected my reward from Nazir at the Sanctuary.

quests.name: Contract: Kill Agnis
journal: I must kill the old woman Agnis, who serves as a servant in Fort Greymoor. I may use any means at my disposal. When I am done, I am to report back to Nazir at the Sanctuary and collect my reward.
Agnis is dead, and I have collected my reward from Nazir at the Sanctuary.

quests.name: Contract: Kill Maluril
journal: I must kill the wizard Maluril, who can be found investigating the Dwarven ruin of Mzinchaleft. I may use any means at my disposal. When I am done, I am to report back to Nazir at the Sanctuary and collect my reward.
Maluril is dead, and I have collected my reward from Nazir at the Sanctuary.

quests.name: Contract: Kill Helvard
journal: I must kill Helvard, the Housecarl of Falkreath. I may use any means at my disposal. When I am done, I am to report back to Nazir at the Sanctuary and collect my reward.
Helvard is dead, and I have collected my reward from Nazir at the Sanctuary.

quests.name: Contract: Kill Safia
journal: I must kill Safia, the pirate captain of the ship Red Wave, which is moored at the docks in Solitude. I may use any means at my disposal. When I am done, I am to report back to Nazir at the Sanctuary and collect my reward.
Safia is dead, and I have collected my reward from Nazir at the Sanctuary.

quests.name: DB01_Opt
objectives: Ask a guard to arrest Grelod (Optional)
Wait for Grelod to drink the poisoned wine

quests.name: Contract: Kill Braith
journal: I have accepted an additional contract to kill Braith in Whiterun.
I have accepted an additional contract to kill Braith in Whiterun.
I've killed Braith in Whiterun. I should collect my reward from Nazir.
I've killed Braith in Whiterun and collected my reward from Nazir.

quests.name: Contract: Kill Elenwen
journal: I have accepted an additional contract to kill Elenwen in the Thalmor Embassy.
I've killed  Elenwen in the Thalmor Embassy. I should collect my reward from Nazir.
I've killed  Elenwen in the Thalmor Embassy and collected my reward from Nazir.

quests.name: Infiltration
journal: Returning from securing the staff 'Summoner's Demise', Alara told me to speak to Laracin, who is spearheading a plan to infiltrate a group of Necromancers.

Returning from securing the staff 'Summoner's Demise', Alara told me to speak to Laracin, who is spearheading a plan to infiltrate a group of Necromancers. He has sent me to Deep Moon Lookout to meet with a recruiter for the Necromancers - where he has recommended I do whatever it takes to join the Necromancers.

In order to infiltrate the Dark Dawn, a group of Necromancers, the recruiter Dralos has told me to kill a woman named Adelaide. I must make a choice whether to kill her, attempt to reason with them, or kill the Necromancers and find another way to infiltrate the group.

In order to infiltrate the Dark Dawn, a group of Necromancers, the recruiter Dralos told me to kill a woman named Adelaide. However, I made the choice to kill the Necromancers. I should speak with Adelaide to find out what she knows about the group.

In order to infiltrate the Dark Dawn, a group of Necromancers, the recruiter Dralos told me to kill a woman named Adelaide. I made the choice to kill her, and must now speak with Dralos in order to find out the location of their sanctuary.
I have discovered the location of the Dark Dawn Sanctuary. I must make my way there and gain access to the Sanctuary in order to find evidence of their plans.

I have gained access to the Dark Dawn Sanctuary. I must search for a way to find out what these Necromancers are planning. I could try searching through secret documents, gaining the favor of members of the group, or fighting my way through to their plans.

I have discovered that the Necromancers are planning to raise the First Vampire created by Molag Bal. I must return to Alara and inform her of this information, or see if I can find out anything more about the Dark Dawn.

Upon returning to Meridia's Sanctum, I have found it to be attacked by the group named The Malevolent and Acolyte Kariss has been killed. I must speak with Alara to find out what I can do to help this situation.

I ran in to a talking dog named Barbas who had a falling out with his master Clavicus Vile. I've retrieved the Rueful Axe for Clavicus who offered me a deal. I decided to kill Barbas and keep the Rueful Axe.

quests.name: A Night To Remember
journal: I have awoken in the Temple Of Dibella in Markarth. Sam and the staff he promised me have disappeared.

I have awoken in the Temple Of Dibella in Markarth. Sam and the staff he promised me have disappeared. I have no idea how I got here but a priestess has told me I trashed the Temple. The priestess might tell me what happened to Sam and the staff if I pick up the place.

I have awoken in the Temple Of Dibella in Markarth. Sam and the staff he promised me have disappeared. I have no idea how I got here but a priestess has told me I trashed the Temple. I have cleaned up the Temple, if I apologize to the priestess she might tell me what happened to Sam and the staff.
I have awoken from a night of debauchery with no idea what happened. Sam and the staff he promised me have disappeared. The priestesses of Dibella have told me to ask about Sam in Rorikstead.

I have awoken from a night of debauchery with no idea what happened. Sam and the staff he promised me have disappeared. Ennis in Rorikstead will tell me more about what happened once I return the goat I stole from him.

I have awoken from a night of debauchery with no idea what happened. Sam and the staff he promised me have disappeared. Ennis in Rorikstead will tell me more about what happened once I return the goat I stole from him.

I have awoken from a night of debauchery with no idea what happened. Sam and the staff he promised me have disappeared. A note of debt I gave to Ennis in Rorikstead has directed me to Ysolda in Whiterun. She might be able to direct me to Sam.

I have awoken from a night of debauchery with no idea what happened. Sam and the staff he promised me have disappeared. Ysolda in Whiterun will give me more information about Sam once I return the ring I borrowed from her to give to someone in Witchmist Grove.

I have awoken from a night of debauchery with no idea what happened. Sam and the staff he promised me have disappeared. Ysolda in Whiterun will give me more information about Sam once I return the ring I borrowed from her to give to a hagraven at Witchmist Grove.
I have awoken from a night of debauchery with no idea what happened. Sam and the staff he promised me have disappeared. Ysolda in Whiterun has told me to look for Sam in Morvunskar.
"Sam" turned out to be the daedric prince of debauchery, Sanguine. He spurred me on during a drunken night of revelry that crossed all of Skyrim. I've acquired the Sanguine Rose for my troubles.

lines.name: Boethiah's Calling
lines.begins: I am to lead someone to the Shrine of Boethiah, instruct them to touch the Pillar of Sacrifice, and once trapped by its magic, slay them. If I do this Boethiah will appear.
lines.note: The Man in Black is a second way through, with Rudin Filaro at the Temple of Mara.

quests.name: Boethiah's Calling
journal: I am to lead someone to the Shrine of Boethiah, instruct them to touch the Pillar of Sacrifice, and once trapped by its magic, slay them. If I do this Boethiah will appear.
Boethiah has appeared using <Alias=DeadFriend>'s corpse as a vessel. She will give a special task to whichever of her cultists are left alive after we fight to the death.

Boethiah revealed herself to me. I am to slay her previous champion, and having done so, don the Ebony Mail. So doing, she will make me her champion. Her former champion stays within a bandit-occupied mine in the mountains northwest of Falkreath.
I have proven myself to Boethiah, and she has made me her new champion.

After slaying her cultists, Boethiah appeared to me.  She desired that I sacrifice a follower in order to prove myself to her, but I refused to take any part in such a vile act. As punishment, she has cursed me.  I should pray to the Divines and hope that they will remove the curse.
Stendarr has granted me the Gauntlets of the Crusader as a reward for refusing Boethiah's wishes.
I have slain Boethiah's cultists; Molag Bal should be pleased.  I should visit his altar in Markarth to see if he will grant me greater power as a reward for this victory over his enemy.
Molag Bal has granted me the Hands of Coldharbour as a reward for my victory over Boethiah's followers.
objectives: Lead someone to become trapped by the shrine and slay them
Retrieve and equip the Ebony Mail
Visit the Altar of Molag Bal

quests.name: The Man in Black
journal: I have agreed to help Rudin Filaro, a Dark Elf intent on visiting the Temple of Mara located in the mountains northeast of Kynesgrove. He has hired to escort him as the road is known to be dangerous.

I was betrayed! Upon entering the mountain pass, a rune set by the Dark Elf left me paralyzed. I have just regained consciousness hours later, barely alive, next to a shrine of Boethiah. I must investigate the area to discover what has transpired here.

The Dark Elf lured me here to sacrifice me to Boethiah, the Daedric Prince of Deception. Miraculously, I survived the ritual the cultists performed. The elf is now traveling to Knifepoint Ridge to kill a dangerous man whom the Prince wants dead.

I tracked Rudin Filaro to Knifepoint Ridge. I found him standing over the previous Champion of Boethiah's corpse, whose title the elf had now claimed. After a palaver, our fight to the death commenced. I emerged victorious, marking an end to his exploits.
objectives: Search for clues on Rudin's whereabouts.

quests.name: Boethiah's Bidding
journal: Lord Boethiah has sent me, her champion, to assassinate the Jarl of Solitude using guile, deception, and stealth.
Lord Boethiah has sent me, her champion, to assassinate the Jarl of Solitude using guile, deception, and stealth. I have successfully completed my mission.

lines.name: Discerning the Transmundane
lines.begins: I've been given a book of bizarre ramblings about Elder Scrolls, written by Septimus Signus. He claims to have spent time at the Winterhold Arcanaeum.
lines.firstObjective: Ask Urag about the insane book

quests.name: Discerning the Transmundane
journal: I've been given a book of bizarre ramblings about Elder Scrolls, written by Septimus Signus. He claims to have spent time at the Winterhold Arcanaeum.
I've learned that Septimus Signus, a preeminent scholar of the Elder Scrolls, is currently living in the far north, studying a dwarven artifact. He might know where I can find an Elder Scroll.

I met Septimus Signus, a brilliant but mad scholar living in the northern ice fields. He's directed me to a dwarven observatory that supposedly houses an Elder Scroll. He doesn't care about the Scroll itself, but wants me to use some kind of machine there to inscribe a dwarven lexicon with the Scroll's knowledge and bring it to him.

I met Septimus Signus and brought him a dwarven lexicon containing the distilled knowledge of an Elder Scroll. With it, he believes he can open the lockbox he's been studying. He will contact me when he has the secret.

I met Septimus Signus and brought him a dwarven lexicon containing the distilled knowledge of an Elder Scroll. With it, he believes he can open the lockbox he's been studying by creating a mixture of blood that will resemble dwarven. I need to collect blood from several different races if I want to help him.

I met a strange hermit named Septimus Signus, who needed the knowledge of an Elder Scroll and a collection of blood to open a dwarven lockbox he had studied for years. I helped him open it. It did not contain what he had expected, but instead a book of great knowledge, the Oghma Infinium.
I met and killed a strange hermit named Septimus Signus, who needed the knowledge of an Elder Scroll and a collection of blood to open a dwarven lockbox he had studied for years.
objectives: Ask Urag about the insane book

quests.name: Ill Met By Moonlight

I've met Sinding, a werewolf who the Daedric Lord Hircine has punished by preventing his transformations. He's given me the ring he stole and asked me to entreat Hircine for forgiveness.
I've met Sinding, a werewolf who the Daedric Lord Hircine has punished by preventing his transformations. Hircine has asked me to finish the job and gain his favor by killing Sinding.
I've met Sinding, a werewolf who the Daedric Lord Hircine has punished by preventing his transformations. I'm going to defend him against the hunters that Hircine has sent to end his life.
I met Sinding, a werewolf who the Daedric Lord Hircine had punished by preventing his transformations. I helped kill him as a service to Hircine, and have been rewarded with the Savior's Hide.
I met Sinding, a werewolf who the Daedric Lord Hircine had punished by preventing his transformations. I defended him against the hunters that Hircine sent to end his life, and earned his friendship.

Silus Vesuius is offering me gold to retrieve the three pieces of Mehrunes' Razor from their current owners. Drascua has the pommel, Ghunzul has the blade shards, and Jorgen has the hilt.
Silus Vesuius now has all three pieces of Mehrunes' Razor and wants me to help him reforge it at the Shrine of Mehrunes Dagon.

I have killed Silus Vesuius for Mehrunes Dagon. I should speak to the Lord of Destruction through his altar.

Silus is dead. Whatever plans he had have died with him.

I have successfully reforged Mehrunes' Razor. I can return it to Silus for a reward.
I have given the reforged Razor to Silus and have received a substantial reward.

quests.name: The Black Star
journal: Aranea, a priestess of Azura, says I am destined to find "an elven man, who can turn the brightest star as black as night." She believes he is in Winterhold.
Nelacar has told me that his old mentor, Malyn Varen, was experimenting on Azura's Star. Malyn's last known location is Ilinalta's Deep.
I have Azura's Star, but it's been corrupted by Malyn Varen's magic. I could take the Star to either Aranea or Nelacar to have it repaired.
I am inside Azura's Star and must defeat Malyn Varen's soul in order for Azura to purify the Star and bring me out.
I am inside Azura's Star and must defeat Malyn Varen's soul in order for Nelacar to bring me out and complete the Black Star.
I have cleansed Azura's Star, the infinite Soul Gem. It is mine to do with as I see fit.

Meridia has commanded me to enter Kilkreath Ruins, destroy Malkoran, and retrieve the artifact Dawnbreaker. I will need to guide a beam of light through the ruins which will open the way for me.
I have entered Kilkreath Ruins, destroyed Malkoran, and retrieved the artifact Dawnbreaker, which Meridia has bestowed upon me for my service.

lines.name: The Cursed Tribe
lines.begins: I've heard rumors there's some kind of problem in the Orc settlement of Largashbur, southwest of Riften.

quests.name: The Cursed Tribe
journal: I've heard rumors there's some kind of problem in the Orc settlement of Largashbur, southwest of Riften.
The Orcs of Largashbur are besieged by giants. Atub, the wise woman of the tribe, has asked me to talk the chief, Yamarz.

The Orcs of Largashbur are besieged by giants. The chief, Yamarz, told me that he has been cursed by ghosts haunting him, leaving him and the tribe weak and vulnerable to Giant attacks. He asked me to petition Malacath to remove the curse.

The Orcs of Largashbur are besieged by giants. The chief, Yamarz, told me that he has been cursed by ghosts haunting him, leaving him and the tribe weak and vulnerable to Giant attacks. I told him I know a spell that could help him.

The Orcs of Largashbur are besieged by giants. The chief, Yamarz, told me that he has been cursed by ghosts haunting him, leaving him and the tribe weak and vulnerable to Giant attacks. Atub told me there should be shrine of Malacath northwest of Largushbur.

The Orcs of Largashbur are besieged by giants. The chief, Yamarz, told me that he has been cursed by ghosts haunting him, leaving him and the tribe weak and vulnerable to Giant attacks. I located the shrine northwest of Largashbur. I was unable to contact Malacath, but found a note on an Orc skeleton mentioning Yamarz should "listen with the ears of the wind".

The Orcs of Largashbur are besieged by giants, and have been forbidden to leave their stronghold. Atub, the wise woman of the tribe, has asked me to find her troll fat and a Daedra heart so that she may contact Malacath for guidance.

The Orcs of Largashbur are besieged by giants. The chief, Yamarz, told me that he has been cursed by ghosts haunting him, leaving him and the tribe weak and vulnerable to Giant attacks. I've cast a spell to make the ghosts appear and they're now attacking the stronghold.

The Orcs of Largashbur are besieged by giants. The chief, Yamarz, told me that he has been cursed by ghosts haunting him, leaving him and the tribe weak and vulnerable to Giant attacks. I've cast a spell to make the ghosts appear and defeated them.

The Orcs of Largashbur are besieged by giants. The chief, Yamarz, told me that he has been cursed by ghosts haunting him, leaving him and the tribe weak and vulnerable to Giant attacks. I've cast a spell to make the ghosts appear and defeated them.

Malacath has spoken to his followers and expressed disappointment in them. He is angry they allowed his shrine to be desecrated, and has commanded the chieftain of Largashbur, Yamarz, to return to the shrine and reclaim it.

Despite being specifically instructed by Malacath to see to it himself, Yamarz wants my help in defeating the giants that have overrun Fallowstone Cave and the shrine of Malacath. He's promised to pay me in exchange for making sure he arrives there safely.

After Malacath ordered him to retake the shrine in Fallowstone Cave, Yamarz insisted that I escort him there to make sure he arrived safely. Now he has offered to pay me even more in exchange for killing the giant myself, to which I have agreed.

After Malacath ordered him to retake the shrine in Fallowstone Cave, Yamarz insisted that I escort him there to make sure he arrived safely. He offered to pay me even more in exchange for killing the giant myself, but I declined. Yamarz died trying to fight the giant, so I suppose it's up to me now.
After escorting Yamarz to Fallowstone Cave and proving myself more worthy, Malacath has commanded me to return to Largashbur and deliver Shagrol's Hammer there.

The curse placed on the Orcs of Largashbur is lifted. The tribe's leader, Yamarz, was revealed as a shiftless weakling in Malacath's eyes, and I have redeemed his actions by defeating the giant that had taken over the shrine in Fallowstone Cave. Malacath has named Gularzob as the new chief, and has named me his new champion.
Using magic, I've helped the Orc Stronghold of Largashbur get rid of the ghosts that were haunting their chief.

Place Shagrol's Hammer on the shrine in Largashbur

I have met Molag Bal, the Lord of Domination. He has asked me to cleanse his altar in the abandoned house in Markarth by luring a priest of Boethiah to him.
Logrolf is dead, and the Mace of Molag Bal is mine.

quests.name: The Merchant's Masterpiece
journal: Theodor Gorlash, a strangely familiar merchant in the Shivering Isles, has offered to teach me how to smith amber in exchange for retrieving a piece of amber in the visage of Sheogorath. He directed me to search a nearby Root tunnel called the Root Canal. I should head there now.

Theodor Gorlash, a strangely familiar merchant in the Shivering Isles, offered to teach me how to smith amber in exchange for retrieving a piece of amber in the visage of Sheogorath. I've retrieved the piece of amber from a mysterious grove deep in the heart of the Root. I should return to Theodor.

Theodor Gorlash, a strangely familiar merchant in the Shivering Isles, offered to teach me how to smith amber in exchange for retrieving a piece of amber in the visage of Sheogorath. I retrieved the piece of amber from a mysterious grove deep in the heart of the Root. After returning to Theodor, he rewarded me with an amber smithing manual. I should give it a read.

Theodor Gorlash, a strangely familiar merchant in the Shivering Isles, offered to teach me how to smith amber in exchange for retrieving a piece of amber in the visage of Sheogorath. I retrieved the piece of amber from a mysterious grove deep in the heart of the Root. After returning to Theodor, he rewarded me with an amber smithing manual. I read through its contents, and now have a good idea of how to smith amber.

Return the Sheogorath-Shaped Amber to Theodor Gorlash

lines.name: The Only Cure
lines.begins: A Khajiit named Kesh has offered to help me commune with Peryite. He asked me to acquire a deathbell flower, flawless ruby, silver ingot, and some vampire dust.

quests.name: The Only Cure
journal: A Khajiit named Kesh has offered to help me commune with Peryite. He asked me to acquire a deathbell flower, flawless ruby, silver ingot, and some vampire dust.
I've found out about Orchendor, a worshipper of Peryite who is preparing to release a plague in Skyrim. I should visit Bthardamz and put a stop to his plans.
There is a fuming incense at the wilderness shrine to Peryite. Inhaling this is supposed to help me commune with the daedric prince.
The Daedric Prince Peryite has solicited me to kill an elf named Orchendor. I should be able to find him at Bthardamz.
I have killed Orchendor and put a stop to his plans.
I met Peryite, the daedric prince of Pestilence. I simply refused to help him. Good riddance, I say.
I killed Orchendor, stopped the plague from spreading and destroyed Peryite's altar.
objectives: Speak with Peryite or Destroy his Altar

lines.name: The Taste of Death
lines.begins: Eola in Markarth wants me to join her in worshipping Namira, the Lady of Decay, by feasting on the flesh of the dead. She has something planned inside Reachcliff Cave.

sources.name: The Taste of Death - Quest Addon

giver.name: Eola
giver.place: Hall of the Dead, The Reach

lines.firstObjective: Clear the Draugr from Reachcliff Cave

quests.name: Investigate the Hall of the Dead
objectives: Speak to Verulus about the Hall of the Dead
Investigate the Hall of the Dead
Tell Verulus the Hall of the Dead is safe

quests.name: The Taste of Death
journal: Eola in Markarth wants me to join her in worshipping Namira, the Lady of Decay, by feasting on the flesh of the dead. She has something planned inside Reachcliff Cave.
Eola wants me to lure Brother Verulus to the Shrine of Namira, so that her coven of cannibals can feast on his flesh.
Brother Verulus is dead, and I've been asked to feast on his dead body to complete my initiation into Namira's coven.
I have feasted on the body of Brother Verulus and have been rewarded with Namira's Ring.
I killed Eola. Whatever she could have offered me was lost when she died.
I killed Brother Verulus outside of the Shrine of Namira's presence. The cannabilistic ritual to gain Namira's blessing has failed.
objectives: Clear the Draugr from Reachcliff Cave
Lead Verulus to the Shrine of Namira

quests.name: A Bitter Aftertaste
journal: I've read the journal of the cannibal who assaulted me. It revealed that Draugr drove them from Reachcliff Cave and that more cannibals are hiding in Markarth. The cave may hold clues to their identities.

I read the journal of the cannibal who assaulted me. It reveals that Draugr drove them from Reachcliff Cave and that more cannibals are hiding in Markarth. The cave may hold clues to their identities.
I've read the journal of the cannibal who assaulted me and have learned that more of her coven are hiding in Markarth. Reachcliff Cave may hold clues to their identities.

I found the Champion of Namira's journal. It names the cannibals hiding in Markarth. Confronting them directly may be unlawful. Speaking to Verulus first, I could get the Jarl's permission to bring them to justice.
I informed Verulus about the Cult of Namira in Markarth. He has advised me to speak to the Jarl.
The Jarl tasked me with dealing with the cannibals as I see fit. Additionally, I now have the proper jurisdiction to arrest them.
The cannibals have been brought to justice. I am to see the Jarl for a reward.

The cannibalistic cult of Namira infesting Markarth has been brought to justice and I have been rewarded by the Jarl himself. Additionally, within Reachcliff Cave, I discovered a peculiar enchanted ring. It pulses with an unsettling hunger...
objectives: Search for evidence in Reachcliff Cave
(Optional) Speak to Verulus for the Jarl's permission to confront the cannibals
Speak to the Jarl of Markarth
Speak to the Jarl of Markarth for a reward

lines.name: The Whispering Door
lines.begins: Balgruuf the Greater, Jarl of Whiterun, has a troubled child. He's asked me to help the boy.

sources.name: Mephala's Curse - Whispering Door Quest Addon

lines.firstObjective: Find out what's wrong with Nelkir

quests.name: The Whispering Door
journal: Balgruuf the Greater, Jarl of Whiterun, has a troubled child. He's asked me to help the boy.
Mephala, the Lady of Whispers, has tasked me with releasing the Ebony Blade from its prison. I could follow her instructions and talk to the child, or warn Jarl Balgruuf about the situation.
I should inform the Jarl about what happened and tell him where to find Nelkir.
After helping the Jarl deal with his son's problem, I must now decide what to do with the Ebony Blade.
I decided to get rid of Mephala's Ebony Blade. It will no longer be able to cause any harm.
I have received Mephala's Ebony Blade, I should use it to slay those who are close to me.
I have received Mephala's Ebony Blade, but it lacks its legendary powers. To restore it, I must achieve great infamy and hatred in this land.
I have restored Mephala's Ebony Blade to its full potential.
objectives: Find out what's wrong with Nelkir
Speak to Nelkir OR warn the Jarl
Obtain the key to the Whispering Door
Retrieve the Ebony Blade. Optional: Inform the Jarl
Report to Jarl Balgruuf OR kill allies with the Ebony Blade
Speak to a Vigilant of Stendarr OR kill allies with the Ebony Blade

quests.name: The Fate of the Ebony Blade
journal: I have acquired the Ebony Blade, the legendary artifact of Mephala. I must decide whether to keep this powerful weapon or seek a means to destroy it. To destroy it, I would need a fire more intense than those that stoke the Skyforge.
The Ebony Blade is mine. I will restore it to its full power.
After much searching, I have found the Aetherium Forge, the only place where the Ebony Blade can be destroyed.
After much searching, I have found the Aetherium Forge, the only place where the Ebony Blade can be destroyed. I have cast it into the fires of the Forge and now feel liberated from its dark magic.
objectives: Decide the fate of the Ebony Blade.

lines.name: Waking Nightmare
lines.begins: I've overheard two citizens of Dawnstar complaining about horrible nightmares. They seem to be relying on a priest of Mara named Erandur for assistance.

quests.name: Waking Nightmare
journal: I've overheard two citizens of Dawnstar complaining about horrible nightmares. They seem to be relying on a priest of Mara named Erandur for assistance.

Erandur has assured me he can end the nightmares, the source of which seems to be within Nightcaller Temple, a place of worship for Vaermina. I have agreed to assist him in this endeavor and we are now on our way.

Erandur has revealed that Nightcaller Temple contains the legendary Skull of Corruption, an artifact of great power. In order to end the nightmares, we must breach the inner sanctum and allow Erandur to perform a ritual on the Skull which will render it inert.

From a tome obtained in the temple's library, Erandur has discovered a way to breach the inner sanctum. By obtaining a special liquid, we'll be able to perform a Dreamstride... travel a distance using another subject's dreams.

With Vaermina's Torpor in hand, I am ready to undergo the Dreamstride. I must drink the liquid which will enable me to enter the dreams of those who still slumber within these walls and use them to breach the inner sanctum.

I've found myself within the dreams of a priest of Vaermina. I am experiencing the Orc invasion of the temple over a decade ago. In the guise of the priest, I've been tasked with releasing the Miasma and placing everyone inside the temple in a deep sleep.
After awakening from the Dreamstride, I was able to remove the barrier to the inner sanctum. I must now follow Erandur to the Skull of Corruption so it can be rendered inert.

I've heard the words of the goddess Vaermina, who claims that Erandur will kill me after the ritual to destroy the Skull of Corruption is complete. I must make a choice; either allow Erandur to complete the ritual and destroy the Skull, or kill Erandur and wield the Skull of Corruption as my own.
I've made my decision, and allowed Erandur to live. The Skull of Corruption has been destroyed and Erandur has offered his services as a companion if I should ever need his assistance.
I've made my decision and Erandur has died by my hands. Unfortunately, the Skull of Corruption was destroyed before I could take his life. Such moments are the misfortunes of the indecisive.
I've made my decision and Erandur has died by my hands. I now possess the Skull of Corruption and look forward to performing my duties for Lady Vaermina.
objectives: Follow Erandur to the Skull of Corruption
Wait for Erandur to dispel the barrier
Allow Erandur to complete his ritual

lines.name: Sleepwalking Into A Nightmare
lines.begins: Ralforn has informed me of his wife Gretska who has disapeared over night and has told me of Gretska's common spots, I should look to see if I can find her or any clues at these spots.
lines.start: Ralforn at Green-Tip Cabin, north-east of Ivarstead.

sources.name: Sleepwalking Into A Nightmare - New Daedric Prince Quest

lines.firstObjective: Find a way to escape The Nightmare.

quests.name: Sleepwalking Into A Nightmare
journal: Ralforn has informed me of his wife Gretska who has disapeared over night and has told me of Gretska's common spots, I should look to see if I can find her or any clues at these spots.
I was unable to find any clues as to Gretska's whereabouts at her fishing spot.
I was unable to find any clues as to Gretska's whereabouts at her archery spot.
On the path I have found a knapsack, I should search it for clues.
I have found Gretska's journal, I should read it to see if I can gain any knowledge on her whereabouts.

I found Gretska's knapsack and it contains her journal. In the journal I have discovered that her nightmares always start with falling asleep somewhere in northern Skyrim. I should take the journal back to Ralforn.
I have found the location from Gretska's nightmares, I should have a look around and see what I can find.
Having spoken to Ralforn about the nightmares, he has asked if I would go look for her around the location of her nightmares in case she's there.
I have found the location from Gretska's nightmare. Gretska is also here sleeping... I should try to wake her.
I was unable to wake Gretska up, Maybe there is another way I can wake her up here.
Upon falling asleep, I have woken up somewhere different. Could this be Gretska's nightmare? I should look around and try find a way out.
I have found a cave within this place, I should take a look and see what I can see inside.
In the Awakening Chambers I found a bed, upon touching it I saw a vision calling me to sleep there but I was unable to. I should find a way to sleep here.
I am in the Nightmare Of Bereavement, I need to figure out how to overcome it.
I have found the Werewolf that killed Gretska's Father. I need to kill it.
I have killed the Werewolf, I should leave this nightmare now
I have overcome the Nightmare Of Bereavement, I should look look to overcome the other nightmares.
I am in the Nightmare Of Anguish, I need to figure out how to overcome it.
I am in the Nightmare Of Anguish, I need to figure out how to overcome it.
I have overcome the Nightmare Of Anguish, I should look look to overcome the other nightmares.
I am in the Nightmare Of Self Doubt, I need to figure out how to overcome it.
I have overcome the Nightmare Of Self Doubt, I should look look to overcome the other nightmares.
All the sconces in the awakening chambers are now lit, I should try to sleep on the bed there.
Upon sleeping I have awoken in a chamber. In this chamber I have been attacked by a ghost called the Lotus. I should defeat it.
I have defeated the Lotus.
I have defeated the Lotus, afterwards a voice spoke to me from the status in the room. I should speak with it.
Upon defeating the Lotus Vaermina reached out to me, offering me a boon for Gretska's life.
I have accepted Vaermina's offer, I need to kill Gretska to finish complete the deal.
I have accepted Vaermina's offer, I need to kill Gretska to finish complete the deal.
I have completed Vaermina's offer, becoming her champion.
I have rejected Vaermina's offer, I should try to wake up Gretska.
I have rejected Vaermina's offer, I should try to wake up Gretska.
Gretska is now awake and has told me she will meet me back at the cabin with Ralforn.
I have spoken to Ralforn, he has told me that Gretska wants to speak.
objectives: Find a way to escape The Nightmare.
Look for clues at Gretska's fishing spot
Look for clues at Gretska's archery target
Look for clues along the path
Tell Ralforn you found the journal
Find the location from Gretska's nightmare
Find a way to wake up Gretska from the nightmare
Find a way to sleep in the Awakening Chambers
Loot the Omen Of Self Doubt
Tell Gretska's Mother you've fixed the Vase
Overcome the Nightmare Of Self Doubt

lines.name: Wyrmstooth
lines.begins: An imperial courier named Theodyn Bienne has requested I speak to Lurius Liore at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun as soon as possible.
lines.start: An Imperial courier, Theodyn Bienne, finds you and sends you to Lurius Liore at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun.
lines.gate: Level 20, Rise in the East done, and the main quest through The Way of the Voice.
lines.firstObjective: Speak to Lurius Liore at The Bannered Mare in Whiterun

quests.name: Retrieving Embersunder
journal: Athir has asked me to find a sword called Embersunder. I should search the forsworn camp at Hag's End as Athir suggested.
I have found the sword Embersunder for Athir. I should bring it to him when I get the chance.
I have given the sword Embersunder to Athir.

quests.name: Barrow of the Wyrm
journal: Lurius has asked me to meet him at the docks in Solitude. He should have a vessel ready that can take us to the island of Wyrmstooth.
We've arrived at Wyrmstooth. I should follow Lurius to the Imperial mining settlement Stonehollow.
Stonehollow appears to have been destroyed by the dragon. I should meet Lurius and the mercenaries at the barrow on the far end of the island.
The entrance to the barrow appears to be locked. I need to search around for any clues that may help us get it open.
I've read in a bandit's journal that a sword named Goreduster is used to open and close the entrance to the barrow. I need to retrieve this sword and slot it into the pedestal to open the gate.
I've opened the entrance to the barrow using the Goreduster sword. We should now be able to enter.
An old mage named Alberthor may know of a way through the barrow and into the dragon's den. I should follow him and find out what kind of obstacle is in the way.
Alberthor needs to cast a spell on me that will transfer my mind into a Draugr. Through the Draugr, I should should look for a switch that will open the gate.
Using the Draugr I managed to find the switch that opens the gate. I should follow the barrow to a passage that leads down into the dragon's den.
The dragon Vulthurkrah has escaped from his den in Dimfrost. I need to follow him and defend the survivors at Stonehollow.
The dragon Vulthurkrah has been defeated.
objectives: Speak to Lurius Liore at the docks in Solitude.
Search the barrow entrance for a clue.
Retrieve Goreduster and enter the barrow.
Find the switch to open the gate.
Find a way into the dragon's den through the barrow.
Receive your reward from Lurius Liore.

quests.name: Blind Robber's Cache
journal: Fjeimir's letter mentioned someone named Rolgar who stole the key to Blind Robber's Cache but travelled to Dimfrost in search of more treasure. I should find Rolgar's body and retrieve the key.
I have retrieved the key from Rolgar's body. I should be able to use it to unlock the door to Blind Robber's Cache.
I have unlocked the door to Blind Robber's cache using the key I found on Rolgar's body.
objectives: Retrieve the key from Rolgar's corpse.
Unlock the door to Blind Robber's Cache.

quests.name: Animal Bounty
objectives: Kill the Bear south of Fort Valus.

quests.name: Bandit Bounty
objectives: Kill the Marauder Clanlord at Cragwater Cavern.

quests.name: Vampire Bounty
objectives: Kill the Master Vampire at Bloodfrost Burrow.

quests.name: Warlock Bounty
objectives: Kill the troublesome warlock at Krakevisa.

quests.name: Robbed Blind
journal: Daenlit has asked me to find an enchanted necklace currently in the possession of Erikur, a merchant living in Solitude.
I have stolen the necklace for Daenlit. I should bring it to her when I have the chance.
I have given the stolen necklace to Daenlit.

quests.name: Wyrmstooth
journal: An imperial courier named Theodyn Bienne has requested I speak to Lurius Liore at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun as soon as possible.
I should speak to Athir to learn the location of the dragon. He should be on the road to Falkreath with the rest of the mercenaries Lurius Liore has hired.
Athir has told me the dragon was last spotted in the mountains south-east of Falkreath. I should travel with the mercenaries and confront the dragon.
I encountered the dragon Vulthurkrah at Ancient's Ascent. However it fled to a place called Wyrmstooth. I should speak to Athir about the current situation.
I encountered the dragon Vulthurkrah at Ancient's Ascent. However it fled to a place called Wyrmstooth. I should return to Lurius Liore at the Bannered Mare to tell him what happened.
objectives: Speak to Lurius Liore at The Bannered Mare in Whiterun
Meet up with the mercenaries on the road to Falkreath
Find and defeat the dragon at Ancient's Ascent

quests.name: Stickler in the Mud
journal: Elmera has asked me to find 30 spiddal sticks. They're apparently common in the Deadlands, a realm of Oblivion.
I have obtained 30 spiddal sticks. I should bring them to Elmera when I have the chance.
I have given the spiddal sticks to Elmera.

quests.name: Unwanted Guests
journal: Alberthor has asked me to dispatch the Thalmor spies on the island.
I have dealt with the Thalmor spies. I should return to Alberthor.
I have dealt with the Thalmor spies for Alberthor.

quests.name: Reclaiming the Past
journal: I have found an old abandoned fort on Wyrmstooth. I should speak to Lurius Liore about the fate of Fort Valus.
I have bought the deed to Fort Valus from Lurius Liore. I should speak with him again should I desire to upgrade the fort or hire a crew.
objectives: Ask Lurius Liore about Fort Valus.
Speak to Lurius Liore about upgrading Fort Valus.

quests.name: A Priceless Commodity
journal: I have read a note from Bolmar that mentioned that the miners at Gronndal Grove have dug into a spriggan sanctuary. I should speak to Bolmar to offer my assistance.
Bolmar has asked me to investigate the spriggans at Gronndal Grove.
I have decided to kill the Spriggan Matriarch. I should clear out the grove before returning to Bolmar.
I have defeated the spriggans at Gronndal Grove. I should return to Bolmar.
I have told Bolmar that the Spriggan Matriarch has been defeated.
The spriggan matriarch has asked me to kill the miners that got away to restore the sanctity of kyne.
I have betrayed the Spriggan Matriarch. I will need to finish clearing the grove before returning to Bolmar.
I have defeated the spriggans at Gronndal Grove. I should return to Bolmar.
I have told Bolmar that the Spriggan Matriarch has been defeated.
I have killed the miners. I should return to the spriggan matriarch.
I have told the spriggan matriarch that the miners have been killed. The sanctity of kyne has been restored.
objectives: Speak to Bolmar at Gronndal Grove.
Investigate the spriggans at Gronndal Grove.
Clear the spriggans from Gronndal Grove.

quests.name: Repaying a Debt
journal: Shargam has asked me to kill Ulfgar to settle a debt. He's currently staying at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth.
I have confronted Ulfgar on behalf of Shargam.
I have killed Ulfgar. I should inform Shargam when I have the chance.
I have informed Shargam of Ulfgar's death.

quests.name: A Debt Unpaid
journal: Signy has told me her father owes gold to Erikur of Solitude. The amount owed is trivial compared to others and she has suggested that Erikur may forget about the debt altogether if he loses his debt ledger, but she doesn't know where this ledger may be kept.
I found Erikur's debt ledger for Signy. I should bring it to her when I have the chance.
I have given Erikur's debt ledger to Signy. She has assured me that no one will ever see it again.

quests.name: The Naked Nord
journal: I have read a note mentioning a naked nord spotted in the wilderness seemingly unable to move. I should investigate this matter.
I ran across a nord that had been paralyzed by a witch, stripped of all he was worth, and left to die in the wilderness.

A naked nord I met in the wilderness has asked me to find the pants that were stolen from him by a witch that put him under a paralysis spell. He suspects the witch is part of a coven inhabiting an old castle on the island to the north-west of Wyrmstooth. I should also search for a way to free him of his paralysis.

I was able to track down the witch that stole Gjalrunn's pants, however it would seem she too had been accosted on the road and had the pants stolen from her by warlocks from Krakevisa. They are likely conducting a ritual to transpose the enchantment on the pants as we speak. I should head there as soon as possible to prevent that from happening.

I was unable to stop the ritual in time. The pants have been transposed, destroying them in the process. I should return to either Gjalrunn or Glendora and let them know what transpired. I should also seek a cure for Gjalrunn's condition.
I was able to retrieve the pants before the ritual could complete. From here I must decide to either give the pants to Glendora the witch or return them to Gjalrunn.
I have given the pants to the witch Glendora in return for a reward. I should still seek a cure for Gjalrunn's condition.
I have given the pants back to Gjalrunn for which he was most grateful. I should seek a cure for his condition next. Perhaps Glendora will be able to help with that.
I have lied to Gjalrunn about finding the pants. I should still seek a cure for his condition.
I have told Gjalrunn that I had given the pants to Glendora. He was noticeably upset by this. I should still seek a cure for his condition.

Gjalrunn has refused the antidote I obtained from Glendora. There is nothing more I can do for him, though I suspect he'll seek revenge in one form or another once the paralysis wears off on its own. Assuming he survives that long...
I have given both the pants and the antidote to Gjalrunn for which he was incredibly grateful. Perhaps we'll cross paths on the road again one day.

I have given Gjalrunn the antidote to cure his condition but lied about finding his pants. At least he was happy to be freed from the witch's magic. His pants are mine now and ought to fetch a nice sum of gold. Perhaps we'll cross paths on the road again one day.

I have given Gjalrunn the antidote to cure his condition but could not retrieve his pants in time before they were turned to ash by the warlock's ritual. At least he was happy to be freed from the witch's magic. Perhaps we'll cross paths on the road again one day.

After giving Gjarunn the antidote to cure his condition I told him that I had given the pants to the witch instead. He was noticeably incensed by this and vowed revenge in one form or another. I suspect he plans on taking the pants back from the witches himself. I doubt he will be able to.

Though I lied about finding Gjalrunn's pants I was able to obtain an antidote to cure his condition for which he was grateful. His pants are mine now and ought to fetch a nice sum of gold. Perhaps we'll cross paths on the road again one day.
I have lied to Gjalrunn about finding a cure for his paralysis. Dejected, he has asked me to put him out of his misery.
Gjalrunn has died. It is no longer possible to do anything about his situation.
objectives: Speak to the naked nord about his predicament.
Find the witch that paralyzed the nord and stole his pants.
Find out why the witch stole the pants.
Exchange a daedra heart for the paralysis antidote.
Retrieve the golden pants from Krakevisa.
Deliver the bad news to Gjalrunn or Glendora.
Return the pants to Gjalrunn or Glendora.
Deliver the paralysis antidote to Gjalrunn.
Obtain the paralysis antidote for Gjalrunn.
Kill Gjalrunn to end his misery.

quests.name: Someone with Backbone
journal: I have read about the tomb of an ancient necromancer in a book on Wyrmstooth's history. I should probably check this out when I get the chance.
A disembodied voice spoke to me as I entered a cave. I should follow it and see where it leads me.
I have told Vulom that I am not interested in finding his bones. Should I change my mind I should speak to his skull in his tomb.
The disembodied voice identified itself as the spirit of Vulom and has asked me to find his bones so that he may rest. I should search inside the nordic ruins across Wyrmstooth.
I have found the missing bones of Vulom's skeleton. I should return them to his tomb so that he may rest.
Vulom revealed himself as an ancient lich. I should destroy him before he has the chance to wreak havok across Tamriel.
Vulom revealed himself as an ancient lich and I was forced to destroy him.

quests.name: A Howl Load of Trouble
journal: I have read a note from a tracker named Dunyick. It sounds like he's been tracking some marauders nearby and is looking to pay a mercenary to deal with them. I should go and speak to him about that when I get the chance.
Dunyick has asked me to find his wolf, Faelor. I should keep an eye out for a rust colored wolf somewhere in the mountains near the mining settlement.
I have found Dunyick's wolf, Faelor. I should reunite her with Dunyick as soon as possible.
Dunyick has died from his injuries. I should eliminate the bandits that killed him.
I have cleared out the bandits that waylayed Dunyick. I can either tell Faelor to go back to Dunyick's camp or take her with me on my adventures.

Eliminate the bandits that killed Dunyick.

quests.name: The Bruska Pogrom
journal: That guard at Fort Tulis mentioned some disturbances deep in the depths of the fort that he thinks might be goblins. I should investigate.

I reported back to the guard, and told him I had killed all of the goblins under the fort. He thanked me but was concerned that they might return. The only way to stop them is if I track down and kill the clan's Shaman. I should search for him now.

I reported back to the guard, and told him I had not killed all of the goblins under the fort. He seemed disappointed, but said that they would return anyway. The only way to stop them is if I track down and kill the clan's Shaman. I should search for him now.

I reported back to the guard, and told him that I was unsure that I had killed all of the goblins under the fort. He told me they would likely return anyway. The only way to stop them is if I track down and kill the clan's Shaman. I should search for him now.
I have tracked down and killed the Goblins' Shaman. The guard at Fort Tulis has rewarded me, and the Bruska clan will be severely weakened now.
The guard at Fort Tulis is dead. The goblins will continue to ravage the valley and its inhabitants. At any rate, no-one will pay me for killing the Shaman now.
objectives: Investigate the depths of Fort Tulis.
Find and kill the Bruska Shaman.

journal: I have spoken with Sadren, an aspiring acolyte of the House of Reclamations, who wants to prove himself by building a temple in Cormaris. He needs help getting wood for the foundations and I've agreed to talk to a local lumberjack called Feldrin at Cormar Crossing.

I have spoken with Sadren, an aspiring acolyte of the House of Reclamations, who wants to prove himself by building a temple in Cormaris. He needs help getting wood for the foundations. I've spoken to Feldrin and he needs me to get his axe back. He thinks it may be in the nearby Kwama mine.

I have spoken with Sadren, an aspiring acolyte of the House of Reclamations, who wants to prove himself by building a temple in Cormaris. He needs help getting wood for the foundations. I've spoken to Feldrin, who needs his axe back. I should return it to him now.

In his clutches I found a journal that mentioned an old abandoned Imperial fort known as "Fort Icemoth", far north of Jehanna just over the horizon. The journal also mentions a large presence of undead. I should investigate.

Upon searching through Silas's things, I uncovered an ancient nord dragon claw key made of silver and topaz. I should find a use for it.
The claw unlocked a portcullis in an ancient nord barrow on the main island. I should find what secrets lie within.
Upon reaching the end of Winter Shroud Sanctum, I came across the dragon priest Tovinaan. Who's now been defeated.

quests.name: The Call of Gray Cowl of Nocturnal
journal: I had a strange vision in my mind. Also I know where to go now.
I've succesfully escaped from Coldharbour.
I just met a man named Arenar and I'm following him to his village. I am in a desert region, now.

So, I'm in Hammerfell, in an isolated region. Lady Syloria has told to me what I'll have to do. The mausoleum is located in the Oasis of Mora Sul at the East side of this region, but first I'll have to get two items. One is the key to the entrance in Mora Sul and it's located in Al Shedim, northern of Ben Erai. Another item is the Alliance of Ancestral Cheetahs amulet, located at very  north of this region. Let's go!

Finally I entered the Mausoleum of the Champion of Cyrodiil. Now I have to fire the Arrow of the Extrication. That tiny rug near the bow should be the position where I have to stay to fire the Arrow and the bluish disc at the opposite side is the thing where I have to hit it with the Arrow.
A door was opened along the right side of the Mausoleum. I think this is the great moment.
Finally I got the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal. Now I have to go back to Seviana by using the magic portal.
I've got the legendary Gray Cowl of Nocturnal.

Find a way to enter the Mausoleum
Get into position and shoot the Arrow

Kill Sadraaka and free the Forgotten City from the curse

Andyn Pamarc has decided to attack us. It is time to show him that it was a bad idea.
Andyn Pamarc was defeated. I should check out how Dorian is doing.
Andyn Pamarc was defeated and Dorian is fine. I should talk to Honai to see what we can do next.
Andyn Pamarc was defeated. The Alik'r Desert should be slightly safer now.

I helped the Ash'abah clean ancient ruins in the Alik'r Desert. They decided that they would settle there a bit to make sure it has been completely purified.

Talk to Honai of the Ash'abah

I found the ancient library. I should head back to Dorian in Ben Erai to tell him its location.
I have found the ancient library and have to show the way to Dorian.
We are inside the ancient library. It was linked to a teleporting stone that brought us to an even bigger library, somewhere in Hammerfell. I should talk to Dorian to see what he has to say.

I have found the ancient library in the Alik'r Desert. It was linked to a teleporting stone that brought us to an even bigger library, somewhere in Hammerfell. Dorian is going to study its content for the sake of the College of Winterhold.

quests.name: Disappearing in the Dark
journal: ;Quest Start

I received a letter that said "Hammerfell needs you". It is the same sentence the Dark Brotherhood in the Alik'r Desert said when they asked for my help. I suppose I should find Tenerio back in the Alik'r Desert Sanctuary.

I talked to Tenerio back in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary in the Alik'r Desert. He wants me to investigate the whereabouts of an initiate called Lucya. Apparently, she was the one sent to find me back in Skyrim back when the Sanctuary was just reinvested.

I found nothing but a dead vampire back in the Alik'r Desert. Nothing about Lucya, but it doesn't sound good if she was the one that murdered the nord. I should head back to tell Tenerio about what I found.
Tenerio told me of a forgotten warehouse that Lucya said she would like to investigate for a future use. She might have headed there, I should look around to see if I can find her there.
Lucya was found dead in the abandoned warehouse. It seems her soul was bound to a soul gem. I should head back to the Sanctuary and tell Tenerio about the tragedy.

Lucya was found dead in the abandoned warehouse. It seems her soul was bound to a soul gem. Tenerio told me she was after an artifact and that she had found a way to get to it, but she was murdered by vampires before she could try anything. But I know about the Soul Cairn, so I might be able to find her there.
objectives: Talk to Tenerio in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary in the Alik'r Desert
Investigate the village where Lucya was supposed to be
Investigate the warehouse that Lucya had mentioned

quests.name: The Crimson Eviscerator
journal: Lucya was found dead in the abandoned warehouse. It seems her soul was bound to a soul gem. Tenerio told me she was after an artifact and that she had found a way to get to it, but she was murdered by vampires before she could try anything. But I know about the Soul Cairn, so I might be able to find her there.

I found Lucya's soul in the Soul Cairn and she told me that she had found an ancient Crimson Scar weapon. This weapon holds a symbolic value for the vampires who are trying to reunite a few vampires and rebuild the Crimson Scar. She told me about the cavern where the weapon is.
I found the Soul Cavern Lucya was talking about. I need to use her soul gem to open the path to the Crimson Eviscerator.
The path to the Crimson Eviscerator is open, I just need to get rid of the hostile ghosts attacking me and it shall be mine.
Nothing is left between me and the Crimson Eviscerator. I shall take the weapon away from the Crimson Scar's grasp.
I have the Crimson Eviscerator and I know what happened to Lucya. I should head back to the Sanctuary and tell Tenerio all about it.
Lucya showed me the way to the Crimson Eviscerator and I got the weapon for myself.
objectives: Find the soul of Lucya in the Soul Cairn
Enter the Soul Cavern in the Alik'r Desert
Use Lucya's soul gem to open the path
Defeat the protector of the cavern

quests.name: Crimson Scar Believers
journal: Tenerio found out where the vampires are hiding. I should enter their cave and confront them.
The vampires started attacking me as soon as I entered the cave. I have to defend myself.
The vampires were defeated. The Crimson Scar will not be reborn, at least not in the Alik'r Desert. I should tell Tenerio about the success of the operation.
The vampires were defeated. The Crimson Scar will not be reborn, at least not in the Alik'r Desert.

quests.name: Protecting What Was Lost
journal: A girl called Azita challenged me to retrieve her grandfather Azzin's sword that was sealed in the Alik'r Desert. To start the trials, I have to activate the pillar that is in front of the magical barrier in Azzin's Hideout.
I activated the pillar and the trials to retrieve Azzin's sword have started. The little girl said I have to fight dragons and retrieve the stones they bear with them. I should find a dragon first.
I defeated the fire dragon. I have to retrieve the fire stone that it held.
I defeated the fire dragon and retrieved its stone. I now have to face another dragon.
I defeated the frost dragon. I have to retrieve the frost stone that it held.
I defeated the frost dragon and retrieved its stone. I now have to face another dragon.
I defeated the shock dragon. I have to retrieve the shock stone that it held.
I defeated the shock dragon and retrieved its stone. I believe I have everything I need to break the seal in Azzin's Hideout. I should head back there and activate the stones.
I activated the fire pillar in Azzin's Hideout. On to the frost pillar.
I activated the frost pillar in Azzin's Hideout. On to the shock pillar.
I broke the seal protecting Azzin's sword. I can pick it up now.

In the Alik'r Desert was a sword that was protected by a seal, until I broke the seal and took the sword that is a replica of the Boneshaver. A sword that is said to be sharp enough to cut through any foe. The original Boneshaver is thought to have been gifted to the Ra Gada by the god Onsi.
objectives: Interact with the pillar to begin the trials
Pick up the Fire Stone from the Fire Dragon's body
Pick up the Frost Stone from the Frost Dragon's body
Pick up the Shock Stone from the Shock Dragon's body
Use the Fire Stone on the pillar
Use the Frost Stone on the pillar
Use the Shock Stone on the pillar

journal: Za'kir has sent me the location of two caves where he thinks there could be some ghosts wreaking havok. I have to head to the first one.
