I picked up a journal from the Akaviri Cave that was in the Alik'r Desert. I should head to the Wind Scour Temple and give it to Za'kir.
Za'kir has found out that a descendant of a blademaster could still be alive and running from the Thalmor. He has sent me to try to recruit him and get him to safety in the Wind Scour Temple.
Jonathan Seven-Swords is dead. I should head back to the Wind Scour Temple to tell Za'kir that he won't be joining us any time soon.
Za'kir has asked me to burn Azzin's journal to ease his spirit and maybe let him rest. This should stop the appearance of Blades ghosts around the desert.
I burnt Azzin's journal. I should talk to Za'kir again.
The ghost of an ancient Blade, Azzin, had appeared in the Alik'r Desert but I dealt with him for the sake of Loremaster Za'kir.

journal: A courier tracked me down and gave me a letter. I should read it.
I've discovered some forgotten ruins on my own...
A woman named Cassia has written to me, asking for my help in some hidden Dwarven ruins. I should travel to the Reach to investigate.
I should talk to Cassia.
I must take a leap of faith into the city.
I must take a leap of faith into the city.
I should explore the Forgotten City, and then find a way out.
I've found an old man who hanged himself, but he's too old to be Cassia's younger brother.
The key to the Lakehouse door is being guarded by a ghost on the Citadel balcony.
Now that I have the key, I should use it to unlock the Lakehouse.
The door to the Lakehouse looks strange from this side, but I'll have to pass through it to leave.
I've returned to the present and have found Altrius alive and well.
Altrius has suggested I attack the cracked wall in the bathroom.
I should take Altrius to the Citadel bathroom where we should be able to escape the city.
I've escorted Altrius out of the city.
I've concluded my business with Cassia.
I've returned to my original time By convincing the Arbtier to wind back the Dwarves' Law, I prevented the events which sent me back in time.
I have reminded that Altrius was waiting for him. He has suggested we jog up together, so we can chat along the way.
I've brought Altrius to Cassia.
Cassia has rewarded me for returning Altrius to her, and has entered the city.

quests.name: Forget-me-not
journal: I appear to have travelled 20 years into the past, to 1 Last Seed 180E. I will need to find a way to return to my original timeline. Perhaps Metellus, whose magic brought me back here, can help me.
I should follow my guide to Jarl Metellus.
I should talk to Jarl Metellus, on the top floor of the Citadel.
I have refused the Jarl's request to investigate who is a threat to the city. I can talk to him again if I change my mind.

Jarl Metellus has asked me to discreetly work out who is going to trigger the destruction of the city. I will need to talk to each resident, and look around. Once I have settled on a suspect, I should inform him immediately.
You refused Metellus' request to kill your suspect, and will now have to return to your original timeline without his help.
I know that Metellus will make his way to the Lakehouse and sacrifice himself to create a portal back in time. If I follow him there, I should be able to travel back in time again.
Metellus has killed himself to create a portal back in time. I now have no way of returning to my original timeline. However, I could pass through his portal again...
Metellus' death has created a paradox; if he died before creating his portal, I could not have passed through it.  As a result, it appears I have been returned to my original timeline.
The Arbiter has returned me to my own time.

Follow your guide to Jarl Metellus.

lines.name: Gravewind
lines.where: A realm of the dead, entered from Falkreath
lines.begins: I've discovered the remains of an abandoned homestead in the woods of Falkreath, surrounded by graves and strange flowers.
lines.start: LoreRim locks the abandoned homestead north-west of Roadside Ruins, Falkreath. The Cemetery Homestead Key is on Vighar, the vampire in Bloodlet Throne: Dengeir of Stuhn in Falkreath sends you after him (Dark Ancestor). Once inside, you're trapped.
lines.gate: The Cemetery Homestead Key, from Vighar in Bloodlet Throne.
lines.note: LoreRim's own patch (LoreRim Gravewind Start Tweak.esp) adds the lock and the key; the mod page's "walk in" is out of date.

quests.name: Lost to Oblivion
journal: I touched a light left by Richter, letting Gravewind fall into the abyss and freeing the souls enthralled within. I have to escape before I disappear with the rest of the realm.
The house is gone, as if none of it ever happened. Gravewind is no more.

quests.name: In the Pines
journal: I've discovered the remains of an abandoned homestead in the woods of Falkreath, surrounded by graves and strange flowers.
The front door seems to have locked itself behind me, and the basement leads to a dead end. There has to be a key around here... Somewhere.
I've unlocked the door to the house and escaped... Only to discover a landscape that doesn't match the one I came from.

quests.name: Lost in the Woods
journal: After "escaping" the cemetery house, I found myself somewhere I don't recognise. The house and trees are all the same, but the sky... Wherever this is, it isn't Falkreath.
After escaping the pit of bones and tar, I was greeted by an expansive underground city. It looks like someone's trying to burn the place down, and I think I might know who...
I found the writer of the notes, dead. The Temple behind him seems to be my goal, but first I'll have to close the barrier. His note mentions a building opposite the Temple...
I've defeated the Sentinel, only to find the Wraithmother dismounted it and disappeared. A red portal appears... It doesn't seem like I have any other option.
I'm back in Tamriel. Herrah has been consumed by the void, leaving everything with me. Lifesurge, her Axe, her life-stealing Scarlet Cloak... And Gravewind.
objectives: Catch up with the author of the notes.

lines.name: Raven Rock
lines.begins: I've stumbled across a Dark Elf in combat for his life with strange, ashen beings at the Attius Farm outside of Raven Rock. He appears outnumbered, and he's requested I lend him a helping hand.
lines.firstObjective: Kill the ash spawn attacking Captain Veleth

quests.name: March of the Dead
journal: I've stumbled across a Dark Elf in combat for his life with strange, ashen beings at the Attius Farm outside of Raven Rock. He appears outnumbered, and he's requested I lend him a helping hand.

I've stumbled across Captain Modyn Veleth fighting strange beings called "ash spawn" at the Attius Farm outside of Raven Rock. Captain Veleth was outnumbered, so I engaged his attackers and lent him a helping hand.

Captain Veleth explained that the ash spawn have been attacking Raven Rock for some time now, and he's been trying to locate their source. His lack of manpower and reluctance to leave the town without a commander are keeping him from finding out more. As a result of our conversation, I've agreed to help him deal with this situation. I need to begin by searching the Attius Farm for clues that might lead me to the ash spawn's source.

While assisting Captain Veleth at the Attius Farm, I've discovered a strange note. I should give this note to Captain Veleth in order to learn more about the origins of the ash spawn threat to Raven Rock.

Captain Veleth was alarmed by the strange note I recovered from the ash spawn at the Attius Farm. The note mentions Fort Frostmoth, the ruins of an Imperial fort located southeast of Raven Rock. According to him, the fort's been abandoned ever since the eruption of Red Mountain. He's sent me to Fort Frostmoth to kill the author of the note, General Falx Carius, before the town falls prey to his threats.
I've slain General Falx Carius in the ruins of Fort Frostmoth and put an end to any further ash spawn attacking Raven Rock. I should return to Captain Modyn Veleth and inform him of my victory.
I've slain General Falx Carius in the ruins of Fort Frostmoth. I should examine his remains to determine what he was doing here.

According to the letter I found on General Carius' remains, he appeared to be responsible for sending what he calls his "men" to attack the town of Raven Rock. I should bring this information to the guards in Raven Rock and let them know the threat has been eliminated.

I've slain General Falx Carius in the ruins of Fort Frostmoth and put an end to any further ash spawn attacking Raven Rock. Captain Veleth was very pleased with my results, and awarded me a bounty in gold.
objectives: Kill the ash spawn attacking Captain Veleth
Search the Attius Farm for clues
Give the note to Captain Veleth
Bring the note to a guard in Raven Rock
Give the note to Captain Veleth

quests.name: Served Cold
journal: Captain Veleth told me that Adril Arano, Second Councilor of Raven Rock,  wanted to speak to me immediately. I should find him and discover the reason for his urgent message.

Adril Arano has requested my help with what he believes is an imminent threat on Councilor Morvayn's life. He believes members of the Ulen family are present on the island and seek revenge upon Morvayn for executing their ancestor. He's requested that I investigate the identity of any possible assassins, hoping to catch them unaware. For now, I've refused his request, but I should return to Adril when I'm ready to assist him.

Adril Arano has requested my help with what he believes is an imminent threat on Councilor Morvayn's life. He believes members of the Ulen family are present on the island and seek revenge upon Morvayn for executing their ancestor. He's requested that I investigate the identity of any possible assassins, hoping to catch them unaware. Adril suggests that I start by speaking to Geldis Sadri, the innkeeper at the Retching Netch Cornerclub. He's hoping that Geldis, who has quite the reputation as a gossip, might have some useful leads.

Geldis Sadri has pointed out that someone is leaving ash yam offerings in the Ulen Ancestral Tomb even though no Ulens live on Solstheim. He suggests that I stake the tomb out at night and discover the identity of the mystery visitor. Hopefully this person is either the assassin himself or can lead me to the assassin threatening Councilor Morvayn's life.

I discovered Tilisu Severin visiting the Ulen Ancestral Tomb at night. This seems suspicious, as she doesn't belong to the Ulen family by name. I should bring this piece of evidence to Adril Arano immediately.

I've informed Adril Arano that Tilisu Severin was the mystery visitor leaving offerings in the Ulen Ancestral Tomb. Since this is not enough evidence to accuse her of a crime, he's sending me to Severin Manor in order to uncover solid evidence that exposes Tilisu as an assassin.

I've recovered evidence from Severin Manor that exposes the true nature of the Severin family. The letters indicate that Vendil Severin is actually Vendil Ulen and that his supposed wife Tilisu and his daughter Mirri are members of House Hlaalu, one of the Great Houses that opposes Morvayn's House Redoran. All three of them are working in conjunction with unknown forces in a place called "Ashfallow Citadel," to assassinate Councilor Morvayn. I need to bring this urgent revelation to Adril Arano immediately.
Adril Arano has sent me to Ashfallow Citadel to destroy Vendil Ulen and whatever forces he's amassed there. I'm supposed to meet two Redoran Guard outside the ruins who will assist me in this regard.

Adril Arano has sent me to Ashfallow Citadel to destroy Vendil Ulen and whatever forces he's amassed there. I've found the two Redoran Guard I was supposed to meet there dead. I'll have to carry the fight into the ruins alone.

I've killed Vendil Ulen and stopped the threat against Councilor Morvayn. Vendil had hired assassins from Morrowind known as the Morag Tong to help him with his coup, but fortunately I was able to defeat them in the depths of Ashfallow Citadel. I should return to Adril Arano with the good news.
With Vendil Ulen dead and the Morag Tong eliminated, I've ended the threat to Councilor Morvayn and saved Raven Rock.
objectives: Discover the identity of the tomb's visitor
Bring the evidence to Adril Arano
Meet up with the Redoran Guard
End the threat to Councilor Morvayn

quests.name: The Final Descent
journal: I've stumbled across Crescius Caerellius inside of Raven Rock Mine. He's convinced that the mines of Raven Rock contain a secret important enough for him to risk his own life to discover. He appears to have more to tell, so I should listen to what he has to say if I want to learn more.

I've stumbled across Crescius Caerellius inside of Raven Rock Mine. He's convinced that the remains of his great-grandfather, Gratian Caerellius, are at the bottom of the mine and that the East Empire Company has falsely designated his ancestor's death as an accident. He's tasked me with exploring the mine on his behalf to locate the remains, and perhaps discovering what killed Gratian Caerellius.
I've located the skeletal remains of Gratian Caerellius. In his satchel, I've discovered an old journal. In order to return it to Crescius, I'll have to discover a way to escape Bloodskal Barrow.
After locating the remains of Gratian Caerellius, recovering his journal, and escaping Bloodskal Barrow, I should bring the evidence of my discovery to Crescius Caerellius.
I've located Gratian Caerellius' remains and uncovered the truth regarding his untimely death deep inside Bloodskal Barrow.

quests.name: Retaking Thirsk
journal: I met a group of Nords from Thirsk Mead Hall, which has recently been overrun by rieklings. They're camped on the eastern shore of the island, waiting for an opportunity to attack and take back their home.
I've agreed to help the Nords from Thirsk Mead Hall take their home back from the rieklings who have infested it.
I helped the warriors of Thirsk Mead Hall retake their home from the infestation of rieklings.

I helped the warriors of Thirsk Mead Hall retake their home from the infestation of rieklings. Their leader, Bujold, has asked me to accompany her to Hrothmund's Barrow, where she hopes to receive the blessing of Thirsk's founder to continue her leadership.

I helped the warriors of Thirsk Mead Hall retake their home from the infestation of rieklings. Their leader, Bujold, asked me to accompany her to Hrothmund's Barrow, where she was denied the blessings of Thirsk's founder. She expressed a desire to lead the hall anyway, and when I opposed her fraud, she attacked me.

I helped the warriors of Thirsk Mead Hall retake their home from the infestation of rieklings. Their leader, Bujold, asked me to accompany her to Hrothmund's Barrow, where she was denied the blessings of Thirsk's founder. She expressed a desire to lead the hall anyway, and plans to begin a new tradition at Thirsk, focused on the present instead of the past.

I helped the warriors of Thirsk Mead Hall retake their home from the infestation of rieklings. Their leader, Bujold, asked me to accompany her to Hrothmund's Barrow, where she was denied the blessings of Thirsk's founder. She expressed a desire to lead the hall anyway, and when I opposed her fraud, she became enraged. I was forced to kill her to defend myself.
I met a group of Nords who had been exiled from their former home in Thirsk Mead Hall, but chose to help the rieklings keep them permanently evicted.
objectives: Join the assault on Thirsk Mead Hall

quests.name: The Chief of Thirsk Hall
journal: I've found a group of rieklings who seem to have taken up residence in Thirsk Mead Hall. Somehow, their chief has learned how to speak intelligently, and has asked me to assist them with a number of small favors.

I've found a group of rieklings who seem to have taken up residence in Thirsk Mead Hall. Somehow, their chief has learned how to speak intelligently, and after I did a number of small favors for the tribe, asked me to help them kill the group of Nords who formerly lived in the hall.

I found a group of rieklings who took over Thirsk Mead Hall. I did a number of favors for them, and their chief attacked me, thinking I was attempting to usurp him. After I defeated him, the rest of the tribe welcomed me, and they made me their chief.
I found a group of rieklings who took over Thirsk Mead Hall, but chose not to help them.

lines.name: Neloth of Tel Mithryn
lines.begins: Neloth has asked me to locate his steward, Varona Nelas. She is probably somewhere around Tel Mithryn.

quests.name: Reluctant Steward
journal: Neloth has asked me to locate his steward, Varona Nelas. She is probably somewhere around Tel Mithryn.
Neloth has asked me to locate his steward, Varona Nelas. Last time anyone in Tel Mithryn saw her, she was on her way to Raven Rock.
Neloth asked me to locate his steward, Varona Nelas. I found her body on the road to Raven Rock.
I found Neloth's steward, Varona, dead on the road to Raven Rock.
I found Varona's dead body on the road to Raven Rock, apparently killed by ash spawn. Now Neloth wants me to find someone in Raven Rock willing to be his new steward.

Neloth asked me to locate his steward, Varona Nelas. I found her dead body on the road to Raven Rock. Now Neloth wants me to find someone in Raven Rock willing to be his new steward. I've heard Drovas Relvi might be willing.

Neloth asked me to locate his steward, Varona Nelas. I found her dead body on the road to Raven Rock. Neloth sent me to Raven Rock to find a new steward. I found Drovas Relvi, who seemed very eager to take the position.
objectives: Tell Neloth that Varona is dead

quests.name: A New Debt
journal: Someone named Mogrul sent a messenger for me. This Mogrul wants to talk.
Helping Drovas has come back to bite me. He owed a money lender named Mogrul 1000 septims. Now Mogrul expects me to pay Drovas' debt. If I don't, he's going to keep sending thugs after me.
Helping Drovas has come back to bite me. He owed a money lender named Mogrul 1000 septims. Mogrul expected me to pay Drovas debt, which I've done.
Helping Drovas has come back to bite me. He owed a money lender named Mogrul 1000 septims. Mogrul expected me to pay Drovas debt. However, I killed him instead.
Helping Drovas has come back to bite me. He owed a money lender named Mogrul 1000 septims. I persuaded him to take half that.

quests.name: Old Friends
journal: Neloth is being attacked by an unknown assailant. He gave me a ring that will identify the source of the attacks. If I walk around the grounds of Tel Mithryn, I might find a clue.
Neloth is being attacked by an unknown assailant. He gave me a ring that identified the source of the attacks as a heart stone hidden in the grave of Ildari Sarothril.

Neloth is being attacked by an unknown assailant. I discovered the source of the attacks was a heart stone hidden in Ildari Sarothril's grave. Neloth has divined that his former apprentice is still alive and seeking vengeance on him. Neloth asked me to track down and kill Ildari.
Neloth's former apprentice, Ildari Sarothril, was covertly attacking him. Deep under Highpoint Tower I confronted Ildari and killed her.
objectives: Find the source of the attacks

quests.name: From the Ashes
journal: Talvas has asked me to destroy an Ash Guardian that is running amok on the Tel Mithryn grounds.
I've encountered an Ash Guardian that is running amok on the Tel Mithryn grounds.
I destroyed the Ash Guardian that Talvas had accidentally summoned. He was quite grateful.

quests.name: Healing a House
journal: Part of the Telvanni tower at Tel Mithryn is withered. Elynea needs three taproots soaked in the headwaters of the Harstrad river to repair it.

Part of the Telvanni tower at Tel Mithryn is withered. Elynea needs three taproots soaked in the headwaters of Harstrad river to repair it. Elynea kept two taproots for herself and told me to plant the last one in the withered part of the tower wall.
I helped Elynea repair the withered tower of Tel Mithryn by planting taproots in the wall that had been soaked in the headwaters of Harstrad river.

quests.name: Lost Knowledge
journal: Neloth has located another of Hermaeus Mora's Black Books in <Alias=Dungeon>. He intends to read it as soon as I bring it to him.
I retrieved one of Hermaeus Mora's Black Books from <Alias=Dungeon> for Neloth.

quests.name: Heart Stones
journal: Neloth asked me to find a heart stone for his research.

quests.name: Telvanni Research
journal: Neloth is doing research on ash spawn. He's asked me to bring him a sample of the ash from one using a special extraction tool.
Neloth is doing research on ash spawn. I've taken a sample of the ash from one using a special extraction tool.
Neloth is doing research on ash spawn. I brought him a sample of the ash from one using a special extraction tool.
objectives: Collect ash from an ash spawn

quests.name: Wind and Sand
journal: Neloth has asked me to get a copy Wind and Sand from inside <Alias=Dungeon>. He needs it for his spell research.
I found a copy of Wind and Sand from inside <alias=dungeon>. Neloth needs it for his spell research.
I found a copy of Wind and Sand from inside <alias=dungeon>. Neloth needed it for his spell research. I should be able to buy the spell from Talvas.
objectives: Get the Wind and Sand book

quests.name: Experimental Subject
journal: I let Neloth cast an experimental spell on me. If I discover any side effects, I should tell him right away.
I let Neloth cast an experimental spell on me. I've discovered a potentially dangerous side effect. Normally it boosts my health, but if I am in the rain or swim, it reduces my health.
Neloth asked me to be a test subject for one of his experiments. I refused.

quests.name: Briarheart Necropsy
journal: Neloth has asked me to examine a Briarheart warrior of the Forsworn tribes. He couldn't direct me to a specific one, but he said they live in the hills on the western edge of Skyrim.
Neloth has asked me to examine a Briarheart warrior of the Forsworn tribes. I found one and saw how the heart was implanted.

quests.name: Azra's Staffs
journal: Neloth has asked me to retrieve one of Azra Nightwielder's staffs. It's hidden in <alias=dungeon>.
Neloth has asked me to retrieve one of Azra Nightwielder's staffs. It was hidden in <alias=dungeon>.
Neloth asked me to retrieve one of Azra Nightwielder's staffs from <alias=dungeon>.

lines.name: Skaal Village
lines.begins: I met Tharstan, a historian living in Skaal Village who discovered the recently unearthed entrance to an old crypt. He offered to hire me as protection while we explored the crypt, and asked me to meet him there if I was interested.

quests.name: Lost Legacy
journal: I met Tharstan, a historian living in Skaal Village who discovered the recently unearthed entrance to an old crypt. He offered to hire me as protection while we explored the crypt, and asked me to meet him there if I was interested.

I met Tharstan, a historian living in Skaal Village who discovered the recently unearthed entrance to an old crypt. He offered to hire me as protection while we explored the crypt, and asked me to meet him there if I was interested.

I arrived at the old tomb to find Tharstan waiting for me. He was eager to start exploring the place, and he asked me to lead the way. First, I need to figure out how to open the doors in the main chamber. Once that's done, we can explore the tunnels beyond.

I met Tharstan, a Nord from Skaal Village who discovered an old draugr crypt. I agreed to accompany him in exploring the old crypt. After we discovered a pair of word walls, as well as two pieces of an ancient claw, we gained entry into a sealed chamber. Tharstan's translations suggest that we'll find a dragon priest's sarcophagus nearby.

I met Tharstan, a Nord from Skaal Village who discovered an old draugr crypt. I agreed to accompany him in exploring the old crypt. Inside, we found the tomb of a dragon priest left behind long ago to guard against a traitor from his own order.

I met a historian named Tharstan in Skaal Village and he hired me to help him explore an old tomb he'd discovered. It turned out to the tomb of a dragon priest named Vahlok, who I fought and defeated.

quests.name: A New Source of Stalhrim
journal: Baldor Iron-Shaper, the smith in Skaal Village, has gone missing. One of the other villagers, Deor, said he saw two elves dragging something through the woods on the day of Baldor's disappearance. They were heading southwest.

Baldor Iron-Shaper, the smith in Skaal Village, was abducted by the Thalmor. They were trying to get him to reveal the secret of forging stalhrim. Baldor told me that the Thalmor leader, Ancarion, had a map that showed the location of a new source of stalhrim, and he asked me to retrieve it.

Baldor Iron-Shaper, the smith in Skaal Village, was abducted by the Thalmor. They were trying to get him to reveal the secret of forging stalhrim. Baldor told me that the Thalmor leader, Ancarion, had a map that showed the location of a new source of stalhrim, and I retrieved it. Now I need to bring it back to Baldor.

Baldor Iron-Shaper, the smith in Skaal Village, was abducted by the Thalmor. They were trying to get him to reveal the secret of forging stalhrim. Baldor told me that the Thalmor leader, Ancarion, had a map that showed the location of a new source of stalhrim. I returned the map to Baldor and in gratitude, he offered to let me use his forge, where I can craft new items made from stalhrim.

lines.name: Deathbrand
lines.begins: At Haknir's Shoal, a band of pirates uncovered an ancient treasure chest containing a single piece of stalhrim armor. How did they know to dig in this remote spot?

quests.name: Deathbrand
journal: At Haknir's Shoal, a band of pirates uncovered an ancient treasure chest containing a single piece of stalhrim armor. How did they know to dig in this remote spot?

A band of pirates followed an ancient treasure map to Haknir's Shoal, where they discovered a chest at the location marked on the map. By following the map, perhaps I can find the rest of the treasure they sought.

A band of pirates followed an ancient treasure map to Haknir's Shoal, where they found a chest containing a piece of the armor of Haknir Death-Brand, the legendary pirate king. By following their map, perhaps I can find the rest of the treasure they sought.

By following an ancient treasure map, I found the armor of Haknir Death-Brand, the legendary pirate king. In addition to his armor, one chest also contained the key to Gyldenhul Barrow. Could it be connected to Haknir's treasure?

By following an ancient treasure map, I found the armor of Haknir Death-Brand, the legendary pirate king. A key contained in one of the chests led me to Gyldenhul Barrow, where I found a room filled with Haknir's cursed gold. But touching it triggered the curse: the doors behind me have sealed.

By following an ancient treasure map, I found the armor of Haknir Death-Brand, the legendary pirate king. A key contained in one of the chests led me to Gyldenhul Barrow, where I found his tomb and one of his cursed swords. But when I touched the sword, his ghost appeared and attacked.

By following an ancient treasure map, I found the armor of Haknir Death-Brand, the legendary pirate king. A key contained in one of the chests led me to Gyldenhul Barrow, where I defeated Haknir's ghost and claimed his swords and gold as well.
objectives: Learn more about the buried treasure
Use the Deathbrand Treasure Map to find the treasure

lines.name: Unearthed
lines.begins: Outside Kolbjorn Barrow, I met Ralis Sedarys, an explorer who came to Solstheim in search of relics within the barrow. But when he arrived, he found it buried by the ash. He had all but given up on excavating it, but if I can supply the funds, he offered to make me a partner in his expedition.
lines.firstObjective: Fund the excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow (1000 gold)

quests.name: Unearthed
journal: Outside Kolbjorn Barrow, I met Ralis Sedarys, an explorer who came to Solstheim in search of relics within the barrow. But when he arrived, he found it buried by the ash. He had all but given up on excavating it, but if I can supply the funds, he offered to make me a partner in his expedition.

Ralis Sedarys came to Solstheim in search of the Relics of Ahzidal, powerful items said to have been sealed in Kolbjorn Barrow, but found it buried by ash. I agreed to fund his expedition to excavate the barrow. He set to work, saying he'd send a courier when he had progress to report.
I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow. I should visit the site and see how the work is going.

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the dig has come to a halt. The excavation had reached a dead end when draugr within the tomb awoke, killing several miners and causing the rest to flee.

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the dig has come to a halt. The excavation had reached a dead end when draugr within the tomb awoke, killing several miners and causing the rest to flee. I defeated the draugr, but now need to find a way past the dead end.

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the dig has come to a halt. The excavation had reached a dead end when draugr within the tomb awoke, killing several miners and causing the rest to flee. I found a way past the dead end, but must deal with the draugr before work can continue.
I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the dig has come to a halt. At his request, I defeated the draugr and found a way past the dead end.
I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but in order to continue, he needs more gold to hire replacements for the workers that have been killed.
I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow. He told me to return in a few days to see how work was progressing.
I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow. I should return and see how the work is going.

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the site has stopped. Most of the miners were killed by another wave of draugr attacks, and two more are unaccounted for.

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the site has stopped. Most of the miners were killed by another wave of draugr attacks, and two more are unaccounted for. I dealt with the draugr, but still need to locate the missing miners.

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the site has stopped. Most of the miners were killed by another wave of draugr attacks, and two more were unaccounted for. I found the bodies of the missing miners, but still need to deal with the draugr threat.
I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but work on the site has stopped. At his request, I dealt with the draugr and found the bodies of the missing miners.
I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but the ongoing draugr attacks means he needs more gold in order to hire more miners and guards to protect them.
I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow. He told me to return in a few days to see how work was progressing.
I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow. I should return and see how the work is going.

I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow, but draugr have attacked the miners again, and only a few managed to escape. Ralis asked if I could wipe them out so the excavation could continue.
I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow, but draugr again attacked the miners. Once again, I slew the draugr so work could proceed.
I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' expedition to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow, but once again, he needs more gold to hire increasingly reluctant miners and guards to work on the site.
I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow. He told me to return in a few days to see how work was progressing.
I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow. I should return and see how the work is going.
I agreed to continue funding Ralis Sedarys' ill-fated excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow, but when I returned to his mining camp, I found only blood and corpses. Ralis himself was nowhere to be seen.

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' ill-fated excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow, but when I returned to his mining camp, I found only blood and corpses. Deep within the barrow, I found Ralis performing a ritual to release Ahzidal, the dragon priest that had been sealed there.

I agreed to fund Ralis Sedarys' ill-fated excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow, but when I returned to his mining camp, I found only blood and corpses. Deep within the barrow, I found Ralis performing a ritual that released Ahzidal, a powerful dragon priest I fought and defeated.

Ralis Sedarys came to Solstheim hoping to find the Relics of Ahzidal and release their maker from his imprisonment in Kolbjorn Barrow. When he found the barrow buried by the ash, he convinced me to fund its excavation, using the miners as blood sacrifices for his rituals. I saw through his lies and decided to kill him for his crimes.

Ralis Sedarys came to Solstheim hoping to find the Relics of Ahzidal and release their maker from his imprisonment in Kolbjorn Barrow. When he found the barrow buried by the ash, he convinced me to fund its excavation, using the miners as blood sacrifices for his rituals. I saw through his lies and killed him for his crimes.

Ralis Sedarys came to Solstheim hoping to find the Relics of Ahzidal, but fell under the spell of their maker, a powerful dragon priest entombed in the barrow. He convinced me to fund its excavation, but was compelled by Ahzidal to use the miners as ritual sacrifices. Ralis had no control over his actions, so I allowed him to live and depart the barrow in peace.

lines.name: Filial Bonds
lines.begins: I met Wulf Wild-Blood, whose brother disappeared many years ago. Wulf believes he may have become a werebear, and warned me to keep an eye out for him.

quests.name: Filial Bonds
journal: I met Wulf Wild-Blood, whose brother disappeared many years ago. Wulf believes he may have become a werebear, and warned me to keep an eye out for him.

I met Wulf Wild-Blood, who told me about his brother Torkild running off many years ago. Wulf's worst fears of his brother proved true, unfortunately. I found Torkild wandering Solstheim, out of his mind. I killed him before he could hurt me, and should tell Wulf the sad news.

I met Wulf Wild-Blood, who told me about his brother Torkild running off many years ago. Wulf's worst fears of his brother proved true, unfortunately. I found Torkild wandering Solstheim, out of his mind. Before my eyes, he transformed into a werebear, and attacked. I was forced to kill him to defend myself. I should tell Wulf the sad news.

I met Wulf Wild-Blood, who told me about his brother Torkild running off many years ago. Wulf's worst fears of his brother proved true, unfortunately. I found Torkild wandering Solstheim, out of his mind, and I killed him before he could hurt me. I told Wulf the sad story of his brother's final chapters, and he taught me how to fight better for setting his mind to rest.

I met Wulf Wild-Blood, who told me about his brother Torkild running off many years ago. Wulf's worst fears of his brother proved true, unfortunately. I found Torkild wandering Solstheim, out of his mind. Before my eyes, he transformed into a werebear, and attacked. I was forced to kill him to defend myself. I told Wulf the sad story of his brother's final chapters, and he taught me how to fight better for setting his mind to rest.
I met Wulf Wild-Blood, who told me about his brother Torkild running off many years ago. Wulf died before I could help him learn the truth about his brother.

quests.name: Miasma
journal: I met an Argonian called Haj-Xul at The Retching Netch in Raven Rock. He claims he is a member of the An-Xileel clan in Black Marsh and has hired me to assist him in capturing a criminal from House Telvanni who might have recently arrived in Solstheim.
I managed to find and defeat Zirath Ryon in the depths of the Ashbound Prison. However, the exit locked itself behind me, leaving me trapped unless I find a different way out.

I managed to defeat both Zirath Ryon and Durvith, the dragon priest who lured him to Solstheim in the first place, securing the power of Miasma for myself. For my efforts, Haj-Xul awarded me with his personal bow and named me a friend of the An-Xileel.

lines.begins: Destroy Ahzidal

quests.name: Destroy the Acolyte Priests
journal: <Alias.ShortName=Storn> has said that to ensure the land is completely cleansed of Miraak's influence, I should seek out and destroy his three Acolyte Priests, who are each sealed within different tombs around the island of Solstheim.

I have destroyed the three Acolyte Priests, who were each sealed within different tombs around the island of Solstheim. With their destruction, the land is closer to being completely cleansed of Miraak's influence.

quests.name: The Forsworn Conspiracy
journal: I've received a note from a man named Eltrys in Markarth. He wants me to meet him at the Shrine of Talos, presumably to talk about the recent incident in Markarth's marketplace.
Eltrys has asked me to uncover evidence surrounding the woman in Markarth's marketplace, who was attacked in broad daylight by a man claiming to be a member of the Forsworn.
Eltrys is dead, and I've been framed for his murder. My only option to clear my name is to let myself be imprisoned inside Cidhna Mine and locate Madanach, the King in Rags.
Eltrys is dead, and I've been framed for his murder. My only option to clear my name is to let myself be imprisoned inside Cidhna Mine and locate Madanach, the King in Rags.

quests.name: No One Escapes Cidhna Mine
journal: I'm imprisoned inside Cidhna Mine, framed for Eltrys' murder. I have to find Madanach, the King in Rags, and clear my name.
I have helped Madanach escape Cidhna Mine, and he and his Forsworn have taken credit for all my past crime, clearing my name in The Reach.
Thonar Silver-Blood has granted me a pardon for killing Madanach. My name has now been cleared in The Reach.

quests.name: Shiv
objectives: Talk to Grisvar about getting a shiv
Get a bottle of Skooma for Grisvar

quests.name: DialogueCidhnaMine
objectives: Mine Silver Ore to serve your time

lines.name: Promises to Keep
lines.begins: Louis Letrush wants a message taken to Sibbi Black-Briar.

quests.name: Promises to Keep
journal: Louis Letrush wants a message taken to Sibbi Black-Briar.
Louis Letrush wants me to ask Sibbi Black-Briar about Frost, a breeding horse Letrush is buying.
Sibbi Black-Briar has asked me to steal Frost and deliver him to Louis Letrush.
I have been rewarded by Louis Letrush for stealing Frost from Black-Briar Lodge.
I have been rewarded by Louis Letrush for stealing Frost from Black-Briar Lodge.

lines.name: Unfathomable Depths
lines.begins: A disturbed Argonian named From-Deepest-Fathoms was wandering the Riften docks. She wanted me to take something she referred to as a Lexicon back to Avanchnzel.

quests.name: Unfathomable Depths
journal: A disturbed Argonian named From-Deepest-Fathoms was wandering the Riften docks. She wanted me to take something she referred to as a Lexicon back to Avanchnzel.
A disturbed Argonian named From-Deepest-Fathoms was wandering the Riften docks. She insisted I take the Lexicon she gave me back to Avanchnzel.
I've returned the Lexicon given to me by From-Deepest-Fathoms to Avanchnzel.

lines.name: The Wolf Queen Awakened
lines.begins: A representative from Dragon Bridge has appealed to the court in Solitude for help investigating Wolfskull Cave. Falk Firebeard is looking for someone to look into the issue.
lines.firstObjective: Ask Falk Firebeard about Wolfskull Cave

quests.name: The Man Who Cried Wolf
journal: A representative from Dragon Bridge has appealed to the court in Solitude for help investigating Wolfskull Cave. Falk Firebeard is looking for someone to look into the issue.
A representative from Dragon Bridge has appealed to the court in Solitude for help investigating Wolfskull Cave. Falk Firebeard has asked me to clear out the cave.
I have confronted and stopped a group of necromancers attempting to summon Potema, the Wolf Queen, in Wolfskull Cave. I should return to Falk Firebeard with the news.
objectives: Ask Falk Firebeard about Wolfskull Cave

quests.name: The Wolf Queen Awakened
journal: Potema has been summoned from beyond the grave and is gathering power. Falk has sent me to Styrr to get the key to Potema's Catacombs.

Potema has been summoned from beyond the grave and is gathering power. Styrr has given me the key to Potema's Catacombs. I must enter the catacombs and prevent Potema from fully resurrecting by acquiring her bones.
Potema has been summoned from beyond the grave. I've defeated her in the Catacombs and retrieved her bones. I must return them to Styrr for blessing and tell Falk Potema has been defeated.
I have defeated Potema and been rewarded by Falk Firebeard.

lines.name: Lights Out!
lines.begins: Jaree-Ra on the Solitude docks has an offer for me.

quests.name: Lights Out!
journal: Jaree-Ra on the Solitude docks has an offer for me.
Jaree-Ra on the Solitude docks has an offer for me. It seemed suspicious, so I reported him to Captain Aldis. However, I need to find evidence before action can be taken.
Jaree-Ra has asked me to put out the Solitude Lighthouse fire.
I found out that Jaree-Ra was conspiring with bandits and trying to take advantage of me. I should either confront him or report this to the guards.
I discovered that Jaree-Ra was trying to take advantage of me, but I persuaded him to become partners. Now I need to put out the Solitude Lighthouse fire.
I uncovered Jaree-Ra's plans to conspire with the Blackblood Marauders and he will be arrested.
I've put out the Solitude Lighthouse fire. I must return to Jaree-Ra and find out if a ship has crashed.
Jaree-Ra found out that I killed his sister Deeja and turned on me. I must defeat Jaree-Ra.
When I went to meet Jaree-Ra at the docks, he turned on me. I must defeat Jaree-Ra.
I've put out the Solitude Lighthouse fire and the Icerunner has failed to dock. I am to head up Solitude's eastern shoreline to find where it's run aground and meet Deeja.
I killed Jaree-Ra at the Solitude docks. Now I should head up Solitude's eastern shoreline to find where the Icerunner has run aground.
I've put out the Solitude Lighthouse fire and the Icerunner has run aground. When I went to meet Deeja at the wreck, she turned on me. I must defeat Deeja to retrieve my share of the loot.
Jaree-Ra has betrayed me and taken the loot from the Icerunner. I've defeated his sister Deeja, now I must track down Jaree-Ra.
Jaree-Ra has betrayed me and taken the loot from the Icerunner to Camp Broken Oar. I must defeat Jaree-Ra.
I have defeated Jaree-Ra and his bandits.
Jaree-Ra is dead. The Icerunner should be able to dock safely.
I uncovered Jaree-Ra's plans to conspire with the Blackblood Marauders and persuaded him to give up.
I worked together with Jaree-Ra and the Blackblood Marauders to take the loot from the crashed Icerunner.
I betrayed Jaree-Ra and the Blackblood Marauders so that I could take the loot from the Icerunner for myself.
I uncovered Jaree-Ra's plans to conspire with the Blackblood Marauders and he has been arrested.
objectives: Report Jaree-Ra to the guard captain
Find evidence of Jaree-Ra's criminal activity
Put out the fire in the Solitude Lighthouse
Report Jaree-Ra to the guard captain
Find Deeja at the Wreck of the Icerunner
Travel to the Wreck of the Icerunner
Find out where Jaree-Ra's bandits took the loot

lines.name: In My Time Of Need
lines.begins: A group of men calling themselves the Alik'r are looking for a Redguard woman in Whiterun.

quests.name: In My Time Of Need
journal: A group of men calling themselves the Alik'r are looking for a Redguard woman in Whiterun.

The barmaid at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun is apparently a fugitive noble from Hammerfell. She claims that she is on the run from assassins sent by rival houses in her homeland and needs someone to stop them before they find her.

The leader of the so-called "assassins" I've been asked to eliminate claims that Iman betrayed her people to the Dominion and they are here to bring her to justice. I've agreed to lead her into an ambush at the Whiterun stables.
I've helped Iman escape the clutches of the Alik'r sent after her. With their leader defeated, she believes the rest of them will scatter, affording her some much-needed safety for now.
After making arrangements with Kematu, I've delivered Iman to him. He assures me that she will be taken back to Hammerfell alive, though after that her fate is no longer in his hands.
objectives: Inform the Alik'r of Saadia's location
Inform the Alik'r of Iman's location
Find a way to enter the Alik'r hideout
Kill Kematu or talk to him
Kill Kematu OR Convince Iman to meet Kematu
Lead Iman to the Whiterun Stables

lines.name: Missing In Action
lines.begins: Fralia Gray-Mane in Whiterun is convinced that her missing son, Thorald, is still alive and being held captive. She's asked me to visit her at her home to speak privately about the matter.
lines.firstObjective: Meet Fralia at her home in the evening.

quests.name: Missing In Action
journal: Fralia Gray-Mane in Whiterun is convinced that her missing son, Thorald, is still alive and being held captive. She's asked me to visit her at her home to speak privately about the matter.
Avulstein Gray-Mane believes his brother Thorald has been taken prisoner, and that the Battle-Borns of Whiterun have proof. I need to find it and bring it to Avulstein.
After being convinced to help by the Gray-Mane family, I've found evidence that Thorald Gray-Mane is still alive, and is being held in Northwatch Keep. Avulstein will want to see this right away.

After being convinced to help, and finding proof that he is still alive, I've offered to try and free Thorald Gray-Mane from Northwatch Keep, a Thalmor controlled fort on the northwestern coast, to prevent bloodshed on either side.

Now that I have found proof that his brother still lives, Avulstein Gray-Mane insists on assaulting Northwatch Keep, a Thalmor controlled fort on the northwestern coast, to rescue Thorald. I've agreed to meet him outside the Keep to assist in the fight.
Thorald Gray-Mane is indeed alive. Now I have to get him away from Northwatch Keep and make sure he stays safe.

Thorald Gray-Mane has been successfully retrieved from Northwatch Keep. Fearing for the safety of his family, he cannot return to Whiterun, and has asked me to deliver a message to his mother: "Suffer the winter's cold wind, for it bears aloft next summer's seeds."
Fralia Gray-Mane is grateful that her son Thorald is alive and well.
Fralia Gray-Mane is grateful that her son Thorald is alive and well.
objectives: Meet Fralia at her home in the evening.
Meet Jon Battle-Born at Talos' statue
Find a way to release Thorald from Thalmor custody

lines.name: Rise in the East
lines.begins: The East Empire Company is being harassed by a group of pirates and would like me to help shut them down. Orthus Endario, in the Windhelm office, has asked me to help get rid of this problem. If I do, the Windhelm office can re-open, and there should be some money in it for me.
lines.firstObjective: Steal Suvaris Atheron's logbook. She works in Windhelm's Clan Shatter-Shield Office.

quests.name: Rise in the East
journal: The East Empire Company is being harassed by a group of pirates and would like me to help shut them down. Orthus Endario, in the Windhelm office, has asked me to help get rid of this problem. If I do, the Windhelm office can re-open, and there should be some money in it for me.
I've helped Orthus Endario to re-open the Windhelm Office of the East Empire Company by eliminating the Blood Horker base at Japhet's Folly.
objectives: Steal Suvaris Atheron's logbook. She works in Windhelm's Clan Shatter-Shield Office.
Talk to Stig Salt-Plank in Dawnstar
Find Adelaisa Vendicci on the Windhelm docks and depart for Japhet's Folly
Report back to Adelaisa on the Japhet's Folly docks
Speak to Adelaisa to return to Windhelm

lines.name: Blood on the Ice
lines.begins: Windhelm is plagued by a shadowy killer. I've been asked to help investigate the latest murder.

quests.name: Blood on the Ice
journal: Windhelm is plagued by a shadowy killer. I've been asked to help investigate the latest murder.
Windhelm is plagued by a shadowy killer. I've been asked to help investigate the latest murder. <Alias=AuthorityFigure>, the steward, may have advice from time to time.
Windhelm is plagued by a shadowy killer. I have broken in to Hjerim and should investigate anything of interest.
Windhelm is plagued by a shadowy killer. I have entered Hjerim and should investigate anything of interest.
Windhelm is plagued by a shadowy killer. After entering Hjerim, I found something of interest and should follow up on the clues.
I discovered that Wuunferth the Unliving was the Butcher of Windhelm, and helped bring him to justice.
I discovered that Calixto Corrium was the Butcher of Windhelm, and helped bring him to justice.
objectives: Follow up on the clues from Hjerim
Patrol the streets of the Stone Quarter at night

quests.name: Blood on the Ice
journal: The Butcher has struck again in Windhelm, after Wuunferth the Unliving was imprisoned. It appears he may have been innocent. I need to find the real killer.
I discovered that Calixto Corrium was the true Butcher of Windhelm, helped bring him to justice, and exonerated Wuunferth.
objectives: Patrol the streets of the Stone Quarter at night

lines.name: The White Phial
lines.begins: The alchemist of Windhelm, Nurelion, has asked me to find the legendary White Phial for him.

quests.name: The White Phial
journal: The alchemist of Windhelm, Nurelion, has asked me to find the legendary White Phial for him.
I retrieved the White Phial for Nurelion, but it was damaged beyond repair. His assistant, Quintus, still paid me my reward, though.

quests.name: Repairing the Phial
journal: Nurelion's assistant, Quintus, believes he's found a way to repair the White Phial.
Nurelion's assistant, Quintus, believes he's found a way to repair the White Phial, and has enlisted me to track down some materials for him.
I helped repair the White Phial in time for Nurelion to see it before he died.

lines.name: The Golden Claw
lines.begins: Lucan Valerius in Riverwood is offering me a gold reward if I retrieve his antique Golden Claw, stolen by bandits camped in Bleak Falls Barrow.

quests.name: The Golden Claw
journal: Lucan Valerius in Riverwood is offering me a gold reward if I retrieve his antique Golden Claw, stolen by bandits camped in Bleak Falls Barrow.
Camilla Valerius in Riverwood is offering me a gold reward if I retrieve her antique Golden Claw, stolen by bandits camped in Bleak Falls Barrow.
I've overheard a group of bandits talking about a golden claw that they've recently stolen. Apparently, one of the bandits has taken the claw further into Bleak Falls Barrow.
I have returned the Golden Claw to Lucan, who rewarded me for my effort.
I have returned the Golden Claw to Camilla, who rewarded me for my effort.
I kept the Golden Claw, and convinced Lucan Valerius that it was lost.
I kept the Golden Claw, and convinced Camilla Valerius that it was lost.
Camilla and Lucan Valerius are dead. Any chance of getting a reward from them for retrieving the golden claw died with them.
objectives: Find the secret of Bleak Falls Barrow
Find the owner of the Golden Claw

lines.name: Laid to Rest
lines.begins: A mysterious fire killed Hroggar's wife and child. Hroggar took Alva as a lover immediately after the fire, and many in the town think he did it. The Jarl might pay me to investigate it.
lines.firstObjective: Talk to the Jarl of Morthal

quests.name: Laid to Rest
journal: A mysterious fire killed Hroggar's wife and child. Hroggar took Alva as a lover immediately after the fire, and many in the town think he did it. The Jarl might pay me to investigate it.
Morthal's Jarl has asked me to investigate the house fire that killed Hroggar's wife and child. Hroggar took Alva as a lover immediately after the fire, and many in the town think he did it.
Morthal's Jarl has asked me to investigate the death of Hroggar's wife and child. Hroggar took Alva as a lover immediately afterward. I suspect she may be a vampire, but I need proof for the Jarl.

Morthal's Jarl has asked me to investigate the house fire that killed Hroggar's wife and child. The vampire Alva enslaved Hroggar and had his family killed in a house fire. Alva's master in Movarth's Lair plans to enslave the entire town.

Morthal's Jarl asked me to investigate the house fire that killed Hroggar's wife and child. The vampire Alva enslaved Hroggar and had his family killed in a house fire. Alva's master in Movarth's Lair plans to enslave the entire town. The Jarl now wants me to destroy Movarth and put an end to his plot.

Morthal's Jarl asked me to investigate the house fire that killed Hroggar's wife and child. The vampire Alva enslaved Hroggar and had his family killed in a house fire. Alva's master in Movarth's Lair planned to enslave the entire town.
objectives: Talk to the Jarl of Morthal
Show Alva's Journal to the Jarl

lines.name: A Return To Your Roots
lines.begins: I've discovered an unusual ingredient called crimson nirnroot.
lines.firstObjective: Discover the significance of Crimson Nirnroot

quests.name: A Return To Your Roots
journal: I've discovered an unusual ingredient called crimson nirnroot.

I've discovered the remains of Sinderion, an alchemist from Skingrad in Cyrodiil. He was exploring Blackreach in search of the crimson nirnroot, and appeared to be on the brink of an amazing discovery.

I have brought my crimson nirnroot to Avrusa Sarethi, a former student of Sinderion. She was overjoyed that I was able to complete Sinderion's field work and pledged to continue his research in his memory.
objectives: Discover the significance of Crimson Nirnroot
Bring <Global=NN01Total> Crimson Nirnroot to Avrusa Sarethi

lines.name: The Heart of Dibella
lines.begins: I have received a letter inviting me to visit the Temple of Dibella.

quests.name: The Heart of Dibella
journal: I have received a letter inviting me to visit the Temple of Dibella.
After speaking to a priestess named Senna, I have been instructed to wait for Mother Hamal, the high priestess of the temple.
I must now talk to Mother Hamal and find out what's going on.
I have agreed to find the young girl who will be their next Sybil. It's been prophesied that she lives in the village of Karthwasten, to the north of Markarth.
I have agreed to find the young girl who will be their next Sybil. The girl must be rescued from the Forsworn who have kidnapped her.
After rescuing her from the Fosworn, I must now bring Fjotra, the next Sybil of the Temple of Dibella, to the priestesses in Markarth.
I have been instructed to pray at the sacred fountain of Dibella to receive my blessing.
I rescued the new Sybil of the Temple of Dibella from the Forsworn and received a blessing from Dibella.
I stole a statue from the Temple of Dibella and sold it to the beggar Degaine.
I refused to help the priestesses of the Temple of Dibella. Whatever it was they were up to, I want no part of it.
objectives: Find the future Sybil of Dibella

lines.name: The Blessings of Nature
lines.begins: I've agreed to help Danica Pure-Spring repair the Gildergreen, the large tree outside the Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun.

quests.name: The Blessings of Nature
journal: I've agreed to help Danica Pure-Spring repair the Gildergreen, the large tree outside the Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun.
I helped Danica Pure-Spring repair the Gildergreen, a large tree central to the worship of Kynareth in Skyrim.
I brought a sapling to Whiterun that will one day be the new Gildergreen, a tree sacred to the Temple of Kynareth.

lines.name: The Book of Love
lines.begins: I've agreed to help the Temple of Mara promote the cause of love throughout Skyrim.

sources.name: The Book of Love - Fastred's Awakening

quests.name: The Book of Love
journal: I've agreed to help the Temple of Mara promote the cause of love throughout Skyrim.
objectives: Put on the Amulet of Mara

quests.name: The Book of Love - Fastred's Choice
journal: Fastred wants to leave Ivarstead with Bassianus, but her father won't allow it. She seems conflicted about her choices. Perhaps there's another solution.
I offered Fastred the chance to travel with me across Skyrim instead of settling down with either suitor.
Fastred's parents reluctantly agreed to let her travel with me. Jofthor asked me to keep her safe.
Fastred's parents reluctantly agreed to let her travel with me. Jofthor asked me to keep her safe.
Fastred is adjusting to life on the road. She thanked me for giving her this opportunity.
Fastred is adjusting to life on the road. She thanked me for giving her this opportunity.
Fastred realizes she's no longer running away from something, but running toward something instead.
Fastred realizes she's no longer running away from something, but running toward something instead.
Fastred asked about loneliness on the road. She seems to be working through her feelings about this journey.
Fastred asked about loneliness on the road. She seems to be working through her feelings about this journey.
Fastred and I have grown closer. What started as an escape from Ivarstead has become something more. We should return to Ivarstead so she can decide her future.
Fastred confessed romantic feelings. I turned her down. The atmosphere between us has become strained. We should return to Ivarstead.
We've returned to Ivarstead. Fastred must decide whether to stay here or continue traveling permanently.
Fastred has chosen to leave Ivarstead permanently. She needs to inform her parents and the two suitors of her decision.
Fastred's mother supported her choice. Her father struggled but ultimately let her go, asking only that she visit when she can.
Fastred broke the news to both men. Bassianus is leaving for Riften alone. Klimmek will remain in Ivarstead. Now is time to return to Dinya Balu at the Temple of Mara in Riften
Dinya was surprised but pleased that Fastred and I found love together. She gave us Mara's blessing.
Dinya accepted that Fastred found her own path, even if it wasn't the one Mara's vision showed. The goddess works in mysterious ways.
Fastred decided to stay in Ivarstead after all. Our journey together has ended, but she's grateful for the experience. I should help her resolve things with Bassianus and Klimmek.
I spoke with one of Fastred's suitors. Things should resolve themselves now between them.
objectives: Speak with Fastred about her future
Accompany Fastred while she tells her parents
Accompany Fastred while she tells Bassianus and Klimmek

lines.name: Seeking A Cure
lines.begins: In my search for a cure for vampirism, I read a book entitled "Undeath Undone". As I was reading, a note addressed to Urag fell out from between the book's pages. The author of the note, Falion, seems knowledgeable about the history of the cure for vampirism. I should find out more about this person.

sources.name: A Forlorn Hope - an addon for Seeking The Cure

quests.name: Seeking A Cure
journal: In my search for a cure for vampirism, I read a book entitled "Undeath Undone". As I was reading, a note addressed to Urag fell out from between the book's pages. The author of the note, Falion, seems knowledgeable about the history of the cure for vampirism. I should find out more about this person.
Falion in Morthal is rumored to have studied vampires.  He might be able to cure the condition.

Falion in Morthal may be able to cure my vampirism, but he needs a few days to confer with his notes before he is certain. I should be careful not to be Blood-Starved when I return to him or he won't trust me enough to help.
Falion in Morthal can perform a ritual to cure vampirism. He requires a filled black soul gem. I should be careful not to be Blood-Starved when I meet with him or he won't trust me enough to help.

Falion in Morthal can perform a ritual to cure vampirism. I need to meet him at the Black Marsh at dawn for him to perform the ritual. I should be careful not to be Blood-Starved when I meet with him or he won't trust me enough to help.
Falion in Morthal attempted to cure me of vampirism, but the ritual failed. I must find a different means of curing myself.
Falion in Morthal attempted to cure me of vampirism, but the ritual failed. I must find a different means of curing myself. As a precaution, I had to kill Falion - he knew too much.
objectives: Wait three days while Falion gets ready
Bring a filled Black Soul Gem to Falion
Stand in the center of the circle

quests.name: A Forlorn Hope
journal: I have received a letter from Falion describing a way to create "daedric essence". To do this I need to locate the Aetherium Forge first.
I should bring the essence to Phinis Gestor in the College of Winterhold.
I need to wait till Phinis ends his experiments and contact me regarding the results.
I have received Phinis' results. The cure is possible, it seems.
I have created a potion. Should I drink it?
objectives: Find a way to create daedric essence.
Bring the essence to Phinis Gestor
Create a potion to remove vampirism

lines.name: Falion's Secret
lines.begins: I followed Falion out to a circle of stones in the marsh near Morthal. I blackmailed him in exchange for keeping quiet. Though I can still tell the jarl what he's up to out here.
lines.firstObjective: Inform the Jarl of Morthal about Falion's activities

quests.name: Falion's Secret
journal: I followed Falion out to a circle of stones in the marsh near Morthal. I blackmailed him in exchange for keeping quiet. Though I can still tell the jarl what he's up to out here.
I have agreed to leave Falion to his mysterious activities in the marsh.
I have informed the jarl of Falion's activities out in the marsh and she will deal with him immediately.
The Jarl of Morthal has told Falion to stop what he's been doing in the marsh. Falion reluctantly agreed.
objectives: Inform the Jarl of Morthal about Falion's activities

lines.name: Repentance
lines.begins: I met a witch named Illia in Darklight Tower. She was supposed to obtain a sacrifice for her mother to perform an evil ritual, but rebelled.  Illia wants me to help her get to the top of the tower so she can stop her mother.
lines.firstObjective: Help Illia reach the top of Darklight Tower

quests.name: Repentance
journal: I met a witch named Illia in Darklight Tower. She was supposed to obtain a sacrifice for her mother to perform an evil ritual, but rebelled.  Illia wants me to help her get to the top of the tower so she can stop her mother.

I met a witch named Illia in Darklight Tower. She was supposed to obtain a sacrifice for her mother to perform an evil ritual, but rebelled.  Illia wants me to help her get to the top of the tower so she can stop her mother. At the top of the tower, Illia told me her plan. She planned to present me as the sacrifice to her mother to gain the element of surprise.

I met a witch named Illia in Darklight Tower. She was supposed to obtain a sacrifice for her mother to perform an evil ritual, but rebelled.  Illia wants me to help her get to the top of the tower so she can stop her mother. At the top of the tower, Illia told me her plan. She planned to present me as the sacrifice to her mother to gain the element of surprise. We attacked and killed her mother. Illia told me to take her mother's staff as a reward.
objectives: Help Illia reach the top of Darklight Tower
Defeat Illia's mother at the top of Darklight Tower

lines.name: Siege on the Dragon Cult
lines.begins: I have been asked to defeat the Dragon Priest in Forelhost and to bring back his mask. A journal left by Skorm Snow-Strider may reveal a way past the collapsed areas.

quests.name: Siege on the Dragon Cult
journal: I have been asked to defeat the Dragon Priest in Forelhost and to bring back his mask. A journal left by Skorm Snow-Strider may reveal a way past the collapsed areas.
I have been asked to defeat the Dragon Priest in Forelhost and to bring back his mask. I have found the journal of Skorm Snow-Strider, which may reveal how to bypass the collapsed areas.
I have been asked to defeat the Dragon Priest in Forelhost and to bring back his mask. I can reach the blocked off areas of the stronghold through the well.
I have been asked to defeat the Dragon Priest in Forelhost and to bring back his mask.
I have defeated the Dragon Priest, Rahgot, and taken his mask. I should return with it to Valmir.
Valmir has betrayed me and has been tricking soldiers into the ruins. He must die.
Valmir needs my help to kill the soldiers he tried to trick. I must decide who to side with.
I gave the Dragon Priest's mask to Valmir.
I tricked Valmir into believing the Dragon Priest's mask was destroyed.
I fought Valmir, the Thalmor agent pretending to be a soldier, after I retrieved the Dragon Priest mask from Forelhost.
objectives: (Optional) Show Skorm Snow-Strider's journal to Valmir
(Optional) Find the key to the well in the Catacombs

lines.name: The Pale Lady
lines.begins: Outside Frostmere Crypt, I found a group of bandits attacking one of their own. It seems she was implicated when one of her friends stole a sword from the leader of the gang.
lines.firstObjective: (Optional) Learn more about the theft in Frostmere Crypt

quests.name: The Pale Lady
journal: Outside Frostmere Crypt, I found a group of bandits attacking one of their own. It seems she was implicated when one of her friends stole a sword from the leader of the gang.

In Frostmere Crypt, the bandit Ra'jirr stole a sword from the gang's leader in order to stop the 'Pale Lady', a mysterious figure haunting his dreams. He fled into the tunnels below the ruin, with the bandit leader in pursuit.

In Frostmere Crypt, the bandit Ra'jirr stole a sword from the gang's leader in order to stop the 'Pale Lady', a mysterious figure haunting his dreams. Ra'jirr ambushed and killed the bandit leader before heading into the underground forest.

In Frostmere Crypt, the bandit Ra'jirr stole a sword from the gang's leader in order to stop the 'Pale Lady', a mysterious figure haunting his dreams. She appeared and attacked before he could use it to seal her away.
In Frostmere Crypt, the spectral Pale Lady was released when a group of bandits stole the enchanted sword that sealed her tomb. By returning the sword to her altar, I returned her to her rest.
In Frostmere Crypt, the spectral Pale Lady was released when a group of bandits stole the enchanted sword that sealed her tomb. I killed her and claimed the sword as my prize.
objectives: (Optional) Learn more about the theft in Frostmere Crypt
Follow Kyr and Ra'jirr into the tunnels

lines.name: Forbidden Legend
lines.begins: In Reachwater Rock, I found a cryptic message that said the tomb here had been sealed, and should be forgotten forever. What is the story of this place?

quests.name: Forbidden Legend
journal: In Reachwater Rock, I found a cryptic message that said the tomb here had been sealed, and should be forgotten forever. What is the story of this place?
In Folgunthur, I found a cryptic message on the body of a powerful draugr, condemning him for his ancient crimes. What was his story? Why was he entombed with a broken amulet?
In Geirmund's Hall, I found a cryptic message on the body of a powerful draugr, condemning him for his ancient crimes. What was his story? Why was he entombed with a broken amulet?
In Saarthal, I found a cryptic message on the body of a powerful draugr, condemning him for his ancient crimes. What was his story? Why was he entombed with a broken amulet?

Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered, and his three sons were hunted down by King Harald's personal battlemage. The entire incident was covered up, their names struck from every record. But the legend survived. Perhaps someone still knows the truth of this ancient tale.

Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered, and his three sons were hunted down by King Harald's personal battlemage. The mage Daynas Valen spent his life searching for the truth of this tale, and came to Folgunthur with the key needed to unlock its secret.

Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered by his three sons, who stole his amulet of power and divided it among themselves. The brothers were hunted down in secret and sealed in tombs across Skyrim. To reclaim the amulet, I will need to seek out their final resting places.

Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered by his three sons, who stole his amulet of power and divided it among themselves. I defeated the brothers and reclaimed the fragments of the amulet. Perhaps Gauldur's tomb holds the secret to restoring it to its original form.

Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered by his three sons, who stole his amulet of power and divided it among themselves. I collected the fragments of the shattered amulet and brought them to Gauldur's tomb, where the ghosts of the three brothers ambushed me.

Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered by his three sons, who stole his amulet of power and divided it among themselves. I defeated the undead brothers, located the fragments of the shattered amulet, and forged it anew in Gauldur's tomb.

In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, the ghost of an adventurer who perished there. She warned me that the Treasury of Arkngthamz was sealed by a dangerous tonal lock and protected by deadly traps.

In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, the ghost of an adventurer who perished there. We made our way through the ruins and reached the summit together. There, she warned me that the Treasury of Arkngthamz was sealed by a dangerous tonal lock and protected by deadly traps.
In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, the ghost of an adventurer who perished there. With her help, I solved the tonal lock that protected its ruined treasury.
In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, the ghost of an adventurer who perished there. With her help, I solved the tonal lock that protected its ruined treasury and found a strange glowing crystal shard within.
In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, the ghost of an adventurer who perished there. With her help, I solved the tonal lock that protected its ruined treasury and claimed the Aetherium shard within.

In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, a ghost searching for the mythical Aetherium Forge. Together, we found one of the four Aetherium shards that make up the key to the Forge. She left to search for the other shards and the Forge itself, and urged me to do the same.

In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, a ghost searching for the mythical Aetherium Forge. With her help, I found the four Aetherium shards that make up the key to the Forge, and now seek the entrance to the Forge itself.

In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, a ghost searching for the mythical Aetherium Forge. With her help, I found the four Aetherium shards that make up the key to the Forge, and met her outside its long-sealed entrance.

In Arkngthamz, I met Katria, a ghost searching for the mythical Aetherium Forge. With her help, I found the four Aetherium shards that made up the key to the Forge, and combined them to reveal the entrance to a long-sealed ruin.

quests.name: A Forgotten Blade
journal: I've come across Fultheim, an old man who I believe may have been a member of the Blades in the past. However, he does seem to want to talk about it. I should ask Delphine about him.

Delphine has told me about Fultheim and his time in the Blades. She still thinks it could be a good idea to recruit him, given his skills. With the knowledge I have now, perhaps he will listen to me. I could also speak to Esbern to hear his thoughts.
Fultheim has agreed to join the blades under the condition I first bring him proof of what the Blades can do. Showing him how easily we can defeat Dragons should do the trick.
Fultheim has agreed to join the blades under the condition I first bring him proof of what the Blades can do. Showing him how easily we can defeat a Thalmor Justiciar should do the trick.
Fultheim has agreed to rejoin the Blades again. Realizing that the organization has changed since his time as a Blade, he seeks to redeem himself as a Dragonslayer.
Fultheim has agreed to rejoin the blades again. Not for honor, but for vengeance against Thalmor and all that they have done to the blades.
I insulted Fultheim and he attacked me. There is no chance of convincing him to join the Blades now.

Bring a Thalmor Justiciar's Robes to Fultheim
