lines.name: Undeath
lines.where: The Reach, then all over Skyrim
lines.begins: I have heard a rumor that a Vigil of Stendarr caravan has been attacked on the road somewhere in the Reach. I should investigate.
lines.start: A rumour that a Vigil of Stendarr caravan was attacked in the Reach, or find the ambush yourself. A note in the Markarth inn also points you there.
lines.note: You can end it as a lich.
lines.firstObjective: Search for the Vigil of Stendarr caravan

quests.name: Black Book: Whispers of the Veil
journal: I have found and read the Black Book called "Whispers of the Veil" deep within Scourg Barrow, and found myself in Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha. The forbidden knowledge hidden here may be the secrets of the ritual the necromancer Antioch was seeking. I should press on to uncover it, or read the book again to escape.

I have uncovered the forbidden knowledge contained in the Black Book "Whispers of the Veil" from deep within Apocrypha. The arcane secrets of transcendence have flooded my memory and I now know the lost rituals necessary to make myself an undead Lich. I have commited the ritual and it's components to parchment, and with the proper materials and preparation, I will have the means to become immortal.
objectives: Learn the Black Book's hidden knowledge

quests.name: The Path of Transcendence
journal: From the forbidden secrets I learned in Apocrypha, I have inscribed a dark ritual to parchment that when completed, will allow me to transform into an undead Lich. I should begin to seek out the components necessary for the ritual.
I have purchased the necessary items and prepared a secure location at which to conduct the ritual.
I have successfully crafted my Phylactery, a vessel required to contain my own soul during, and after, the ritual.
I have managed to successully brew the Elixir of Defilation, a potent physical and spiritual poison which is necessry to complete my transformation during the ritual.

I now have all the necessary components to begin the Ritual of Transcendence. I should go to the Ritual Site and begin. I must make sure that I am ready, for once the transformation is complete it cannot be reversed. As an undead Lich, my power will increase tenfold, but I will be feared and hated by the people of Skyrim...
I am ready to begin the Ritual of Transcendence. If any component of the Ritual is missing or is not exact, it will surely fail and I will be killed...

I have completed the Ritual of Transcendence and become a powerful undead Lich. While in my true form I will be hated and feared, however I am able to use powerful magic from the school of Illusion to disguise myself as my previous mortal appearance.

quests.name: In their Footsteps
journal: I have heard a rumor that a Vigil of Stendarr caravan has been attacked on the road somewhere in the Reach. I should investigate.

I have discovered the scene of the destroyed Vigil of Stendarr caravan in the Reach. While a bloody ambush has occurred here, it does not look as though the Forsworn were involved. I should investigate the devastation and see what I can find...

From a note I found on the body of a Necromancer, I have learned that the Vigil of Stendarr seemed to be transporting some sort of tome or artifact. Considering the size of the caravan's escort, it is clear it must be very important. It appears that the attackers have taken it to Ravenscorn Spire.

I have arrived at Ravenscorn Spire, the lair of the dark wizards that attacked the Vigil of Stendarr's caravan. I believe that the artifact they have stolen must be hidden inside. I should begin my search, and proceed with caution.

I have read the journal of the Necromancer's leader, Antioch. It appears that the dark artifact that was stolen from the Vigil of Stendarr was a powerful necromantic tome which has set him on the path of  completing some sort of dark ritual. I should search the Tower basement for more clues.

I have read another entry of Antioch's journal. It appears that he is seeking the secrets for a ritual that will allow him to transform into an undead Lich, and has already departed for the Dragontail Mountains in search of something. He has sent his followers across Skyrim to obtain more artifacts. I should stop them and see if they hold more clues to where their leader has gone.

I have searched Ravenscorn Spire, the lair of the Necromancers who assaulted the Vigil of Stendarr's caravan.  While I did not find the book that was stolen, I have learned that their leader, Antioch, is seeking to use it to become an immortal undead Lich. He has already departed for the Dragontail Mountains in search of something, but has sent his followers across Skyrim to obtain more artifacts. I should seek out and stop his minions before they cause more damage, and see if they have more clues that will lead me to him.
objectives: Search for the Vigil of Stendarr caravan
Investigate the scene of the attack
Search Ravenscorn Spire for more information

quests.name: Exhuming Power
journal: The Necromancer's leader, Antioch, is seeking to use a Tome stolen from the Vigil of Stendarr to become an undead Lich. He has already departed for the Dragontail Mountains in search of something, but has sent one of his followers to Winterhold to locate and dig up the body of a former Archmage from the College of Winterhold. I should find them and prevent them from taking what they are seeking.
I have found the gravesite of former Archmage Vyngald, which is being desecrated by Antioch's Necromancer followers. I must stop them.

I have discovered and defeated a group of Antioch's Necromancer followers who were desecrating Archmage Vyngald's burial ground, before they were able to obtain the raiment they were seeking. I can re-cover Archmage Vyngald's grave site and allow him to rest in peace, or take the Shroud of Vyngald from the coffin myself...
I have re-covered Archmage Vyngald's grave, allowing him to rest in peace.
I have taken the Shroud of Vyngald from the former archmage's desecrated grave. His enraged spirit appeared and attacked me, but I have defeated it.
objectives: Locate the grave of Archmage Vyngald
Take the Shroud of Vyngald from the grave

quests.name: Arkay the Enemy
journal: The Necromancer's leader, Antioch, is seeking to use a Tome stolen from the Vigil of Stendarr to become an undead Lich. He has already departed for the Dragontail Mountains in search of something, but has sent some of his followers to  destroy a Temple of Arkay in Falkreath hold and take the Heart of one of its Priests. I should hurry there and stop them.
I have located the Temple of Arkay, but the Necromancers may already be here. I should proceed with caution.

The Necromancers had arrived at the Temple before me and slaughtered many of the Priests of Arkay before I finally defeated them. There is however one survivor from whom they were going to take extract the Heart for their ritual. I should free him, or I can take his Heart for myself...
I have freed the surviving Priest of Arkay.
I have slaughtered the surviving Priest of Arkay. I should now extract his Heart myself.

After reaching the Temple of Arkay and defeating the Necromancers I found there, I killed the surviving Priest of Arkay, and cut out his heart for the Necromancer's ritual. For some reason, I suspect this will come in handy.
After reaching the Temple of Arkay and defeating the Necromancers I found there, I released the surviving Priest of Arkay and let him escape.
objectives: Clear out the Necromancers from the Temple of Arkay
Slaughter the captive Priest of Arkay
Take the Priest of Arkay's Heart
Free the captive Priest of Arkay

quests.name: Infernal Alchemy
journal: The Necromancer's leader, Antioch, is seeking to use a Tome stolen from the Vigil of Stendarr to become an undead Lich. He has already departed for the Dragontail Mountains in search of something, but has sent some of his followers to conduct some sort of Alchemical Ritual on a plateau overlooking the Reach. I should investigate this.
I have arrived at the Ritual Site, where several of Antioch's followers seem to be preparing some sort of Cauldron and Reagents. I should dispose of them.

I have defeated the Necromancers at the Ritual Site. Their strange concoction however seems to be prepared and ready for reagents. I can destroy it to ensure the mixture is never completed, or I can try to finish the Elixirs they were trying to create myself...
I have destroyed the Cauldron and its contents. The Necromancer's foul concoction can never be completed now.

I attempted to complete one of the concoctions that the Necromancers were trying to complete at a strange Cauldron I found. I was not able to succeed however. The Cauldron has lost its potency and now the mixture can never be completed...

I attempted to complete one of the concoctions that the Necromancers were trying to create at a strange Cauldron I found. I have succeeded, and claimed the Elixir, 'Namira's Corrosion'. I should hold onto this until I can discover its use...

I attempted to complete one of the concoctions that the Necromancers were trying to create at a strange Cauldron I found. I have succeeded, and claimed the Elixir, 'Embalming Essence'. I should hold onto this until I can discover its use...

quests.name: Scourg Barrow
journal: I have defeated all of Antioch's followers throughout Skyrim as they attempted to obtain various artifacts and components for him. I should search their bodies and see if they hold any clues as to their leader's whereabouts.

From a note I found on the body of a Necromancer, I have learned that their leader, Antioch, has traveled deep into the Dragontail Mountains in search of an ancient crypt known as 'Scourg Barrow'. He believes that he is closer than ever to the forbidden secrets he is searching for. I should hurry to the Dragontail Mountains myself, and put a stop to him before he finds what he is looking for.

I have arrived at a frigid cliffisde trail, deep in the peaks of the Dragontail Mountains. An ancient crypt known as 'Scourg Barrow' is allegedly hidden here, where the Necromancer Antioch is attempting to unearth dark and forbidden knowledge. I should seek it out and put a stop to him.

I have entered the ancient crypt known as Scourg Barrow. The Necromancer Antioch is undoubtedly in the depths of these forgotten catacombs, seeking its forbidden secrets. I should find him and put a stop to his search personally.

Antioch is defeated, and his artifacts and knowledge now lie in my possession, thus ending the threat to Skyrim. The secrets that he was searching for in these catacombs may still lie within, however...

lines.name: Granite Hill

quests.name: A Plea From Granite Hill
journal: A courier handed me a note from someone in Granite Hill. I should read it.

Someone named John sent me a letter and asked me to meet him in Granite Hill. The letter mentioned that a shop owner named Privous along with John discovered a crawl space under Privious' shop, Oddities and Curiosities which led to a ruin filled with draugr.
John mentioned that the crawl space opened up into an old ruin where he saw draugr and heard strange noises. He gave me a key to the crawl space so I can clear out the draugr for him.

I went into the crawl space which led into the ruins John mentioned. It was filled with draugr which was expected but at the bottom of the of the tomb, I found and killed a dragon. I should go tell John about this and collect my reward.

I told John about the ruins found under the shop in Granite Hill. He was surprised to hear about the dragon and relieved I took care of the threat. He said he and the people of Granite Hill were thankful. I was given the keys to a home in Granite Hill as a reward.
objectives: Speak with John in Granite Hill
Explore the crawl space under the shop
Speak with John about your journey through the ruins

quests.name: Legends Of Aetherium
journal: I have heard of an excavation into a lost Dwemer ruin offering gold as a reward for work aiding the crew. I should go an investigate to see if there is any work still available.
I have arrived at the excavation site, it seems the crew have already started work on excavating the ruin, I should delve into the mine and see if I can find the crew.
I have arrived in a large chamber, there is a large dwemer ruin in the center I should investigate.

The tower is barred off, there are three levers around the base which seem like they should open the bars but the levers will not move. There must be a way to use these, I should investigate the three other dwemer structures in the chamber.
I have reached the top of the tower, there is a large building ahead I shoulder enter and investigate.
There is a Dwemer centurion that seems to be guarding an armory of sorts. I will need to defeat it to gain entry.
The centurion is defeated, I should investigate the armory.

Find a way to reach the top of the tower

quests.name: Kagrenac's Tools
journal: I've received an anonymous note from the courier. I should read it and see what it's regarding.
An individual name Mathis Valen urgently request to meet me at the Silver-Blood Inn in the city of Markarth. I should go and find out why.
I've met Mathis Valen, who knows the locations of the Lost Tools of Kagrenac. He has told me where to find them and how to restore them to their former power.
I've obtained the cursed key from Vonos Dreloth and now have access to Sunder's hiding place. I should now locate and retrieve Sunder.

I have convinced Yassour Tansumiran to tell me the whereabouts of Wraithguard; he has divulged his information regarding Wraithguard. It was stolen from him by a thief, and last he saw, it was being taken to the Dwemer ruins of Nchardak. Directly East, away from Raven Rock. I should now head towards Nchardak to reclaim Wraithguard.

I've acquired both Sunder and Wraithguard. However, they feel severely weakened over the last few centuries after the Heart of Lorkhan was banish by the Nerevarine. The Bal am as Aedra stones should be capable of restoring the tools on the pedestal in Blackreach. I should now travel to these Ayleid ruins near the Cyrodilic border.

I've obtained all three Bal am as Aedra stones, and the gems emit radiating energy from within me. Coursing through my very veins as if I were a god! I should now return to Mathis Valen at the Silver-Blood Inn in Markarth.
Mathis Valen has instructed me to meet him in Blackreach, where the pedestal location is. I should now travel to Blackreach and finally witness the restoration of Kagrenac's Tools.
A mysterious portal resides within this ruin. Mathis did not mention such a portal, but maybe it should be where he went. I should head into the portal and see where it takes me.

The portal has sent me to what appears to be an unfamiliar region not belonging to Skyrim. I need to find the entrance to the ruins to join Mathis's quest to restore the tools. Still, I should tread carefully, not fully understanding what has happened.

I have entered what seems to be a colossal Dwarven lift with no way down but to jump below... I need to continue ahead and meet with Mathis at the pedestal. Although exploring this place could reveal other hidden treasures too.
Ultimately it is unveiled that Mathis Valen is the leader of the remnants of the Sixth House and is scheming to use Kagrenac's Tools to reclaim Morrowind.

With Mathis Valen defeated along with both his bodyguards, a disaster is averted, however, the Sixth House of Dagoth Ur whereabouts and strength remains an elusive mystery. I should now head on over to the pedestal where I can restore Kagrenac's Tools to their former glory.
The Tools of Kagrenac have lastly restored to their former glory! I now am left with the fate of these tools to bring righteousness or misfortune to the mortal plane.

lines.firstObjective: Accept the job from the Black-Briars

quests.name: Deluge of Deceit
journal: The Black-Briars sent out a notice for diving work to collect ingredients at the bottom of Lake Honrich. I should speak to Frissa Black-Briar at Elgrim's Elixirs if I want to accept the job.

I found a plant that seems to sing to me, at the bottom of Lake Honrich. I can see a cave behind it, but some kind of magic is stopping me from uprooting it. Maybe an alchemist within the city would know more?

I spoke with Frissa Black-Briar, who is paying for any samples and artifacts that I may find in the cave at the bottom of Lake Honrich. A hired team has already been dispatched there. They should be north of the Riften docks, by Merryfair Farm.
I found the Black-Briar's hired team by Lake Honrich. The Elven woman there said to speak to Ingun's assistant, the Argonian, once I'm ready to leave.
I spoke to the leader of the Black-Briar's diving team, and we are ready to proceed. I need to swim to the lowest point of Lake Honrich, and investigate the cave.
After uprooting a plant in the cave under Lake Honrich, the cavern collapsed, trapping me inside ruins deeper underground. I need to find another way to escape.

In the Ayleid ruins, I found a massive hall with many connecting doors. Tilael said that she needs time to rest, and will wait here for me. The bridge above is out of reach, but there may be a path I can take here, somewhere. There's also another pedestal, where I can place another Varla stone.
I found a Topaz Varla stone that seems to match the gem type on the pedestal in the main hall. I should return there, and explore my options after placing it.

I placed the Varla stone in the main hall, causing the room to flood. The water level is high enough for me to swim up to the bridge in the center. I can explore more of the area to look for a way out now.
I've escaped the Ayleid ruins. I should rest.

I fell into a trance while attempting to progress through the ruins, and met a ghostly woman who had ill intentions. I should find the other team members quickly and escape before they are affected by the magic here.

I placed a third Varla Stone on the pedestals in the Atasel Hall, causing the water to rise higher and give access to another platform. I should continue looking for the team members and a way to escape.
I placed all four Varla stones on the pedestals in the Atasel Hall, causing a portal to appear on the bridge. Could this be the way to get out of these ruins?

After going through the portal, I found the resting place of the Ayleid haunting this place, and put them to rest. With their magic no longer keeping the structure together, the halls are flooding. I need to find a way out!
I escaped the Ayleid ruins. I should return to Elgrim's Elixirs to talk to Frissa Black-Briar.
I spoke with Frissa Black-Briar about the Ayleid ruins, and she compensated me for the danger I was put in while trapped in the ruins.
objectives: Accept the job from the Black-Briars
Find the plant in the lake
Speak to Ingun's assistant to start the job
(Optional) Speak to all the members of the diving team (<Global=EVGSirenIntroTalk4>/4)
(Optional) Give Yineel 1 Nordic Barnacle and 1 Histcarp
Find a way onto the bridge
Wait for Tilael to solve the puzzle
Go with Tilael to her Soul Gem

journal: I have talked to Gwilym, a priest I met in the Silver Blood Inn in Markarth. He has tasked me with healing the "Heart" in a cave in the reach. I should go there and make the remedy he provided.
After talking with Vinillian he said that I should create a poison instead to kill the heart instead. He gave me a poisonous root to do so. I can choose to make the remedy or the poison.
I have reached Ever-Bog, I shoud search for the ingredients needed.
All the ingredients needed have been found, there should be a cooking station I can use to them at.
I should venture deeper into Ever-Bog to find this so called heart.
The remedy seemed to have worked when applied to the heart, I should return and speak with the Gwilym.
The poison seemed to have worked when applied to the heart, I should return and speak with the Villinian.
After speaking with Gwilym he has informed me that he will return to the heart, he should be there in a day if I want to witness him go about his duties.
After returning to Vinillian, he paid me and told me to be on my way.

journal: I heard rumors about a statue of Talos hidden somewhere in the Falkreath area. Perhaps I could find some allies that could help me.

"Taliesin" seems cooperative at the moment. I can either heal him as promised, or leave him to bleed to death. Despite his bemoaning and caterwauling, the wound isn't that serious. A small potion should help.

quests.name: Collecting the Edda - Windhelm
journal: Player has read the book

Higil in Windhelm has asked me to collect eddas from citizens of Windhelm. I got a list with all people I should speak to. I should start by speaking to Thane Alarik. He lives in the Higher Valunstrad. West of the palace. Look for him at court, if he is not at home.
Next on the list is Jorn Scarred-Scald. He lives in the Iron Quarter. East of the Palace. Close to the Pit. He tends to play in Iron Hall during the evenings.
Next on the list is Hellte. She works and lives in Iron Hall. The serving maid. She usually wears a bronze headband. Be careful.
Next on the list is Audmund.  Never thought him to be a writer, but you'll most like find him in his shop. The one between the Gray Quarter and the Iron Quarter. Close to the Pit.
Next on the list is Tormund. Tormund Tall-Tale. Heard he moved in to the old bookshop.The one right of Candlehearth Hall. Not sure if he actually owns the shop himself, now that I think about it.
Next on the list is Sulvar.  If he's still alive alive you'll find him in the Old Wheelhouse, outside the city. Think there's a gate from the market you can use. Been a while since I last saw him.

Next on the list is Frida Lives in the Valunstrad, just downstair from our clan's hall.  Big girl. Wears a bear pelt. Hard to miss. Very traditional. Might be at Wilhelm's place in the market, or at the Five Hundred's Wall, if not at home.
Next on the list is Hjarrandi. Old man. Lives up in the Hall of Relics. Up high, west of the palace. Know him for years, but still don't know much about him. Bit of a mystery, that one.
I should return to Higil with all the verses

quests.name: Ode To The Tundrastriders
journal: Player gets note

The Jarl is looking for someone to deal with some troublesome giants, who has their camp in the Tundra outside Whiterun. They way I see it, there's three ways I could deal with them. Honorable, but dangerous battle. Poison their food. Dishonorable, but effective. Or perhaps diplomacy. I could ask around town to see if there's anyone who knows more. There's people both inside and outside wall, someone will probably know something.
Urik claims to know how to deal with the Giants peacefully. I could read his note if, if diplomacy is my goal.

Urik claims to know how to deal with the Giants. I need a cow, some blue dye and a poem called "Ode to the Tundrastriders". I should be able to find all of this in Whiterun. Should check with a construction shop for the dye. Urik will get the cow for me.
Urik's will arrange for the cow to be bought. I'll have to find some blue dye and a copy of the poem "Ode to the Tundrastriders". I should speak to Urik once I found the items.

All preparations are complete. I should get Gertie the cow to follow me. I can then go and try to strike a deal with the Giant Chieftain in Bleakwind Basin now.
All preparations are complete. I should get Gertie the cow to follow me. I can then go and try to strike a deal with the Giant Chieftain in Bleakwind Basin now.
I've acquired a strong poison. Now I just need to put it in their food.

The negotiations have failed. My only choice is to kill the giant now.
The giant is dead. I should speak to the Jarl's steward for my reward.

I've negotiated a truce between the Giants and Whiterun. They will no longer harass travelers - provided the travelers stay away from the Giant's camp. The giant chieftain offered to trade with me. I should report all of this to the Jarl's steward.

I've negotiated a truce between the Giants and Whiterun. They will no longer harass travelers - provided the travelers stay away from the Giant's camp.The Jarl would have prefered the Giant to be dead, but still gave me some gold as a reward.

I should go speak to either Joslin, in the stables behind the Bannered Mare, or to the Stablemaster outside Dragonsreach. A band of strange raiders, bringing both Wild Beasts and Siege Equipment, launched an assault on Whitewatch Tower. Together with some guardsmen and the other Thanes of Whiterun, I fought them off.

Giraud was ecstatic and rewarded me with a copy of the collated fragments, including the last verse. According to Adonato's letter, it might be risky to read the complete version, but I can't resist the temptation. Surely nothing terrible can come out of it.
A tale of old has now been told, A bard's reward is due; A queen once brewed a lethal food, And you can brew it too.

quests.name: In the Shadows
journal: With the death of King Torygg, it seems not even the Jarls are safe in Skyrim, and security comes at a premium. Given the need for capable warriors, I should speak with the steward and see if he has any work for me.
In Whiterun, I spoke to the Jarl's steward and asked him if he had any work. He handed me a note with details on a job.

In Whiterun, I spoke to the Jarl's steward and asked him if he had any work. He handed me a note with details on a job. Reading the note, it seems there may be a potential assassination plot against the Jarl. The steward wants me to visit the local alchemist and check if anyone has purchased any poisons.

It seems there may be a potential assassination plot against the Jarl. At the steward's direction, I visited a local alchemist and took a copy of her ledger. I should read it to see if anyone has recently purchased any poisons.

It seems there may be a potential assassination plot against the Jarl. At the steward's direction, I visited a local alchemist and took a copy of her ledger. I read it and found two people had purchased poisons. A priest at the Hall of the Dead, and a stable boy.

It seems there may be a potential assassination plot against the Jarl. At the steward's direction, I visited a local alchemist and took a copy of her ledger. I read it and found two people had purchased poisons. A priest at the Hall of the Dead, and a stable boy. At the Whiterun Stables I found a dead body and clues that point to the Silent Moons Camp. I should investigate the area and see what I can find.

At the Silent Moons Camp, I discovered a journal from an assassin who intends on killing the Jarl of Whiterun. He intends to take the shot from somewhere unoccupied, using the Bow of Shadows to conceal himself. It's likely he will only appear when the Jarl is not tending to any other business. I should find him and take him out before he can carry through with the plot.
At the Silent Moons Camp, I discovered a journal from an assassin who intends on killing the Jarl of Whiterun. After following his trail, I found him in Dragonsreach and eliminated him.

At the Silent Moons Camp, I discovered a journal from an assassin who intends on killing the Jarl of Whiterun. After following his trail, I found him in Dragonsreach and eliminated him, taking the Bow of Shadows for myself.

At the Silent Moons Camp, I discovered a journal from an assassin who intends on killing the Jarl of Whiterun. After following his trail, I found him in Dragonsreach and eliminated him, taking the Bow of Shadows for myself. I then returned to the steward and received my reward.

Investigate the Hall of the Dead
Find the Assassin on the upper floor of Dragonsreach when the Jarl is unoccupied

lines.name: The Cause
lines.begins: I found the Oblivion Gate and defeated the leader of the Mythic Dawn, Vonos. It appears this was an elaborate ritual designed to deceive me, and killing Vonos was the final step. I have become an unwitting instrument of Mehrunes Dagon, and my actions have opened the Oblivion Gate.

quests.name: The Cause
journal: I found the Oblivion Gate and defeated the leader of the Mythic Dawn, Vonos. It appears this was an elaborate ritual designed to deceive me, and killing Vonos was the final step. I have become an unwitting instrument of Mehrunes Dagon, and my actions have opened the Oblivion Gate.
Centuries have passed since the Oblivion Crisis, yet remnants of that era may still exist in Skyrim. I should pay attention to any news or rumors.
I've found a letter from a stranger. It looks like a plea for help. I should read it and see what it says.

I found a letter from someone named Skorvild claiming to be a reformed member of the Mythic Dawn. He mentioned the Oblivion Crisis and asked for a meeting at the Shrine to Stendarr. I should go there and see what he has to say.

The stranger who wrote the letter, Skorvild, was apparently murdered by two Mythic Dawn assassins before I could meet with him. They ambushed me when I arrived, but I defeated them. I should look around to find any additional information.

A stranger asked for help, but he was killed before I arrived. I was then ambushed by two assassins. I learned that the Mythic Dawn have reemerged, and that they've somehow reassembled an Oblivion gate, but need a powerful artifact to open it. A camp was mentioned in the notes I found. I should go there to see what I can find.

The Mythic Dawn have repaired an Oblivion Gate, but need a Great Welkynd Stone to open it. To avoid the Vigilants of Stendarr they've excavated a back way into an ancient Ayleid ruin where such a stone is rumored to be hidden. A journal at their camp mentioned something about a secret chamber. I should investigate the ruin and see if I can find it before they do.

The Mythic Dawn have been searching an Ayleid ruin where a Great Welkynd Stone is rumored to be hidden within a secret chamber. They have been unable to find this chamber, but one of the explorers discovered Ayleid Elemental Shards may be the keys to opening it. I should find the shards.

The Mythic Dawn have been searching for a secret chamber within an Ayleid ruin that may contain a Great Welkynd Stone. I found four Ayleid Elemental Shards that may help me gain access to this chamber. I should return them to their holders.
I placed the four Ayleid Elemental Shards in their holders, and a passage to a hidden chamber opened. I should investigate and see if I can locate the Great Welkynd Stone.
I gained access to the secret chamber within Rielle and retrieved the Great Welkynd Stone, but was ambushed by an Ayleid Lich. I need to defeat him in order to escape.

I found and retrieved the Great Welkynd Stone from within Rielle, and defeated the Ayleid Lich guardian, but the Mythic Dawn will stop at nothing to bring Mehrunes Dagon into power. I should search for any clues nearby that might lead me to the location of the Oblivion Gate.

While searching for clues about the Mythic Dawn's whereabouts I found a journal on a dead Vigilant of Stendarr. They learned of the Mythic Dawn's plot by capturing and interrogating a priest, and were able to decipher the location of the Oblivion Gate. I should go there and see if I can get inside. Wearing a set of Mythic Dawn robes might make it easier, but I need to be careful.

I've found the repaired Oblivion Gate deep inside Red Scar Cavern, the Mythic Dawn hideout. The leader of the Mythic Dawn, Vonos, will stop at nothing to bring Mehrunes Dagon to power, and must be defeated.

I found the Oblivion Gate and defeated the leader of the Mythic Dawn, Vonos. It appears this was an elaborate ritual designed to decieve me, and killing Vonos was the final step. I have become an unwitting instrument of Mehrunes Dagon, and my actions have opened the Oblivion Gate.

I've found the weakened Sigil Stone within the Deadlands, and now must make a decision. If I take the Sigil Stone, the gate will close and the Mythic Dawn will be defeated. However, if I place the Great Welkynd stone on the altar, it will recharge the gate, and seal it open...
Gate Closed
Gate Open

A stranger informed me that the Mythic Dawn reformed and unearthed an ancient Oblivion Gate. They were searching for a Great Welkynd Stone to charge the gate, which I found within Rielle before they could. I infiltrated the Mythic Dawn's hideout and went inside the Deadlands to find the Sigil Stone. Rather than remove the stone and close the portal, I decided to follow the will of Mehrunes Dagon by using the Great Welkynd Stone to charge the gate and protect the Sigil Stone.

A stranger informed me that the Mythic Dawn reformed and unearthed an ancient Oblivion Gate. They were searching for a Great Welkynd Stone to charge the gate, which I found within Rielle before they could. I infiltrated the Mythic Dawn's hideout and went inside the Deadlands to find the Sigil Stone. I defeated two of Mehrunes Dagon's champions, and retrieved the Sigil Stone, thereby closing the portal and destroying the gate.
objectives: Meet Skorvild at the Shrine to Stendarr
Search for clues in the Mythic Dawn camp
Search Rielle for clues about the secret chamber
Locate the Ayleid Elemental Shard Holders
Find clues to the Oblivion Gate's location
(Optional) Wear a set of Mythic Dawn robes
Use the Scroll of Liminal Breach
Locate the Sigil Stone in the Deadlands

lines.name: The Unquiet Dead
lines.begins: Search the plantation for clues

quests.name: The Unquiet Dead
journal: <Alias=FarmLocation> near Rorikstead is reportedly haunted by ghosts that harass travelers on the road. The Jarl of Whiterun Hold is offering the plantation itself as a reward for anyone who can lay the spirits to rest. I should head to <Alias=FarmLocation> to investigate.

Upon reaching <Alias=FarmLocation>, I discoverd that the rumors were true - this place is indeed haunted by the restless dead. What is driving the spirits of these simple farmers to such rage? And what sort of tragedy caused their untimely deaths? I should search the farm to find out more.

<Alias=Husband> accused his wife of being a witch before attacking her, after which she appears to have poisoned him. Could <Alias=Wife> have murdered her own son? I should try to find her secret laboratory to uncover the truth.

<Alias=Wife> believed her angry, controlling husband had killed their son, <Alias=GhostChild>, so she poisoned him. Could <Alias=Husband> have murdered his own son? I should search the farm to find out more.

I have uncovered the truth about what occurred at <Alias=FarmLocation>. After their son disappeared, <Alias=Husband> and <Alias=Wife> killed each other - <Alias=Wife> with extract of Deadly Nightshade, <Alias=Husband> with an axe - each thinking that the other had murdered their son, <Alias=GhostChild>. The only way to finally bring peace to their spirits is to discover what really became of <Alias=GhostChild>.

I have uncovered the horrible truth about what occured at Goldenhills plantation. After their son disappeared, <Alias=Husband> and <Alias=Wife> killed each other, and their son appears to have run away to escape his parents' bickering. The only way to finally bring peace to the spirits here is to find out what happened to <Alias=GhostChild>, and to do that I need to find the old well mentioned in his journal.

At the old well, I found another journal of <Alias=GhostChild>. In it, he mentions that he killed a wolf, but afterwards he went to Rannveig's Fast with several hunters to claim some treasure. I should go to that place and find out what happend to him there.

I have found <Alias=GhostChild>'s remains in Rannveig's Fast, along with his beloved toy sword. It looks like a necromancer at ruins tricked, captured and killed him. I should return the toy sword to <Alias=FarmLocation>, so that the spirits of <Alias=Husband> and <Alias=Wife> can finally know the truth of what happened to their son.

The restless spirits at <Alias=FarmLocation> can finally rest in peace, reunited with the spirit of their son and knowing that neither of them murdered their only child. I should inform <Alias=Steward> that the ghosts have been put to rest.
The restless spirits at <Alias=FarmLocation> have been put to rest. I informed <Alias=Steward> about this and received a reward. The plantation is now for sale.
The restless spirits at <Alias=FarmLocation> have been put to rest. I informed <Alias=Steward> about this, received a reward and bought the plantation.
objectives: Return <Alias=GhostChild>'s toy sword to the farm
Speak to the Steward of Whiterun

quests.name: Paragliding in Skyrim
journal: A man fell out of the sky and died on impact. I should investigate.

The man's name was Fredrick, nicknamed Flyin' Fred. I guess now he'll be remembered as Fallin' Fred. His journal mentions a paraglider that allows one to fly and a flight platform atop the Jerall Mountains. I should go investigate that flight platform.

I've reached Fred's flight platform and it's a sight to behold.  It seems Fred really liked pinwheels. While the gazebo appears cozy, the pinwheels of a mad man litter the area, forever creaking in the howling wind. A truly haunting experience. There, before the sea of pinwheels, I see what looks to be a properly twined duplicate of Fred's paraglider.

As I make morally questionable decisions daily, there's a good chance I'll keep this paraglider for personal use despite the very real possibility that Fred may have surviving family nearby who may find it of great sentimental value. I also have absolutely no concern that my sudden possession of Fred's property coinciding with his violent death, that I alone witnessed and makes me the last person to see him alive, may arouse any suspicion from guards suspecting foul play. Can't wait to fly though. Thanks Fred!

lines.name: Lucien
lines.begins: Lucien has received a letter from his father along with the key to a Dwemer ruin on Solstheim that he's keen to explore. He'd like us to visit there at our earliest convenience.

sources.name: Lucien - Immersive Fully Voiced Male Follower

quests.name: Intruders
journal: Lucien's resonant sphere has started making a strange noise, which Lucien tells me is a warning of some kind indicating that Dumzbthar is under attack. We should go there as quickly as possible.
Lucien and I have been called back to his laboratory to repel some kind of incursion. Upon returning, however, I have encountered a reactivated Dumzbthar. I need to find out what's going on.

Lucien and I have been called back to his laboratory to repel some kind of incursion. Upon returning, I encountered Dumzbthar, who Lucien has reactivated. We were interrupted, however, by a Daedra, which I must now defend myself from.

Lucien and I have been called back to his laboratory to repel some kind of incursion. Upon returning, I encountered Dumzbthar, who Lucien has reactivated. We were interrupted, however, by a Daedra. I should talk to Dumzbthar again.

Lucien and I have been called back to his laboratory by Dumzbthar, who Lucien has reactivated. The facility is under attack from Daedra who have entered through the Oblivion Gate. We need to defeat them before they escape to the surface.
Lucien has reactivated Dumzbthar, and we have been called back to the facility to defend it from Daedra. Upon defeating them, however, we have encountered a strange horse.

Lucien has reactivated Dumzbthar, and we have been called back to the facility to defend it from Daedra. Upon defeating them, however, we encountered a strange horse, which Lucien has spoken to and ridden. I should talk to him to find out what's happening.

Lucien reactivated Dumzbthar, and we were called back to the facility to defend it from Daedra. Upon defeating them, however, we encountered a strange horse, which Lucien says is called Clive. It is now going to travel with us, and will appear whenever Lucien needs it.

quests.name: The Oblivion Engine
journal: Lucien has received a letter from his father along with the key to a Dwemer ruin on Solstheim that he's keen to explore. He'd like us to visit there at our earliest convenience.
Lucien and I have arrived at Dumzbthar, a Dwemer ruin he's keen to explore. We should take a look around and see what we can discover.
Lucien and I are inside Dumzbthar, a Dwemer ruin he's been keen to explore. We've passed through a set of vault doors that he assures me will open again for us on the way out.

Lucien and I are inside Dumzbthar, a Dwemer ruin he's been keen to explore. After passing through a set of vault doors that he assures me will open again for us on the way out, we heard a mysterious voice, and are travelling deeper into the ruin.
Lucien and I are exploring Dumzbthar, a Dwemer ruin governed by a mysterious intelligence. We should find out what exactly is going on here.

Lucien and I are sealed inside Dumzbthar, a Dwemer ruin governed by a mysterious intelligence which seems intent on killing us. Our only option is to travel deeper into the ruin to find a way to make it let us out.

Lucien and I are sealed inside Dumzbthar, a Dwemer ruin governed by a Daedric intelligence which seems intent on killing us. Now that we have reached its core, I should distract it while Lucien tries to shut it down.
Lucien and I are sealed inside Dumzbthar, a Dwemer ruin governed by a Daedric intelligence which seems intent on killing us. Inside its core, our only hope for escape is to shut it down.
Lucien and I have shut down the Daedric intelligence governing Dumzbthar. I should talk to him about getting us out of here.
Lucien and I entered Dumzbthar and shut down the Daedric intelligence governing it. He stayed behind to set up a laboratory there, but will be happy to travel with me again whenever I need him.

lines.name: Serana
lines.begins: Serana asked me to find her books related to the events that led to the Dragonborn Prophecy. In return, she'll teach me a few lessons on skills she's good at. I'm sure I can find something for her in the College of Winterhold.

quests.name: From Arena to Oblivion
journal: Serana asked me to find her books related to the events that led to the Dragonborn Prophecy. In return, she'll teach me a few lessons on skills she's good at. I'm sure I can find something for her in the College of Winterhold.
Serana asked me to find her books related to the events that led to the Dragonborn Prophecy. I brought her four books and she seemed satisfied with them.

quests.name: The Bleeding Flower
journal: Serana told me that she hasn't fed in years and requested me to donate some blood for her to feed on. In order to make this as painless and easy as possible, it's better if I fall asleep, so I should find a safe place to rest and let her feed.

Serana told me that she hasn't fed in years and requested me to donate some blood for her to feed on. After finding a safe location I fell asleep and had a strange dream. I should talk to Serana and make sure everything went alright.

Serana told me that she hasn't fed in years and requested me to donate some blood for her to feed on. After finding a safe location I fell asleep and had a strange dream. Serana told me she's in top condition and that I should just take it slow, but we should move on.

Serana told me that she hasn't fed in years and requested me to donate some blood for her to feed on. Sadly, I forgot about it and reached her home before finding a place to sleep. She reprimaned me for it.
objectives: Find a place to sleep (tavern recommended)

quests.name: Solitude in Company
journal: Serana expressed her desire to explore the city of Solitude, so I offered myself as her guide. We should head there while I come up with something fun to do.

Serana expressed her desire to explore the city of Solitude, so I offered myself as her guide. Once we got there, I asked her what she wanted to do, but she's the one who expected me to have the tour planned. Taking her to the Solitude Windmill should be a good start, but I have to come up with a plan afterwards...

Serana expressed her desire to explore the city of Solitude, so I offered myself as her guide. After visiting the Bridge, I proposed Serana to visit the College. She didn't seem very enthusiastic about it, but wasn't against it either. Let's go there and then decide what to do afterwards.

Serana expressed her desire to explore the city of Solitude, so I offered myself as her guide. After taking a brief peek at the Bards College's exterior, I suggested her to buy herself a souvenir. She liked the idea, so we're heading to Radiant Raiment.

I took Serana to the Radiant Raiment and she became interested in buying a certain circlet. Unfortunately, when she was going to pay for it, she realized that she brought coins from another era. After asking for advice, I suggested her to ask the Jarl for a job. We should head to the Blue Palace at once.

After talking to Jarl Elisif, she gave us a job herself. We have to find a thief at Kilkreath Temple and retrieve the scroll he stole. There's a chance he may not be alone, so we have to be prepared for a fight.

We reached Kilkreath and found a Solitude Guard waiting with two bandits. As Jarl Elisif suspected, he's the one who stole her husband's scroll. The thieves won't listen to reason. We must take the scroll by force!
I can't believe he fell for it...
We reached Kilkreath and found a Solitude Guard waiting with two bandits. We faced them, but we emerged victorious and managed to retrieve Torygg's Scroll. I should talk to Serana.

We reached Kilkreath and found a Solitude guard waiting with two bandits, who turned out to be the thieves. We faced them, but we emerged victorious and managed to retrieve Torygg's Scroll. We should now return the scroll to Elisif and confront her about what the corrupt guard told us.
After returning the scroll to Elisif and hearing her story out, she paid us 500 septims each. Now Serana has more than enough to buy that circlet she fancied in Radiant Raiment.
After sidetracking from our little tour, we finally were able to buy Serana the circlet she fancied. We should leave the shop and decide what to do next.

Serana expressed her desire to explore the city of Solitude, so I offered myself as her guide. Among other things, we decided to find a job so that Serana could buy herself a circlet, and fortunately, Jarl Elisif had one for us. After getting the job done and earning our keep, Serana bought her circlet and we decided to head back. It certainly was an exhausting ordeal, but we had fun. I wish we could do something like this again.
objectives: Take Serana to the Solitude Windmill
Take Serana to the Bards College
Visit Taarie in the Radiant Raiment
Find the thief and retrieve Torygg's scroll
Meet up with Taarie in the Radiant Raiment
Talk to Serana outside the shop

quests.name: Mirrors of Youth
journal: Before reaching the Ancestor Glade to learn the location of Auriel's Bow, Serana pointed out that we'd need to be extra prepared just in case. We'll depart to Whiterun to buy some potions at Arcadia's Calduron and deliver her a note.

Before reaching the Ancestor Glade to learn the location of Auriel's Bow, Serana pointed out that we'd need to be extra prepared just in case. The potions we were going to buy were rather expensive, but Arcadia offered us a discount in exchange of finding Braith before she does something with her experimental potion.
After agreeing to help Arcadia with her little problem with Braith, we asked around town. We were told to look for her up in the Cloud District, but outside Dragonsreach.
We found Braith uncooperative. Serana seems convinced to be able to yield results. Maybe I should let her handle it.
Serana managed not only to convince Braith to gives us the potion back, but to help her with her own problems in a possitive way. We should return to Arcadia now.
Serana managed not only to convince Braith to gives us the potion back, but to help her with her own problems in a possitive way. We should return to Arcadia now.
After our little misadventure to Whiterun to get potions half the price, we were able to help Braith in the process. I should ask Serana how she felt about this experience.

Before reaching the Ancestor Glade to learn the location of Auriel's Bow, Serana pointed out that we'd need to be extra prepared just in case. The potions we were going to buy were rather expensive, but Arcadia offered us a discount in exchange of finding Braith before she did something with her experimental potion. When we located her, we realized she wanted to use it on her crush, Lars, so Serana helped her approach this matter in a healthy way and Braith in return gave us the potion back. Arcadia rewarded us by giving us a discount with the potions. Serana walked away out of this adventure happily, having made a friend.

quests.name: Ambivalence
journal: I confronted Serana about my feelings for her. I was prepared to be rejected, but she actually admitted to feel something for me. However, she seems to feel insecure about it because of what she's been through in her past, believing that she doesn't deserve this happiness. I need to do something to show her that she's worthy of my feelings for her. Maybe if I were to give her a gift that could convey my feelings, like a ring, it may help her clear her doubts. Fralia Grey-Mane's jewelry has a decent reputation. Maybe she can craft that ring for me.

I confronted Serana about my feelings for her. I was prepared to be rejected, but she actually admitted to feel something for me. However, she seems to feel insecure about it because of what she's been through in her past, believing that she doesn't deserve this happiness. Later, I hired Fralia Grey-Mane to craft a ring for me. She said she'll have it ready in a day.

I confronted Serana about my feelings for her. I was prepared to be rejected, but she actually admitted to feel something for me. However, she seems to feel insecure about it because of what she's been through in her past, believing that she doesn't deserve this happiness. Later, I hired Fralia Grey-Mane to craft a ring for me. She should have it ready now.

I confronted Serana about my feelings for her. I was prepared to be rejected, but she actually admitted to feel something for me. However, she seems to feel insecure about it because of what she's been through in her past, believing that she doesn't deserve this happiness. I bought a ring from Fralia Grey-Mane, who told me that I shouldn't just give it to Serana in any place. It has to be somewhere special. I think the castle courtyard is the best option. That's where we truly began to grow closer.

I confronted Serana about my feelings for her. I was prepared to be rejected, but she actually admitted to feel something for me. However, she seems to feel insecure about it because of what she's been through in her past, believing that she doesn't deserve this happiness. I bought a ring from Fralia Grey-Mane and gave it to Serana in the castle courtyard. After our heart-to-heart conversation, she accepted the ring and kissed me, but said that she wasn't truly prepared for a relationhip yet. She'll need time, but I don't mind. I truly want her to be happy.
objectives: Ask Fralia Grey-Mane to craft you a ring for Serana
Wait for Fralia to have the ring ready
Pick up the ring from Fralia Grey-Mane
Give the ring to Serana in Castle Volkihar's Courtyard

quests.name: At the Tempo of our Heartbeats
journal: I wanted to take Serana on a dance, but I made her uncomfortable. I should wait until tomorrow and apologize.
I wanted to take Serana on a dance, but I made her uncomfortable. I should apologize now that things have calmed down between us.

I wanted to take Serana on a dance, but I made her uncomfortable. When I tried to apologize, she requested to continue this conversation in Castle Volkihar's courytard. I should take her there to apoligize.

I wanted to take Serana on a dance, but I made her uncomfortable. After talking it out in her castle's courtyard, we decided to take the step together and dance. She was afraid, but she pushed through and we had a very memorable time. I'm glad we're slowly overcoming her traumas and that she's learing to love herself despite what she did in her past.
objectives: Take Serana to the Castle Courtyard

quests.name: Serana's cure vampirism
journal: Serana seems to be visiting Falion in Morthal to cure vampirism. It should be fine if I just go to see how things are going.
The ritual is about to begin. Let's go to the summoning circle in the swamp and see what happens
The ritual is over. I wonder if she is alright.
Serana cured vamprism.

lines.firstObjective: Talk to Katana when you have a moment

quests.name: The Sweetest Carrot
journal: Megara mentioned a carrot at Chillfurrow Farm. I wonder what's so special about it. I suppose I should find out.
Time to steal the carrot. Hopefully, no one catches us.
I've picked up the carrot!
Megara wants to go back to the Bannered Mare to talk. I wonder if she has other plans. Or was that all?
Megara said she'll give the carrot we stole to Cappy soon. I should wait a little, then ask her about it.
Well, that was worth it! Plus, I don't think Nazeem will miss that carrot. What would he do if he found out, anyway?
I refused to help Megara with this "special" carrot.
objectives: Head to the Chillfurrow Farm area and then talk to Megara

quests.name: Honey Nuts and the Chin of Fate
journal: After dealing with Chadryn, Katana and Megara could use a little adventure to clear their heads. And so could I. Time for some fun.
Rumor has it there's a special plant near Riften that could lift our spirits. We should go find it and forget all our troubles.

I should bring Katana and Megara to the bridge in Riverwood. The soothing sounds of the river could do us all some good. Afterwards, we could stroll through town, and maybe even grab a drink to unwind.
Well, that was quite an adventure. I'm sure we'll have many more.
Well, that was quite an adventure. I'm sure we'll have many more.
Well, that was quite an adventure. I'm sure we'll have many more.
Well, that was quite an adventure. I'm sure we'll have many more.
objectives: Head to Solitude with Katana and Megara
Stop by the Honningbrew Meadery with Katana and Megara
Head to Riften with Katana and Megara
Head to Riverwood with Katana and Megara

quests.name: Chasing the Current
journal: I don't know exactly what Katana needs help with, but I'm sure she'll tell me when she's ready. For now, I guess it's a waiting game.
Katana has a plan, but it looks like I need to wait and talk to her later.
At the Drunken Huntsman, I'll need to sit at one of the tables and someone's supposed to come find me.
Alright, I'll bite. I sat. I'm not really sure what's happening, but I want to know what Katana has planned.
To collect the bounty, I need to go to Silent Moons Camp near Whiterun, and defeat Lucky Irnsvar.
I've defeated Lucky Irnsvar. Now, I need to go sit at a table at the Silver-Blood Inn in Markarth, and tell Megara.
I suppose sitting at taverns is code for something for these people.
Megara gave me a letter that was found near the bandit I defeated. I don't know why she gave the letter to me, but I should read it.
A bandit called Galtun Bold-Thief is waiting to challenge me. I must go to Kolskeggr Mine near Markarth to defeat them.
Galtun Bold-Thief has been defeated. I need to meet Megara at the Bee and Barb in Riften and let her know.
I don't understand why I have to keep sitting.
Megara gave me another note. I should read it.
I need to go to Broken Helm Hollow near Riften to defeat Runir Wulfhart. This might give us information to find the thief.
I've defeated Runir Wulfhart and need to go collect my reward from Megara. She also might have more information for me.
Megara has finally given me the location of the thief. I should talk to Katana, but I feel quite off... as if someone is watching me. I should look around.
What was that? I really should talk to Katana.
We must go to a house near Fort Fellhammer when we're ready to face River.

River got away, but it seems Katana's made peace with it. I'm just glad we made it out alive, and I bet Megara will be, too. A drink with her and Katana at the Drunken Huntsman would be wonderful right now. We'll celebrate and get to know each other better! Maybe she'd even like to join us.
objectives: Talk to Katana when you have a moment
Wait to hear about Katana's plan
Head to the Bee and Barb

quests.name: Megara's Radiant Quests
objectives: Kill the leader of the bandits at <Alias=BanditLocation>

quests.name: Serenata
journal: I wonder what Megara wants to talk about. She looks anxious.

Katana and Megara are off making arrangements for their big day, leaving Shale in my hands - probably to keep him as clueless as I am about what they're planning. Anyway, Megara says they should be done by tomorrow, but who really knows? In the meantime, how about some adventuring with Shale?
I think we should be receiving something shortly... From a courier, perhaps?
The courier delivered a note from Katana and Megara. Maybe there's news about their big day? I should read it with Shale.

The scroll will carry Shale and me to wherever Katana and Megara are. I should use it when I'm ready. Not sure anyone can really be ready for tingling and... compromised underthings, but hey, gotta make sacrifices, right? Their smiles are worth it.
The scroll did its thing. Now, we need to find Megara and Katana.
Chadryn, huh? What were they thinking? Well, anyway, it's time to enjoy the ceremony.
Even Chadryn couldn't ruin such a beautiful moment. Everyone's happy, celebrating. I should join them and mingle a while.
While Katana and Megara are enjoying their honeymoon, Shale and I can have our own fun. We should keep venturing together for now.
Katana and Megara are already back from their honeymoon.
So happy to have Megara and Katana back! I can't wait to hear all about their honeymoon. Time to get them talking!
Katana and Megara have never looked happier. So happy I could be there to celebrate their marriage, and no matter what the future brings, I'm glad to have them in my life.
objectives: With Katana and Shale, talk to Megara in a city during the day
Journey with Shale for about a day
With Shale, read the note from Katana and Megara
With Shale, use the scroll when you're ready
Let Megara know when you're ready to leave
With Shale, await Katana and Megara's return
Talk to Megara to continue your journey

quests.name: Sugar and Spice
journal: I have no idea why we're going to Kilerth's Rest. After everything that's happened.
I have no idea why we're going to Kilerth's Rest. After everything that's happened.
It's finally happening. I should do what Katana's asking.
I'm so confused right now. I must have passed out.
Katana wants to spend some time together around Katla's Farm. I wonder what she wants to talk about.
I don't know what I expected... maybe something rowdier? Katana did mention making things less peaceful. But our time together was still interesting.
I don't really know what to say. Well played, Katana. Well played.
objectives: Head to Kilerth's Rest with Katana
Get comfortable and close your eyes
Head to the coast by Katla's Farm with Katana

quests.name: The Khat's Eye
journal: Megara's set on solving Moorside Inn's surplus cheese problem. We do deserve a couple of nights of good food, wine and a lot fun. But I can't imagine facing Katana's wrath if I don't take her along, so when I get a chance, I should take them both to Morthal.
Al'Tharo says he dropped his spectacles by Movarth's Lair. I should explore the area.
Looks like Thalmor spies were expecting Al'Tharo. I must defeat them.
I'm glad Al'Tharo didn't try to get his spectacles back, himself. Now that I have them on my person, I can return them to him.
Al'Tharo is safe from the spies for now, and I'm happy we were able to help him. I'm fairly certain Megara will miss him.
objectives: Relax at Moorside Inn with Katana and Megara

quests.name: The Ravens' Lament
journal: Katana's trying to hide it, but River's clearly getting to her. She won't be ignoring this much longer. I should talk to her about visiting The Bee and Barb.
Katana plans to put an end to the problem with River, and she wants Megara and me with her. We should head to The Bee and Barb when we're ready.
River evaded us. I should look for anything that might tell us where to find her.
I'll never remember this. I should take the note with me. But what's with that flower?
River's toying with us. Her rhymes are off, and the riddle makes little sense. Katana thinks River is at Vilemyr Inn, but Megara suggests we check Fallowstone Cave.
Things are about to get ugly. How could they not? We need to stay sharp.
An ambush? River thinks she's clever.
Megara thinks she knows where Shale is, and it seems he's running out of time. We'll follow her lead.
River's trying to flee again. What a rat. Hopefully Shale knows where he's going.
Hagravens? Matches River's style. Let's end this once and for all.
Katana's close to breaking down, but getting her away from River's camp should help. So we'll go to the Bee and Barb to rest and have a few drinks.

This whole thing with River has been rough. I should check on Katana and Megara, maybe introduce myself to Shale. A chance to talk could be just what we all need. When I'm ready to go, I'll let Katana know.

River's gone, but can we claim victory? Twice we faced her. Twice we tasted defeat. If not for Katana's shade, would we even still live? I'll never know, but I'm not complaining. Here we are, breathing. We saved Shale, the shade saved us all, and Katana's free of River. We have warm food, good drinks, and the best company. Whatever tomorrow brings, we face it together, and maybe Shale wouldn't mind facing it with us.

lines.name: Fishing
lines.begins: Skyrim's waters are teeming with life just below the surface. With enough skill and a bit of luck, I could catch a few fish that would make for a hearty meal. While there are many places to fish throughout Skyrim, I've heard rumors of an excellent fishing spot at a camp near the Guardian Stones just south of Riverwood.
lines.firstObjective: Visit the fishing camp south of Riverwood

quests.name: In A Pinch
journal: I met Viriya, one of the employees at the Riften Fishery. She handed me a bounty letter and seemed rather frustrated. I should see what it has to say.

Viriya at the Riften Fishery has been conducting research on breeding mudcrabs to harvest their meat, much like fish. She has issued a bounty for someone to obtain a juvenile mudcrab for her studies, but the last person to accept the bounty never returned. I should speak to her when I am ready to take over the bounty.

Viriya at the Riften Fishery has been conducting research on mudcrabs in the hopes that they could be more easily bred and harvested, much like fish. She has issued a bounty for someone to obtain a juvenile mudcrab for her studies, but the last person to accept the bounty never returned. I should try fishing one up myself in the streams and lakes in the temperate parts of Skyrim. One lake in particular is known to be teeming with mudcrab, which Viriya mentioned was west of Broken Fang Cave.
I turned a juvenile mudcrab over to Viriya for her research. In return, she gave me a key to the Riften Fishery so that I may enter whenever I need to.
objectives: Obtain a juvenile mudcrab for Viriya
Speak to Viriya about taking over the bounty

quests.name: Crustacean Extermination
journal: Viriya has entrusted me with another task directly from her. I should read what her note has to say.

An unexplained swarm of aggressive mudcrabs have recently begun attacking fishermen at a fishing shack on the coast west of Dawnstar. Viriya has tasked me with eliminating them in order to make the coasts safe once more.
I've arrived at the fishing shack west of Dawnstar. As I approached, frenzied mudcrabs attacked from the sea. I'll have to defeat them in order to make this area safe again.
I've defeated the swarm of frenzied mudcrabs. I should investigate the area to see if I can discover why the mudcrabs in this area have become so aggressive.

I discovered that Seviur, a novice necromancer, was practicing his arts on the coastline. He cast a powerful illusion spell to bring mudcrabs to the shore where he repeatedly killed and resurrected them in order to hone his abilities. Aggressive mudcrabs not under Seviur's control soon began rising from the sea to attack. Eventually, Seviur was slain, but it seems that the frenzied mudcrab attacks have not stopped. I must now quell this latest mudcrab attack on the coastline.

I discovered that Seviur, a novice necromancer, was practicing his arts on the coastline. He cast a powerful illusion spell to bring mudcrabs to the shore where he repeatedly killed and resurrected them in order to hone his abilities. Aggressive mudcrabs not under Seviur's control soon began rising from the sea to attack. Eventually, Seviur was slain, but it seems that the frenzied mudcrab attacks have not stopped. Now that the mudcrabs have been defeated, I should return to Viriya.

I returned to Viriya and told her about the mudcrab swarm and the necromancer who stirred them into a frenzy. As payment, she gave me an Alik'ri fishing rod, which should be very helpful when trying to catch smaller fish.
objectives: Read the letter on mudcrab attacks
Investigate the area near the fishing shack west of Dawnstar
Discover the origin of the frenzied mudcrabs

quests.name: End of the Line
journal: I've received a letter from Viriya. I should read what it has to say.

Viriya is planning to leave the Riften Fishery and start her own market stall in the Grand Plaza specializing in her passion, mudcrab. I should see if I can help her by obtaining all of the supplies she will need to build her stall so she can move on to her next venture.
I have given Viriya everything she needs in order to build her own market stall in the Grand Plaza. I should wait for her to set it up.
Viriya should have her market stall in the Grand Plaza set up by now. I should pay her a visit when I have the chance.
I spoke to Viriya at her new market stall, where she has started a new chapter in her life beyond the Riften Fishery. I'm glad she was able to realize her dream of farming and selling mudcrab meat.
objectives: Bring the building supplies to Viriya
Wait 24 hours for Viriya to set up her market stall

quests.name: Wave Breaker
journal: I received a hastily written letter from Viriya. I should read what it has to say.

Viriya received a letter from Jarl <Alias=Jarl> in Dawnstar. The frenzied mudcrabs have emerged once again. When the Dawnstar guard arrived, they were attacked by a spirit that caused them to flee in terror. Viriya is already on her way to Dawnstar and asked for my assistance. I should answer the call and return to the shore west of Dawnstar.

I have arrived once again at the shore west of Dawnstar. The signs of a recent battle scar the surrounding area where Viriya and a handful of guards have stood their ground against a mudcrab horde. As I approached, the frenzied mudcrabs began to emerge from the sea again. I should help Viriya and the guards defeat them.
I've helped Viriya and the guards defeat a wave of frenzied mudcrabs, but more are coming. I should take a moment to prepare for the next assault.
Another wave of frenzied mudcrabs have emerged from the sea west of Dawnstar, this time more numerous than ever. We will need to fend them off once more.
After several hard-fought battles, the frenzied mudcrab attacks have stopped for now. We should regroup inside the shack nearby.
Now that we've regrouped after the battle, I should speak to Viriya inside the shack.

The guardian spirit of a massive emperor crab has materialized off the coast, along with a new wave of mudcrabs. The guardian spirit is too large to be harmed by normal means. However, I should be able to use the catapults the guards have put in position nearby. The mudcrabs seem to have collected the flaming pots from the wrecked wagon near the shack. I will have to recover them from the mudcrabs and use them to fire the catapults at the guardian spirit.
Using the catapults, I managed to vanquish the emperor crab guardian spirit. The swarms of frenzied mudcrabs have come to an end. I should speak to Viriya now that the battle is over.

In the aftermath of the battle, Viriya thanked me for helping defeat the guardian spirit of the emperor crab. The guards must tend to their wounds, and Viriya will make the long journey back to Riften. The emperor crab guardian spirit and its horde of frenzied mudcrabs should no longer threaten the people of Dawnstar. I should travel to Dawnstar and inform the Jarl that the battle was a success.

In the aftermath of the battle, Viriya thanked me for helping defeat the guardian spirit of the emperor crab. The guards must tend to their wounds, and Viriya will make the long journey back to Riften. The emperor crab guardian spirit and its horde of frenzied mudcrabs should no longer threaten the people of Dawnstar. I traveled to Dawnstar and informed the Jarl, who rewarded me for my efforts.
objectives: Return to the shore west of Dawnstar
Regroup with Viriya inside the shack
Fire the catapults at the Emperor Crab Guardian Spirit (<Global=ccBGSSSE001_CrabMQ4CatapultCount>/<Global=ccBGSSSE001_CrabMQ4CatapultTotal>)
Fire catapults at the Emperor Crab Guardian Spirit using flaming pots (<Global=ccBGSSSE001_CrabMQ4CatapultCount>/<Global=ccBGSSSE001_CrabMQ4CatapultTotal>)
Obtain flaming pots from the frenzied mudcrabs

quests.name: Catch of the Day
journal: Swims-In-Deep-Water has given me a list of fish I should catch to improve my fishing skills. I should read the note to see what I need to catch.

Swims-In-Deep-Water would like me to catch fish that can commonly be caught in streams and lakes in the warmer parts of Skyrim. Once I've caught one of each, I should return them to him. His field guide, Fishing Mastery, should provide details on each fish and how they can be caught. He mentioned that a copy is sitting on a shelf in the back room of the Riften Fishery.

I read the first volume of Fishing Mastery, Swims-In-Deep-Water's field guide. All of the fish I need to catch can be caught in the warmer parts of Skyrim on a clear day. Goldfish and glassfish can only be caught in lakes, while pogfish are found in streams. Carp can be caught in both lakes and streams. I should be able to catch what I need by fishing of off the docks near the Riften Fishery, and along the river that leads to Ivarstead.
I've given Swims-In-Deep-Water all of the fish he requested as proof of completing his fishing challenge. In return, he gave me a sum of gold, as well as a key to the Riften Fishery.
objectives: Read the list of fair weather fish

quests.name: Caught in the Rain
journal: Swims-In-Deep-Water has given me another fishing challenge. I should read the list he gave me to see what I will need to catch.

The fish that Swims-In-Deep-Water would like me to catch are a bit more elusive than last time. However, they come to the surface more frequently while it is raining. I should refer to the second volume of Fishing Mastery to learn more. He also asked me to help fish up his lucky fishing hat, lost at a fishing spot west of Sarethi Farm. He claims that it rains wherever he wears the hat when fishing. That sounds far-fetched, but I suppose I could use all the luck I can get.

I have read the second volume of Fishing Mastery. All of the fish I need to catch are most easily caught when it's raining in the warmer parts of Skyrim. Catfish, spadefish, and pygmy sunfish can only be caught in lakes. Pearlfish can be caught in both lakes and streams. He also asked me to help fish up his lucky fishing hat, lost at a fishing spot west of Sarethi Farm. He claims that it rains wherever he wears the hat when fishing. That sounds far-fetched, but I suppose I could use all the luck I can get.

I've given Swims-In-Deep-Water all of the fish he requested as proof of completing his fishing challenge, as well as his lucky fishing hat. He rewarded me with an Argonian fishing rod, which will be useful when trying to catch large fish. He also handed me a sum of gold.

I've given Swims-In-Deep-Water all of the fish he requested as proof of completing his fishing challenge. I kept his lucky fishing hat to myself after telling him I couldn't find it. He rewarded me with an Argonian fishing rod, which will be useful when trying to catch large fish.
objectives: Fish up Swims-In-Deep-Water's lucky fishing hat
Read the list of rainy weather fish

quests.name: Frozen Fish
journal: I received a letter from Swims-In-Deep-Water about fishing challenges. I should see what it has to say.
Swims-In-Deep-Water is ready to resume my fishing challenges. I should speak with him when I return to the Riften Fishery.
Swims-In-Deep-Water has given me another fishing challenge. I should read the list he gave me to see what I will need to catch.

The fish that Swims-In-Deep-Water has tasked me with catching are commonly found in the freezing waters of Skyrim's snow-capped landscapes. Once I've caught one of each, I should return them to him. I can consult the third volume of Fishing Mastery to learn more about my quarry.

I have read the third volume of Fishing Mastery. All of the fish I need to catch to complete the challenge can be caught at fishing spots wherever there is freezing water near snow and ice. The docks of Windhelm, the water near Dawnstar, and the small lake near Nightgate Inn were mentioned as places I could try casting my line.
I've given Swims-In-Deep-Water all of the fish he requested as proof of completing his fishing challenge.
objectives: Read the letter on fishing work
Read the list of arctic fish

quests.name: Darkest Depths
journal: Swims-In-Deep-Water has given me another fishing challenge. I should read the list he gave me to see what I will need to catch.

The fish that Swims-In-Deep-Water would like me to catch are only found in caves, flooded mines, and other underground places. Once I've caught one of each, I should return them to him. I can read more about each fish, and where to catch them, in the fourth volume of Fishing Mastery.

I've read the fourth volume of Fishing Mastery. The fish I need to complete the challenge can only be caught underground. Eldergleam Sanctuary in Eastmarch, Brood Cavern in the mountains south of Morthal, Embershard Mine near Riverwood, and Chillwind Depths south of the Dragon Bridge were places mentioned that I could try my hand at catching them.
I've given Swims-In-Deep-Water all of the fish he requested as proof of completing his fishing challenge.
objectives: Read the list of underground fish

quests.name: Fishing Legend
journal: Swims-In-Deep-Water has given me another fishing challenge. I should read the list he gave me to see what I will need to catch.

For my final challenge, the fish I am to catch are both rare and found in locations all over Skyrim. The fifth volume of Fishing Mastery has details on where, and how, to catch them. I should return them to Swims-In-Deep-Water once I've caught them all.

For my final challenge, the fish I am to catch are both rare and found in locations all over Skyrim. Angelfish can be found in temperate lakes, and can only be caught with an Alik'ri fishing rod. The lyretail anthias can be caught in temperate streams with the Alik'ri rod as well. Anglers are only caught in freezing waters using the Argonian fishing rod. Finally, scorpion fish are found underground. Like the angler, scorpion fish can only be caught by using the Argonian fishing rod.
I've completed Swims-In-Deep-Water's final fishing challenge, designating me a legendary fisherman. He granted me the Fang of Haynekhtnamet, an exquisite Argonian dagger, as a reward.
objectives: Read the list of rare fish

quests.name: Beneath Bronze Waters
journal: Calcelmo has heard fishermen's tales of a strange apparatus outside of Bronze Water Cave. He believes it is an ancient Dwemer mechanism of unknown purpose, waiting to be brought to life. I should investigate the area and see if there might be any way to trigger it.
I've arrived at the entrance of Bronze Water Cave. The fishermen that once fished here seem to have left behind a journal. It may contain a clue for activating the mechanisms nearby.

The fishermen at Bronze Water Cave saw faint glowing objects at the bottom of the lake near Bronze Water Cave, but they were unable to fish them up. They believed that a fishing rod of Dwarven make might be needed to retrieve them. They recently left for Alftand Ruined Tower, where the schematics for such a rod might be located.

I've found the schematics for the Dwarven fishing rod that might be used to catch the glowing objects that lie below the water's surface outside of Bronze Water Cave. I should return it to Calcelmo so that he can construct it.
I've given Calcelmo the schematics for the Dwarven fishing rod. I now need to wait for him to construct it. I should ask him about it at this time tomorrow.
Calcelmo should be finished constructing the Dwarven fishing rod from the schematic I discovered.

Calcelmo has given me the Dwarven fishing rod. I should cast it at the fishing spots near Bronze Water Cave so that I might be able to catch the objects that might activate the mechanisms near the cave.

I cast the Dwarven fishing rod into the water near Bronze Water Cave, and caught an aetherium dynamo core. An empty socket on the pedestal nearby appears to be shaped to hold such a core. I'll have to insert the dynamo core to bring the rest of the mechanism to life.

I cast the Dwarven fishing rod into the water near Bronze Water Cave, and caught an aetherium dynamo core. An empty socket on the pedestal nearby appears to be shaped to hold such a core. I'll have to insert the dynamo core to bring the rest of the mechanism to life.
After using the Dwarven fishing rod near Bronze Water Cave and powering up an ancient mechanism using aetherium dynamo cores, a pedestal rose from beneath the surface revealing a submerged chest.
objectives: Investigate the entrance of Bronze Water Cave
Find the Dwarven fishing rod schematic in Alftand Ruined Tower
Bring the Dwarven fishing rod schematic to Calcelmo
Wait 24 hours for Calcelmo to build the fishing rod
