quests.name: Clear-Headed
journal: Zaria, the proprietor of Grave Concoctions in Falkreath, is in need of someone to bring her a glassfish for use in potion making.
I gave Zaria the glassfish she requested. She handed me a sum of gold along with a note. I should read what the note has to say.

Someone in the city guard may be using skooma, and the Jarl has asked for Zaria's help in stopping it. Zaria plans to brew an invisibility potion disguised as a bottle of skooma. I should give the bottle to the guard suspected of using skooma in the Falkreath Barracks. Now that I understand Zaria and the Jarl's plan, I should obtain the disguised potion from Zaria.
Zaria gave me her invisibility potion disguised as a bottle of skooma. I should hand it over to the guard inside the barracks.
I killed the guard suspected of using skooma in the Falkreath Barracks. I should let Zaria know.
I handed the invisibility potion disguised as skooma over to the guard inside the barracks. I should follow him to see if he tries to use the "skooma".

I watched as the guard drank the potion disguised as skooma. He seemed truly distraught after he saw himself turn invisible. Hopefully this is the last of his skooma using days. I should let Zaria know that the plan worked.
I let Zaria know that the plan to scare the guard away from using skooma was a success. She rewarded me with an enchanted ring from the Jarl himself.
I let Zaria know that I killed the guard suspected of using skooma. She clearly disapproved of my methods, but still rewarded me with an enchanted ring from the Jarl nonetheless.
objectives: Obtain a glassfish for Zaria in Falkreath
Obtain the disguised invisibility potion from Zaria
Give the disguised invisibility potion to the guard in the Falkreath Barracks
Follow the guard into the Falkreath Barracks Jail
Tell Zaria that the guard is dead

quests.name: Spirits Away
journal: Ri'saad, the Khajiit caravan merchant, has accidentally lost several bottles of expensive flin. He has already sold the bottles to an impatient buyer and needs to retrieve them as soon as possible. Ri'saad has put out a bounty to anyone who might be able to retrieve them from the river west of Old Hroldan Inn.
I discovered what appears to be the Khajiit caravan's overturned cart along the river west of Old Hroldan Inn. If I fish here, I may be able to recover the lost bottles of aged flin.
I've managed to fish up all of the rare bottles of aged flin that were lost in the river. I should return them to Ri'saad to fulfill the bounty.
I gave Ri'saad the lost bottles of aged flin. In return, he paid me with an enchanted ring that aids the wearer in moving quickly and silently. The aged flin must have been very special indeed.
objectives: Find the Khajiit caravan's overturned cart west of Old Hroldan Inn
Fish up Ri'saad's lost bottles of aged flin (<Global=ccBGSSSE001_MiscKhajiitFlinCount>/<Global=ccBGSSSE001_MiscKhajiitFlinTotal>)

quests.name: Private Lessons
journal: Lynea in Markarth is in search of a fishing tutor. I should let her know when I feel up to the task. Her bounty letter said that she can be found waiting in the Silver-Blood Inn.
I spoke to Lynea about fishing lessons, and she agreed to meet me on the docks near the Warrens in Markarth when she is ready to begin.
I met Lynea on the docks near the Warrens. I should catch several fish in order to demonstrate proper fishing technique.
I caught several fish while Lynea watched on. I should speak with her now that the lesson is complete.
Lynea seemed to appreciate her fishing lesson, and gave me her amulet of Dibella as payment.
objectives: Speak to Lynea about private fishing lessons
Meet Lynea on the docks near the Warrens

quests.name: No Contest
journal: A fisherman named Brutius is challenging anyone who would face him to a fishing contest. He requires his challengers to make a wager on who the better fisher is. If I want to test my fishing abilities against him, I should meet him on the docks in Morthal.
I placed a bet with Brutius that I could best him in a fishing contest. He marked where we will have the contest on my map. I should meet him there when I am ready to face him.

It seems that the fishing contest was nothing more than a trap. Brutius and several other wizards ambushed me as soon as I arrived at the location for the fishing contest. I will have to defeat them before I can find any answers.
I defeated Brutius and the rest of his ambushers. I should search him to see if he kept a journal of his misdeeds.
I defeated Brutius, who turned out to be a wizard disguised as a fisherman. I wonder what other secrets he might have been keeping. I should search him to see if he kept a journal.
On Brutius's body, I found a journal. I should read it to discover what secrets he's been keeping.

It seems that Brutius was a wizard that has been luring unsuspecting fisherman into the woods under the guise of a fishing contest, only to slay and rob them. Of note is an enchanted ring that he recently lost in the river at the fishing spot he lured his victims. I might be able to claim it if I try fishing there myself.

Tamriel is a better place without Brutius preying upon the citizens of Morthal. I also managed to fish up the Warlock's Ring, the ring Bruitus lost at the spot near the river where he lured his victims.
objectives: Talk to Brutius in Morthal about a fishing contest
Meet Brutius at the fishing spot

quests.name: The Ultimate Feast
journal: Gisli in Solitude has requested a huge seafood meal. The innkeeper does not stock everything she would like, so I'll need to collect all of the food in Gisli's bounty letter in order to set a table for her on the second floor of the Winking Skeever.
I have set a table for Gisli at the Winking Skeever in Solitude. I should wait for her to take her seat and check in once she's finished dining.
Gisli should be finished dining by now. I should check the table for her payment.
I prepared a huge seafood feast for Gisli in Solitude. Judging by the letter of thanks and the coin purse left on her empty plate, she seemed satisfied with her meal.
objectives: Obtain a pair of steamed crab legs
Obtain a bowl of crab stew
Wait for Gisli to take her seat

quests.name: Heart of Gold
journal: Mila Valentia in Whiterun wants a pet goldfish. While I can't hope for much of a reward, I'm sure she would really appreciate it if I brought her one.
I brought Mila a goldfish. I should follow her to make sure she's going to take care of it.
I gave Mila a goldfish. She seemed very happy with her new pet. In exchange, she handed me a single septim. It's not much, but at least I helped brighten a child's day.
objectives: Obtain a goldfish for Mila Valentia in Whiterun

quests.name: Two of a Kind
journal: I received a letter from Mila Valentia. I should read what it has to say.
Mila Valentia in Whiterun wrote me a letter saying that the goldfish I brought her needs a companion. I should bring her another goldfish whenever the opportunity arises.
I brought Mila another goldfish. I should follow her to the trough where she will keep them.
Mila's goldfish now has a new companion. In exchange, she gave me a note and a key. I should see what the note has to say.

Mila's note mentions that she keeps "treasure" in a secret hiding place where she likes to play behind Dragonsreach. It's likely just things she's found around Whiterun, but I should check just to be certain.

I brought Mila Valentia another goldfish. In exchange, she gave me the key to her treasure box at her hiding spot behind Dragonsreach. I was surprised to discover that she has collected a set of rare alchemy ingredients.
objectives: Find another goldfish for Mila Valentia
Read the letter from Mila Valentia

quests.name: Tusked Terror
journal: The Jarl of Windhelm has put out a bounty on a monsterous horker known as Fangtusk, which has been terrorizing fishermen north of Hollyfrost Farm. Fishermen have learned that it seems to enjoy arctic grayling above all other fish. I should obtain an arctic grayling and leave it near its feeding grounds in order to lure it out.
I've placed an arctic grayling at Fangtusk's feeding grounds, which seems to have lured it out. I can now slay it in order to rid the area of its hostility.

I have slain Fangtusk. During the battle, I discovered that the rumors about its ability to drain the life of those around it are true. I should inspect it to learn what, if anything, has granted it this unnatural ability.
After slaying Fangtusk, I discovered the remains of a vampire inside its gut, along with an enchanted vampiric ring. I should show the Jarl's steward the ring as proof that the deed is done.
I showed the vampiric ring taken from Fangtusk to Jarl of Windhelm's steward, who rewarded me for fulfilling the bounty.
objectives: Place an arctic grayling at Fangtusk's feeding grounds

quests.name: First Catch
journal: Skyrim's waters are teeming with life just below the surface. With enough skill and a bit of luck, I could catch a few fish that would make for a hearty meal. While there are many places to fish throughout Skyrim, I've heard rumors of an excellent fishing spot at a camp near the Guardian Stones just south of Riverwood.

I've found the fishing spot near the Guardian Stones. I should try my hand at fishing here to see what I can catch. The fisherman who camps here seems to have a copy of Line and Lure nearby. I might learn a few things by flipping through it.
Using my fishing rod and supplies, I managed to make my first of many successful catches.
objectives: Visit the fishing camp south of Riverwood
Catch a fish using fishing supplies

quests.name: Angler Acquaintances

I've introduced myself to both of the most experienced fishermen at the Riften Fishery, with the hope that their assignments will help me hone my skill in fishing.
